source: The Service of the Deacon (St Demiana & St Athanasius Coptic Orthodox Church, Sydney)

rows.en: Have mercy on us, O God, the Father, Almighty, O Holy Trinity have mercy upon us. O Lord, God of Hosts, be with us, for we have no other helper in our tribulations and advertisies but You.
rows.cop_lat: Eleyson Emas O Theos O Patir O Pantokrator : pan agia etreyas eleyson emas : Epchoise Efnoty ente nigom shopi neman : je emmon entan en-o-voethe-os khen nen-ethli epsis nem nen hog-heg ev-eel erok.

rows.en: O Lord make us worthy to pray thankfully, “Our Father…”
Our Father, who art in Heaven…
rows.ar_lat: Ya Abana allazi felsamawat…
rows.cop_lat: Je Penyout et-khen ni-fiowi…

rows.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅.
rows.en: Through Jesus Christ our Lord.
rows.ar_lat: Bel Massieh Yasoua Rabena.
rows.cop_lat: Khen pi-Ekhristos Isous Penchoise.

rows.cop: Ϣⲗⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Eshleel.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲡⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲕⲏ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲑⲏⲧⲉ.
rows.en: Stand up for prayer.
rows.ar_lat: Lel sala kefu.
rows.cop_lat: Epi epros-evki esta-thite.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲡⲁⲥⲓ.
rows.en: Peace be with you all.
rows.ar_lat: Al-salam le gameakom.
rows.cop_lat: Irini Pasi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: And also with you.
rows.ar_lat: Wa ma’a roheka aydan.
rows.cop_lat: Ke to epnevmati so.

rows.en: Let us give thanks to the Good and Merciful God, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ, for He has protected, assisted, preserved, accepted us, had compassion upon us, supported us and brought us till this hour.
rows.ar_lat: Falnashkor sane’a alkhayrat al-rahum Allah, Abu Rabena wa Ellahona wa Mokhalisna Yasoua alMassieh. Le-anahu satarna, wa a’anana wa hafizana wa kabilana ele’a wa ashfakta alayna wa a’adadana wa ata bina ella hazehi el-sa’a.
rows.cop_lat: Maren shep ehmot entotf empi refer pethna-nef, owoh enaeet Efnoty Efyot em Penchoise owoh Pennoty owoh Pensoteer Isous piEkhristos. Je afir eskepazin egon, afervo-ethin eron af-areh eron, afshoptin erof, afty aso-eron, afti-toten afenten sha e-ehri etay ono thay.

rows.en: Let us ask the Almighty God to keep us in peace this blessed day, and all the days of our life.
rows.ar_lat: Howa aydan falnas-alahu a’an yahfazana fi haza al-yom al-mokaddas wa-kol ayam hayatena bekol salam el-dabet el-kol al-Rabu Ellahona.
rows.cop_lat: Enthof-on marenti-ho erof hopos entef are-eron khen pai eho-o Ethouab fay nem ni-eho-o tiro ente penonkh khen hiriny niven enje pi pantokrator Epchoise Pennoty.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ.
rows.en: Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Epros evek-saste.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: O Lord, Master and Almighty God, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ. We thank You on every occasion, in every condition and for all things. For You have protected, assisted, preserved, accepted us, had compassion upon us, supported us and brought us till this hour.
rows.ar_lat: Ayoha al-Sayedo al-Rabu el-Ellah dabet el-kol, Abu Rabena wa-Elahena, wa Mokhalesna Yasoua elMassieh. Nashkoroka a’ala kol hal wa men agl kol hal wa fi kol hal. Le anaka satartana wa a’antana wa hafeztana wa kabeltana elayka, wa ashfakta a’alayan wa a’adad-tana wa atayta bena ella hazeh el-sa’a.
rows.cop_lat: Efneeb Epchoise Efnoty Pi-Pantokrator, Efyot em Penchoise owoh Pennoty owoh Pensoteer Isous piEkhristos. Ten shep ehmot en-totk kata hob niven nem ethve hob niven nem khen hob niven. Je aker eskepazin egon aker vo ethin eron akare-eron, akshopten erok akty aso eron, akty toten aken ten sha e-ehry etay ono thay.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ϧⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲉⲣⲃⲟⲏ̀ⲑⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϯϩⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Let us pray that God may have mercy and compassion upon us, hear us, sustain us, and continuously accept the prayers and supplications of His saints on our behalf, for the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.ar_lat: Otlobu leaky yarhaman Allah, wa yatar-af ‘allayna, wa yasma’ana way o‘eenana wa yakbal so’al-at wa telbat kedeeseeh, menhum besalahy ‘ana fi kol heen, le maghferat khatayana.
rows.cop_lat: Tovh hina ente Efnoty nay nan entef shenheet kharon : entef sotem eron entef ervo-ethin eron : entef-etshi en-nitiho nem ni-tovh ente ni ethouab entaf entoto e ehri egon epi agathon en seyo niven : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Therefore, we ask and appeal to Your goodness, O lover of mankind that You grant us to conclude this blessed day and all the days of our life in peace and in Your fear.
rows.ar_lat: Men agl haza nas-al wa natlob men salahika ya moheb el bashar amnahna an nokamil haza al-yawm el-mokadas wa kol ayam hayatina bekol salamen ma-a’a khawfik. Kol hasad wa kol tagreba wa kol fa’el al-shaytan wa mu-amarat alnas al ashrar wa keyam al a’ada al khafeyeen wa al zahereen.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenty-ho owoh tentovh entekmet aghathos pimayromi mees nan ethrengok evol em payky eho-o ethouab fay nem ni eho-o tiro ente pen-onkh khen hiriny niven nem tek-hoty. Efthonos niven pirasmos niven, energia niven ente epsatanas, epsotshini ente hanromy evho-o nem eptonf e-epshoy ente han gaji ney et-heep nem ni etho-onh evol.

rows.en: All envy, all temptation, all works of satan, all intrigues of the wicked, uprising of enemies, seen and unseen, do cast away from us, and from all Your people, and from this church and from this holy place of Yours. Grant us endowments and benefactions, as You have given us the power to tread underfoot serpents, scorpions and the whole strength of the enemy.
rows.ar_lat: Enza’aha a’na wa ‘an sa-er sha’abek, wa ‘an hazihi al-mawda. Wa ‘an mawde’ak al mokadas haza. Amma al-salehat wal nafi-at fa erzukna eyaha, le anaka anta allazy a’taytana al soltan an nadusa ‘alla al hayat wal a’karib wa kol kowat al a’dow.
rows.cop_lat: Aleeto evol haron nem evol ha pekla-os tirf nem evol ha etrapeza thay nem evol ha payma ethouab entak fay. Ni ze ethnanev nem ni eternofry sahny emoonan, je enthok pi etakty empe ershishy nan, ehomy ejen nihof nem ni-et-shely, nem ejen tigom tirs ente pigaji.

rows.en: VERSES OF THE CYMBALS
Introduction
WATOS Days (Wed-Sat)

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ̅: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲛ̀ⲟⲙⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy : We worship the Father : the Son and the Holy Spirit : the Holy and co-essential : Holy Trinity.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson : Tenoosht em Efyot : nem Epshiri nem pi Epnevma Ethouab : ti Etreyas Ethouab : en-omoseyos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
rows.en: Hail to the Church : the house of the angels : hail to the virgin : who gave birth to our Saviour.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ti ek-ekleseya : epee ente ni angelos : shere ti-parthenos : etas-mes Pen-soteer.

rows.en: OR ADAM Days (Sun – Tue)

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ̅: Ⲁⲙⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ: ⲛ̀ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: Lord have mercy : O come let us worship : the Holy Trinity : the Father the Son : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson : Amoinee mareno-osht : en-tietreyas ethouab : ete Efyot nem Epshiri : nem Pi-epnevma Ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲡⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: We all the people : of the Christian nation : for this is : our true God.
rows.cop_lat: Anon kha neela-os : en ekhresteyanos : fay ghar pe Pennoty : en alithinos.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ Ⲫϯ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲥⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: We have hope : in Saint Mary : that God will have mercy upon us : through her intercession.
rows.cop_lat: O-on o helpees entan : khen thi ethouab Maria : ere Efnoty nai nan : heeten nes-epresveya.

rows.cop: Ϥⲟⲛ ⲟⲙⲏⲧ ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲁⲓ ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓ ϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲁⲅⲓⲁ̀ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Every peace : in the world : happens through the prayers : of Saint Mary the virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Fon o meet semnos : en ehri khen pai kozmos : evol heeten peeeshlil : ente ti agia Maria ti parthenos.

rows.en: Then continue with the following:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ: ⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Hail to you O Mary : the beautiful dove : who brought forth : to us God the Word.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne Maria : ti etshrompi ethnesos : thi etas-misi nan : emEfnoty pi-loghos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲉϥⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ: ⲙ̀ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: Hail to you O Mary : a holy hail : hail to you O Mary : the mother of the Holy.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne Maria : khen o shere efouab : shere ne Maria ethmav : emfi ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ: ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓ ⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲙ̀ ⲡⲓϥⲁⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + Hail to Michael : the great archangel : hail to Gabriel the chosen announcer : to Mary the virgin. Hail to the Cherubim : hail to the Seraphim : hail to all the : Heavenly orders.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Mikhael : pinishty en-arshi angelos : shere Ghabriel pi sotp em pi-fay shenofi : em Maria ti-parthenos. Shere ni Cherubeem : shere ni Serafeem : shere ni taghma tiro eneporaneyon.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲓⲱⲁ̅: ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲇⲣⲟⲙⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ: ⲡ̀ⲥⲩⲅⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to John : the great fore-runner : hail to the priest : the kinsman of Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Youannis : pinishty em-ep-rodromos : shere pi oweeb : ep-sengenees en-Emmanuel.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ Ⲑⲉⲟ ϥⲁⲛⲓⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: + Hail to our father the devout saint : the great among the apostles : Saint John the beholder of God : and beloved of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere penyot ethouab en zike-os : pinishty khen niapostolos : Abba Yoanness theo-fanyos : pimenrit ente pi-Ekhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ: ⲛ̀ⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Hail to my masters and fathers : the apostles : hail to the disciples : of our Lord Jesus Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nashoys enyoty : en-apostolos : shere nimatheetees : ente Penchoise Isous piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓ̅: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓ Ⲑⲉⲱ̀ⲣⲓⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to you O martyr : hail to the evangelist : hail to the apostle Mark : the beholder of God.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak O pimartiros : shere pi-evangelestis : shere pi apostolos Abba Markos pi-Theo-rimos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲥⲧⲉⲫⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲙ̀: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲁⲣⲭⲓ ⲇⲓⲁⲕⲱⲛ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: + Hail to Stephen : the first martyr : hail to the blessed : arch-deacon.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Stefanos : pishorp em-martiros : shere pi-arshy-ziakon : owoh efesmaro-ot.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓ̅: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϭⲟⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲉⲱⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲱϥⲟⲣⲱⲥ: ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲅⲉⲱ̀ⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to you O Martyr : hail to the courageous hero : hail to the victorious : my master George the prince.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak O pimartiros : shere pietshoig en-gen-ne-os : shere pi athloforos : pachoise eporo George-os.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ ⲡⲓ̅: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣⲱⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲉⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲛⲓⲫⲁⲓⲁⲧ.
rows.en: Hail to you o martyr : hail to the courageous hero : hail to the victorious martyr : Abba Mina of Fayat.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak O pimartiros : shere pi-etshoig engen-e-os : shere piathloforos : Abba Mina ente Nifayat

rows.cop: Ϯⲁⲗⲱ̀ ⲛ̀ⲑⲁⲩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲛ̀Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏ: ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ.
rows.en: + The prudent young virgin : the truly chosen lady of Christ : the bride of Christ : the holy Saint Demiana.
rows.cop_lat: Ti alo en thavi em parthenos : ti sotp en Kiriye emmi : tisheleet ente Pi Ekhristos : ti agia emmi Timiani.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲛⲧⲱⲛⲓⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓϧⲏⲃⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲉ: ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Hail to our father Anthony : the lamp of monasticism : Hail to our father Abba Paul : the beloved of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere penyot Abba Antonios : pi-khebs ente ti-met-monakhos : shere penyot Abba Pavle : pi menreet ente piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲛⲟⲩϣⲏⲣⲓ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲓϣⲱⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲉ: ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Hail to my lords and fathers : who love their children : Abba Bishoi and Abba Paul : the beloved of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nashoys eniyoti em-mai-no-shiri : Ava Pishoi nem Abba Pavle : ni-menreet ente piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲭⲏⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Hail to our Saintly father, the Patriarch : hail to Abba Athanasius the apostolic, the beloved of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere penyot en zike-os : penyot ethouab empatriarchees : Ava Athanasius pi-apostolikos : pi menreet ente piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲱ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲩⲓⲱⲥ: Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲑ̀ⲣⲉⲅⲁⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲙⲁⲧⲁϫⲣⲱϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲉⲑⲣⲟⲛⲱⲥ. Ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲕⲉϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣ: ⲛ̀ⲗⲓⲧⲟⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲓⲥⲕⲱⲡⲟⲥ: ⲙⲁⲧⲁϫⲣⲱϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲉⲑⲣⲟⲛⲱⲥ. Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: + We ask You O Son of God : to keep the life of our Patriarch : Abba (.....) the high priest : confirm him upon his throne. And his partner in the ministry : the honoured father : Ava (…..) the Bishop : confirm him upon his throne. + Through the intercessions : of the Holy mother of God Mary : O Lord : grant us : the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Tenti ho erok O Eyos : Theos eth-reg-areh eeponkh em pen patriarchees : Ava (.....) pi archi-erefs : matagrof higen pef-ethronos. Nem pef-ke-eshfir : enlitorghos : penyot ethouab en zike-os : Ava (…..) pi epeskopos : matagrof higen pefethronos. Heeten nee epresveya : ente ti Theo-tokos ethouab Maria : Epchoise ari ehmot nan : em pi ko evol ente nen-novi.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲕ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ϫⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲕⲓ* ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
rows.en: That we may praise You : with Your Good Father : and the Holy Spirit : You have come* and saved us : have mercy on us.
rows.cop_lat: Ethrenhos erok : nem pekyot en aghathos : nem pi Epnevma ethouab : ge ak-ee* aksoty emmon nai nan.

rows.en: (*Aktonk/risen from Sat night – Tue morning) FEAST OF THE NATIVITY
VERSES OF THE CYMBALS

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ̅: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟ̀ⲩⲱ̀ϣⲧ ⲙ̀Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀Ϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲠⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ϯⲉ̀ⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson : Teno-osht em-Efyot nem Epshiri nem pi-Epnevma Ethouab : shere ti-ek-eklisia ep-ee ente ni-angelos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲛⲁⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere tiparthenos : etas-mes Pensoteer : shere Ghabriel : etafhishenofi nas.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲣⲭⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϫⲟⲩⲧ ϥ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩ: ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Shere Mikhail : pi-archi-angelos shere pigot eftoo : emepresviteros.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓ Ⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓ Ⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ni Sherobim : shere ni Serafeem : shere nitaghma tiro : eneporanion.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ: ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲇⲣⲟⲙⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲏⲧ ⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Youaness : pinishty emeprodromos : shere pimeet esnav : en-apostolos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲩⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲅⲱⲣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲓ̀ⲇⲱⲗⲟⲛ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere penyot Markos : pievangelistis : pirefgor evol : ente nie-ezolon.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲥⲧⲉⲫⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲅⲉⲱ̀ⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲁ̀ⲧⲟ̀ⲟⲩⲓ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Stefanos : pishorp emmartiros : shere Ge-orge-os : piseyo ente han-ato-owi.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲛⲧⲱⲛⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲙⲧ Ⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲟⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere epkhoros tirf : ente ni-martiros : shere Abba Antoni : nem pishomt Makarios.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲣⲁⲛⲁϥ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅.
rows.cop_lat: Shere epkhoros tirf : ente niestavroforos : shere ni-ethouab tiro : etaf-ranaf em-Epchoise.

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲩⲭⲏ: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡⲉⲛⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓ ⲟ̀ⲩⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟ̀ⲩⲣⲟ.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evki : pi-Ekhristos penoro : ari onai neman : khen tekmetoro.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓϫⲓⲛⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲛⲁⲕϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲟⲩϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲟⲝⲟⲛ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲧ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲁⲇⲁⲙ.
rows.cop_lat: Pijinmisi emparthenikon : owoh ninak-hi em-epnevmatikon : oeshfiri emparazoxon : kata ni-esmi em-eprofitikon. Shere Bethle-em : etpolis en-nieprofitis : thi-etavmes pi-Ekhristos enkhits : pimah-esnav en-Adam.

rows.en: Continue with standard verses in yearly tune :

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟϥⲓ: ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Ghabri-eel : pinishty en-arshiangelos : shere fi-etaf-hi-shenofi emMaria tiparthenos.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁϥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫⲟⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲩⲡⲟⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ̀ ⲛⲁϥ.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos ensaf nem fo-oo : enthof enthof pe nem sha eneh : khen o-hipostasis eno-ot teno-osht emof tenti-oo naf.

rows.en: Saint Demiana, Saint Athanasius and other saints may be recited (see pages 8-9)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲱ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲩⲓⲱⲥ: Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲑ̀ⲣⲉⲅⲁⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲙⲁⲧⲁϫⲣⲱϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲉⲑⲣⲟⲛⲱⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Tenti ho erok O Eyos : Theos ethreg-areh e eponkh em pen patriarchees : Ava (.....) pi archierefs : matagrof higen pef-ethronos.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲕⲉϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲗⲓⲧⲟⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲓⲥⲕⲱⲡⲟⲥ: ⲙⲁⲧⲁϫⲣⲱϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲉⲑⲣⲟⲛⲱⲥ.
rows.cop_lat: Nem pef ker eshfir enlitorghos : penyot ethouab en zike-os : Ava (…..) pi-epeskopos : matagrof higen pef-ethronos.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛⲧⲉ ϯϩⲏⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.cop_lat: Epouro ente ti hirini : moi nan entek hirini : semni nan entek hirini : ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.cop: Ϫⲱⲣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲁⲣⲓⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲓⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲏ.
rows.cop_lat: Gor evol eni gaji : ente ti-ekekleseya : arisoft eros : eneskim sha eneh.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲩ̅.
rows.cop_lat: Emmanoeel Pennoty : khen ten mity tino : khen epo-oo ente pefyot : nem pi epnevma ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲧⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲱⲛⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ.
rows.cop_lat: Entef esmo eron tiren : entef tovo en-nenhit : entef tale-cho eni-shoni : ente nen epsishi nem nen soma.

rows.cop: Ϯⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
rows.cop_lat: Teno-osht emmok o pi-Ekhristos : nem Pekyot en agatha-os : nem pi Epnevma Athouab : je av-mask aksoty emmon nai nan.

rows.cop: Ϣⲗⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Eshleel.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲡⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲕⲏ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲑⲏⲧⲉ.
rows.en: Stand prayer.
rows.ar_lat: up
rows.cop_lat: for Lel sala kefu. Epi epros-evki es-ta-thite.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲡⲁⲥⲓ.
rows.en: Peace be with you all.
rows.ar_lat: Al-salam le game-akom.
rows.cop_lat: Irini Pasi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: And you.
rows.ar_lat: also
rows.cop_lat: with Wa ma’a roheka aydan. Ke to epnevmati so.

rows.en: EVENING & SATURDAY MORNING INCENSE :

Again let us ask God the Almighty, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour, Jesus Christ. We ask and entreat Your goodness, O lover of mankind, remember O Lord, the souls of Your servants who have fallen asleep, our fathers and our brethren.
rows.cop_lat: Palin on marenti-ho e-Efnoty piPantokrator : Efyot em Penchoise owoh Pennoty owoh Pensoteer Isous pi-Ekhristos. Ten ti-ho owoh tentovh en-tek- met-aghathos pi-mairomi. Ari-ef- meve-e Epchoise enni ep-siki ente nek-ev-aik etav-enkot nenyoty nem nen-esneyo.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛ ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲉⲛⲕⲟⲧ ⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲧⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲛⲁϩϯ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲏⲅⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛ ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲁⲕⲱⲛ:
rows.en: Pray for our fathers and our brethren who have fallen asleep and reposed in the faith of Christ since the beginning, our saintly fathers the archBishops, our fathers the Bishops, our fathers the hegomens, our fathers the priests, our brethren
rows.cop_lat: Tovh ejen nenyoty nem nen esneyo etavenkot av-emton emmooo khen efnahti em-piEkhristos is-jen epeneh : nenyoty ethouab en-archi-epis-kopos : ke nenyoty en episkopos : nenyoty en hi-ghomenos ke nenyoty em epresviteros nem nen esneyo en-ziakon :

rows.cop: ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲓⲕⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲡⲁⲩⲥⲓⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲥ: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ϯ ⲙ̀ⲧⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩ ⲯ̀ⲩⲭⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲓⲥⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ: ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ⲇⲉ ϩⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲉⲣ ⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: the deacons, our fathers the monks, and our fathers the laymen, and for the full repose of the Christians, that Christ our God may repose all their souls in the Paradise of joy, and we too, accord mercy unto us, and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: nenyoty em-monakhos : kenenyoty en-laykos : nem e-ehri ejen ti anapav-sees ters ente niekhristianos : hina ente pi-Ekhristos Pennoty ti-emton en-no epsishi tiro khen pi paradisos ente ep-onof : anon ze hon entef-er pi nai neman : entef kanenovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Graciously O Lord, repose all their souls in the bosom of our saintly fathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Sustain them in green pasture, by the

water of rest, in the Paradise of joy; the place out of which grief, sorrow and groaning have fled away, in the light of Your saints. Raise up their bodies also, on the day which You have appointed, according to Your true promises, which are without lie. Grant them the good things of Your promises, that which an eye has not seen nor heard, nor have entered the heart of man, the things which You, O God, have prepared for those that love Your holy Name.

For there is no death for Your servants, but a departure, and if any negligence or heedlessness has overtaken them as men, when they were clothed in flesh and dwelt in this world, do O God, as a good One and lover of mankind, grant O Lord Your servants the Orthodox Christians, who are in the whole world, from sunrise to sunset and from north to south, each one by his name and each one by her name, O Lord repose and forgive them.

For no one is pure from blemish even though his life on earth is a single day. As for them, O Lord, whose souls You have taken, repose them, and may they be worthy of the Kingdom of Heaven. As for us all, grant us our Christian perfection that would be pleasing to You, and give them, and us, a share and an inheritance with all Your saints.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Lord, by Your grace, protect us this night from sin. You are the blessed God of our fathers, Your holy Name is full of glory forever. Amen. Lord, let Your mercy on us, be as great as our reliance on You, because all eyes are focused upon You. You give us food in due time.

Hear us, our Lord and Saviour, because You are the hope of the world, You alone are able to protect and save us from this generation and even unto eternity. Amen. Blessed are You, O Lord, teach me Your justice, show me Your will, enlighten me to Your goodness. Your mercy is everlasting, do not reject what You have made with Your own hands because You are my refuge from generation to generation.

I cried to the Lord: “I have sinned against You, have mercy upon me and save my soul.” Save me Lord, for I am seeking You. Teach me to do Your will, for You are my Lord, You have the spring of life, through Your light we see light, let Your mercy come to those who know You and Your goodness to those who are pure in heart.

Blessing, praise and glory are due to You, O Father and Son and Holy Spirit, who is being since the beginning, now and forever. Amen. It is good to confess to the Lord and to praise Your name, O Most High, Your mercy is declared in the mornings and Your justice every night. (Continue with The Trisagion : Page : 22)
MORNING INCENSE
(Except Saturdays) PRIEST :
Again let us ask God the Almighty, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour, Jesus Christ. We ask and entreat Your goodness, O lover of mankind, remember, O Lord, those of Your people who are sick.
rows.cop_lat: Palin on marenti-ho e-Efnoty piPantokrator : Efyot em- Penchoise owoh Pennoty owoh Pensoteer Isous pi-Ekhristos. Ten-ti-ho owoh tentovh en-tek- met-aghathos pimairomi. Ari ef meve-e Epchoise enni-et shoni ente pekla-os.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛ ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲛⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ϫⲓⲛϣⲱⲛⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲓ̀ⲧⲉ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲁⲓ ⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲓ̀ⲧⲉ ϧⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray for our fathers and our brethren who are sick with any kind of illness, whether in this place or in any place, that Christ our God may grant us, and them, health and healing, and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Tovh ejen nenyoty nem nen esneyo etshoni khen gin-shoni niven : ite khen paitopos ite khen mai niven : hina ente piEkhristos Pennoty erehmot nan nemo-oo em pi-o-gai nem pitalet-sho : entef ka nenovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Visit them, O Lord with mercies and compassion, and heal them. Remove away from them and us all illness and all maladies, the spirit of illness chase away. Those who have long lain in sickness raise up and comfort. All those who are afflicted by unclean spirits, set them all free.

Those who are in prisons or dungeons, and those who are exile or captivity, or those who are held in bitter bondage, O Lord, set them all free and have mercy on them. For You are He who looses the bound and uplifts the fallen, the hope of those who have no hope and the help of those who have no helper, the comfort of the fainthearted, the harbor of those in the storm.

All souls whom are distressed or bound, grant them mercy, O Lord, grant them rest, grant them salvation, grant them the forgiveness of their sins and iniquities. As for us also, O Lord, the maladies of our souls heal, and those of our bodies too, do cure. O You, the true Physician of our souls and our bodies, the provider for all flesh, visit us with Your salvation.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: On Weekdays (except fast days) & when the oblations are not present :
We ask entreat Your goodness O lover of mankind, remember, O Lord, our fathers and our brethren who are travelling.
rows.cop_lat: Tenti-ho owoh tentovh en-tek metaghathos pi-mairomi. Ari ef meve-e Epchoise enen-yoty nem nen esneyo etav-she e-epshem-mo.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛ ⲥ̀ⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩϣⲉ ⲉ̀ ⲡ̀ϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ: ⲓⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲉ̀ϣⲉ ϧⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲓⲧⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ⲓⲉ ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲓⲉ ⲛⲓⲗⲩⲙⲛⲏ ⲓⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲓⲉ ⲉⲩ ⲓ̀ⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩϫⲓⲛⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲧ̀ⲁⲥⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲏ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲟⲩⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray for our fathers and our brethren who are traveling, and those who intend to travel anywhere, ease all their ways whether by sea, rivers, lakes, roads, air, or those who are traveling by any other means, that Christ our God may bring them back to their own homes in peace, and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Tovh ejen nenyoty nem nen esneyo etavshe e-epshem-mo : ieni-eth-mev-ee eshe khen mai niven : soton no moyt tiro : ite evol heeten efiom ie niyaro-oo : ie ni-lim-ni ie ni-moyt em-moshi ie ev-iri em-po-gin-moshi enrity niven : hina ente pi-Ekhristos Pennoty etas-to-o eni ete no-oo em-ma-enshopi khen o-hirini : entef ka nenovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: And those who intend to travel anywhere, ease the ways of everyone, whether by sea, rivers, lakes, roads, air, or those who are traveling by any other means, everyone anywhere. Lead them to a calm and a safe haven. Graciously accompany them in their embarkation and be their companion in their travel.

Bring them back to their own, rejoicing with joy and safe in security. Participate in work with Your servants in every good deed. As for us, O Lord, our sojourn in this life keep without harm, without storm and undisturbed to the end.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: PRIEST : ( Sundays & feast days (in place of Travellers) and whenever the oblations are present.)
We ask and entreat Your goodness, O lover of mankind, remember O Lord, the sacrifices, the oblations and the thanksgivings of those who have offered honour and glory to Your Holy Name.
rows.cop_lat: Tenti ho owoh tentovh en-tek metaghathos pi-mairomi. Ari ef meve-e Epchoise enni thi-seya nivepros-fora ni-shep-ehmot ente ni etav-er-eprosferin e-o-taio nem o-oo em-pekran ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϥⲓ ⲙ̀ ⲫ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩϣ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲑⲩⲥⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲫⲟⲣⲁ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲉϩ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲛⲓ ⲥ̀ⲕⲉⲡⲁⲥⲙⲁ ⲛⲓϫⲱⲙ ⲛ̀ⲱϣ ⲛⲓⲕⲩⲙⲓⲗⲗⲓⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉⲣϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ϯϣⲉⲃⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲓⲣⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲏⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray for those who have care for the sacrifices, oblations, first fruits, oils, incense, coverings, reading books and altar vessels, that Christ our God may reward them in the heavenly Jerusalem, and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Tovh ejen ni-etfi em efro-osh enni-thi-seya ni epros-fora ni-aparshi nieneh ni estoi-nofi ni eske-pazma nigom en-osh ni-ki-miliyon ente pima en-er-sho-oshi : hina ente pi-Ekhristos Pennoty tishe-veyo no-oo khen Yerosalem ente etfe : entef ka nenovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Accept them to Yourself upon Your holy, rational altar of Heaven, for a savor of incense before Your greatness in the heavens, through the service of Your pure angels and archangels. As You have accepted the offerings of the righteous Abel, the sacrifice of our father Abraham and the two mites of the widow, so also receive the offering of thanksgiving of Your servants, those in abundance or those in scarcity, hidden or manifest.

Those who desire to offer You but have none, and those who have offered these gifts to You this day, give them the incorruptible instead of the corruptible, the heavenly instead of the earthly and the eternal instead of the temporal.

Fill their houses and their stores, with every good thing. Surround them, O Lord, by the power of Your pure angels and archangels. As they have remembered Your holy Name on earth, remember them also, O Lord, in Your Kingdom, and in this age too, do not forsake them.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: THE GLORIA
[Morning Incense]

Let us praise with the angels, saying, “glory to God in the highest, peace on earth, and goodwill toward men.” We praise You, we bless You, we serve You, we worship You, we confess You, we proclaim Your glory, we

give thanks to You for Your great glory, O Lord, who reigns upon the Heavens, God the Father, the Almighty, O Lord, the only begotten Son, Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit. O Lord God, lamb of God, Son of the Father, who takes away the sin of the world, have mercy upon us, accept our supplications. O You who sits at the right hand of the Father have mercy on us.

For You alone are Holy, You alone are the Most High, my Jesus Christ, and the Holy Spirit, glory to God the Father, Amen. Every day I bless You, and I praise Your Holy Name, forever, Amen. Since the night my soul awakes early to You, O my God, for Your commandments are light upon the earth. Continually I pursue Your ways for You have become my help. In the morning, O Lord, You shall hear my voice. Tomorrow, I will stand before You, and You will see me.
[Evening Incense]

Lord, by Your grace protect us this night from sin. You are the blessed God of our fathers. Your Holy Name is full of glory forever. Amen. Let Your mercy on us, be as great as our reliance on You, because all eyes are gazing with hope towards You. You give us food in due season.

Hear us, our Lord and Saviour, because You are the hope of the world, You alone are able to protect us from this generation and even unto eternity, Amen. Blessed are You, Lord, teach me Your justice. Show me Your will, enlighten me to Your goodness. Your mercy is everlasting. Do not reject what You have made with Your own hands because You are my refuge from generation to generation.

I cried to the Lord : “I have sinned against You, have mercy upon me and save my soul.” Save me Lord, for I am seeking You. Teach me to do Your will, for You are my Lord, You have the spring of life, through Your light we see light, let Your mercy come to those who know You and Your goodness to those who are pure in heart.

Blessing, praise and glory are due to You, O Father and Son and Holy Spirit who has been since the beginning, now and forever. Amen. It is good to confess to the Lord and praise Your Name. O most High, Your mercies are declared in the morning and Your justice every night.
THE TRISAGION

Holy God, holy Almighty, Holy Immortal, who was born of the virgin, have mercy upon us. Holy God, holy Almighty, Holy Immortal, who was crucified for us, have mercy upon us. Holy God, holy Almighty, Holy Immortal, who arose from the dead and ascended into the heavens, have mercy upon us.

Glory be to the Father, to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and forever more Amen. O Holy Trinity have mercy upon us. O Holy Trinity have mercy upon us. O Holy Trinity have mercy upon us. O Lord, forgive us our sins. O Lord, forgive us our trespasses. O Lord, forgive us our transgressions. O God, be with those who are sick, cure them for the sake of Your Holy Name.

May You, O Lord repose the souls of those who have passed over to You. O Lord, who is without fault, have mercy upon us, support us and accept our prayers, for glory, honour, dominion and worship are due to You. Lord have mercy, Lord have mercy, Lord bless us. Amen. And make us worthy to pray thankfully, Our Father…
HAIL TO YOU

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲉⲑⲙⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ϯⲙⲁⲥⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: + Hail to Saint Mary, full of grace, the evervirgin, mother of God, mother of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne ten-te-ho ero : O thi ethouab eth-meh enoo : etoy em-parthenos en-seyo niven : te-masnoty ethmav em piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ: ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ϩⲁ ⲡⲉϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: May you lift our prayers to Your beloved Son to forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ani-owee en-ten epros evke : e-epshoy ha-peshiri em-menreet : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: HAIL TO YOU

rows.cop: entef ka nen novee nan evol. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅. Ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ. Ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ⲙ: ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲧⲣⲱⲙⲓ. Ⲁⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ:
rows.en: + Hail to the Holy virgin : mother of the True Light : Christ our Lord : the holy virgin. May You ask our Lord : to have mercy : upon our souls : and forgive us our sins. + O virgin Mary : mother of God : who pleads for : all mankind. Pray for the forgiveness :
rows.cop_lat: Shere thi-etas-misi nan : em-pi o-oyni en taefme : pi-Ekhristos Pennoty : ti-parthenos ethouab. Mati-ho em-Epetchoise e-ehre egon : entef ero-nai nem nen ep-sekee : entef ka nen novee nan evol. Ti parthenos Mariam : tiTheo-tokos ethouab : ti epros-tatees eten-hot : ente ep-genos ente ti-metromy.

rows.cop: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟϥ: ϩⲟⲡⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲱⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ. Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: of our sins : before Christ to whom : you gave birth. + Hail to you O virgin : the true queen indeed : hail to the pride of our race : who bore for us Emmanuel. We ask you, remember us : O faithful advocate : before our Lord Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ari epresvavin e-ehri egon : nahren Pi-Ekristos fe etar-eg-fof : hopos entef er-eh-mot nan : em pi-ko evol ente nen novee. Shere ne o tiparthenos : ti oro emmi en alithini : shere ep-shosho ente pen-genos : ari egfo nan en-Emmanoeel. Ten-ti ho ari-pen-meve : o-ti epros-ta-tis eten hot : nahren Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos :

rows.en: INTRODUCTION TO THE CREED
We honour you, mother of True Light, and praise you, O Holy virgin mother of God, for you gave birth to our Saviour. He came and redeemed our souls.

Glory to you, our Master and King Jesus Christ, pride of the apostles, Crown of martyrs, joy of the righteous, Sustainance of the Church, Remission of sins. We preach the Holy Trinity, the One Divinity, whom we worship and honour. Lord have mercy, Lord have mercy, Lord bless us. Amen. THE CREED

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁϩϯ ⲉ̀ ⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ: Ⲫϯ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉ ⲛ̀ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ. Ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁϩϯ ⲉ̀ ⲟⲩϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ϧⲁⲅⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ:
rows.en: We believe in One God, the Almighty God the Father, maker of Heaven and earth, of all things visible and invisible. We believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ the only begotten Son of the Father, before all ages;
rows.ar_lat: N’omen be Ellahen wahed. Allahu alAab dabet al-kol, khalek al-sama wal ard, ma-yora wa mala-yora. No’men be-Raben wahed Yassoua alMassieh. Ebn Allah al-Waheed, almawlood men alAab kabla kol eldehoor. Noor men noor, Ellah hak men Ellah hak.
rows.cop_lat: Tennahty e onoty enn-o-ot : Efnoty Efyot pi-pantokrator fi etaf-thamyo enetfe nem epkahy ni eto-nav ero-oo nem ni-ete en-senav eroo an. Tenahty e-oetchois en-o-oot Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty pi-monogenees : pimisi evol khen Efyot khaga-oo eni e-oon tiro : o-oiny evol khen o-oiny :

rows.cop: ⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲟⲩⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲟⲩⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ ⲁⲛ ⲡⲉ: ⲟⲩⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁ ϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲓⲧⲟⲧϥ. Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲉⲑⲃⲏⲧⲉⲛ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓ ⲡⲛⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
rows.en: light out of light, true God out of true God, begotten not made; co-essential with the Father, through whom all things came into being. He descended from Heaven for us and for our salvation, and was incarnated of the Holy Spirit and of the virgin Mary, and became man.
rows.ar_lat: Mawlood ghayr makhlook, mesawy al-Aab fi algawhar, allazy behy kana kol shay’e. Haza allazy men galena nahno al-bashar wa men agel khalasena nazalla men alsama’, wa tagasada men al-Roh elKodoss wa men Mariam al-‘Azra’ wa ta-annas.
rows.cop_lat: onoty enta efmi evol khen onoty enta efmi : omisi oe othamyo an pe : o omoseyos pe nem Efyot fi etahob niven shopi evol hitotf. Fay ete ethviten anon kha niromi nem ethve pen-ogay : af-ee epesit evol khen etfe af-etchi-sarex evol khen pi Epnevma Ethouab nem evol khen Maria tiparthenos owoh afer-romi.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲱⲛⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉϩ ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲟⲛⲧⲓⲟⲥ Ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲁϥϣⲉⲡⲉⲙⲕⲁϩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲕⲟⲥϥ. Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϩ ⲅ̅ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲅ̀ⲣⲁⲫⲏ. Ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲟ̀ⲓ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ. Ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉϥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϯϩⲁⲡ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ:
rows.en: He was crucified for us at the time of Pontius Pilate,He suffered and was buried; arose from the dead on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures. He ascended to the heavens and sat at the right hand of His Father; He shall also come back in His glory to judge the living and the dead;
rows.ar_lat: Wa soliba ‘ana ‘ala ahed Bilates alBonty, ta-allam wa kober, wa kama men al-amwat fi alyawm el-thaleth kama fi al-koteb. Wa sa’ada illa alsamawat wa galasa ‘an yameen Abeeh. Wa aydan ya’aty fi magdehy le yodeena al-ahya’ wal-wamwat, allazy laysa le molkehy enkeda.
rows.cop_lat: Owoh aver estavronin emmof e-ehri egon nahren Pntios Pilatos : af-shep emkah owoh av-kosf. Owoh aftonf evol khen ni-ethmooot khen pi eho-oo emmah shomt kata ni egrafee. Afshenaf e epshoi en-nifiowi : afhemsi sa-owi nam em-pefyot. Ke palin ef neyo khen pef o-oo eti-hap e ni-etonkh nem ni ethmo-ot :

rows.cop: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲟⲩⲁⲑⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ ⲧⲉ. Ⲥⲉ ⲧⲁⲛⲛⲁϩϯ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓ ⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥϯ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ: ⲥⲉⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲥⲉϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ. Ⲉ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏ ⲛ̀ⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀. Ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲛ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲙⲥ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: of whose Kingdom there will be no end. Truly we believe in the Holy Spirit, the life giving Lord, who proceeds from the Father, we worship and glorify Him together with the Father and the Son, who spoke in the prophets. And in one, holy, universal and Apostolic Church. We acknowledge one baptism for the remission of sins.
rows.ar_lat: Na’am no’men belRoh el-Koddoss alRabu al-Mohee almonbathek men-alAab, nasgud Lahu wa nomagedahu ma’a al-Aab walEbn, al-natek fi-alanbeya’a. wa bekaneesa waheda mokadassa game’a rasoleya. Wa na’ataref be ma’amodeya waheda le maghferat alkhataya.
rows.cop_lat: fi ete tefmet-oro o athmonk te. Se tenahty epi Epnevma Ethouab Epetchoise enrefty am ep-onkh fi ethneyo evol khen Efyot : se o-osht emmof sety-oo naf nem Efyot nem Epshiri : fi etafsaji khen ni eprofitees. Eowi en agia en katholiki en apostoliki en ekekleesia. Tener omologeen en-omos en-o-oot e-epko evol ente nen novee.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ϩⲓ ⲛ̀ϯ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁ̀ⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥ ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: And we look to the resurrection of the dead and the life of the world to come. Amen.
rows.ar_lat: Wa nantazeroo keyamat el-amwat, wa hayat el-dahr el-aaty Amen.
rows.cop_lat: Ten gosht evol kha ethi enti anastasis ente ni-ref mo-ot : nem pi onkh ente pi e-oon ethneyo : Amen.

rows.en: God, have mercy upon us. your mercy upon us. compassion upon us.
rows.ar_lat: Settle Have
rows.cop_lat: Efnoty nai nan. The-sho Shen heet kharon. nai eron.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ
rows.en: Amen.
Hear us.
rows.cop_lat: Sotem eron.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ
rows.en: Amen.
Bless us, guard us, help us.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo eron, areh eron, ari-voi-thin eron.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ
rows.en: Amen.
Take away Your anger from us. Visit us with Your salvation, and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Oli em pek gont evol haron : jem pen shini khen pek ogay : owoh ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲕⲉ̅ Ⲕⲉ̅ Ⲕⲉ̅.
rows.en: Amen. Lord have mercy. (x3)
rows.ar_lat: Amen. Yarabu erham (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Amen.Kiriye eleyson. (x3)

rows.en: LITANY OF THE GOSPEL

rows.cop: Ϣⲗⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Eshleel.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲡⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲕⲏ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲑⲏⲧⲉ.
rows.en: Stand prayer.
rows.ar_lat: up
rows.cop_lat: for Lel sala kefu. Epi epros-evki es-ta-thite.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲡⲁⲥⲓ.
rows.en: Peace be with you all.
rows.ar_lat: Al-salam le game-akom.
rows.cop_lat: Irini Pasi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲥⲟⲩ. ⲧⲱⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ
rows.en: And you.
rows.ar_lat: also
rows.cop_lat: with Wa ma’a roheka aydan. Ke to epnevmati so.

rows.en: O Master and Lord, Jesus Christ, our God, who told His holy and honoured disciples and pure apostles that many prophets and righteous men earnestly desired to see what you are now seeing but they could not;
rows.ar_lat: Ayoha al-Sayed al-Rabu Yasoua el-Massieh Elahona, allazy khataba talamizaho al-kedeseen wa roselhi al-at-har almokarameena ka-elan, enna anbeya-an wa abraran kathireen eshtahu an yaru ma antom taruna walam yaru wa an yasma-au ma antum tasma-oon wa lam yasma-au.
rows.cop_lat: Efneeb Epetchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos Pennoty : fi etaf-gos en-nef-agios ettayot em-mathitees owoh en-apostolos ethouab je hanmish emeprofitees nem hanethmi aver-e-pithimin enav eni etetenav ero-oo owoh em-ponav :

rows.en: and to hear what you are now listening to but they could not. Blessed are your eyes for they can see, and your ears for they can hear. Grant that we become eligible to hear and perform according to Your holy Gospels, through the petitions of Your Saints.
rows.ar_lat: Amma antum fa-tuba lea’ayonekom le anaha tobsir wa le azanikom le anaha tasma’a. Falnastahik an nasma’a wa na’amala be anagelika al-mokadasa be telbat kedeseek.
rows.cop_lat: owoh esotem eni etetensotem ero-oo owoh em-posotem. En-thotem ze ooniyato en-netenval je senav : nem netenmashg je se-sotem. Maren-erep-em-epsha ensotem owoh e-eri en-nek-ev angelion ethouab khen ni toveh ente ni ethouab entak.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲡⲉⲣ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ ⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Pray for hearing of Holy Gospel.
rows.ar_lat: the the
rows.cop_lat: Salu men agl alEngeel almokadass. Epros evek-saste iper-to agio evangelio.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Remember, O Lord, those who have asked us to remember them in our supplications and petitions that we offer You, O Lord, our God. Repose the souls of those who have preceded us in departure, and heal those who are sick, for You are the life of us all, the salvation of us all, the hope of us all, the healing of us all and the resurrection of us all.
rows.ar_lat: Ozkor aydan ya Sayedana kol alazeena amaroona wa awsuna an nazkorahum fi tadaru-atina watelbatena allaty narfa’aha elayka ayoha al-Rabu Ellahona. Allazina sabaku farakadu, Yarab nayehahum, al-marda eshfeehom. Le Anaka Anta howa hayatna kolena, wa khalasona kolena, wa raga-ona kolena, wa shefa-ona kolena, wa keyamatona kolena.
rows.cop_lat: Ari-efmevi ze on pennib eno-on niven etav-hon-hen nan eerpo-mevi khen nentiho nem nentovh eteniri emo-oo eepshoi harok Epchoise Pennoty. Ni etavershorp e-nenkot ma-emton no-oo : ni etshoni metal-echo-o. Je enthok ghar pe penonkh tiro : nem penogay tiro : nem tenhelpis tiro : nem pental-echo tiro : nem ten-anastasis tiren.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia.
Stand up in the fear of God, and listen to the Holy Gospel.
rows.cop_lat: Estathite meta vovu Theo, akosomen to agio evangeleyo.

rows.en: Blessed is He who comes in the Name of God. O God bless the chapter from the Holy Gospel according to Saint (Mathew/Mark/ Luke/ John)
rows.cop_lat: Efesmaro-ot enje fi ethneyo khen Efran em Epetchoise ente ni gom. Kiriye evlogison ekto kata (Mathe-on/Markon/ Lukan/Yo-anen) agio evangeleyo to anagh-nosma.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁⲥⲓ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀.
rows.en: Glory be to You O God.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxasi kiriye.

rows.en: THE GOSPEL
Stand up in the fear of God, and listen to the Holy Gospel, a chapter from the Holy Gospel according to Saint (Mathew/Mark/Luke/ John) the evangelist, apostle and pure disciple may His blessings.
rows.ar_lat: Kefu be makhafet Allah wa ensetu le sama’a al-Engeel al-mokadass, faslon men besharat al Angeel le mo’alemna Mari (Matta/Morkos/Lu’ka/ Yohanna) albasheer, wa altelmeez al-taher, barakatahu.

rows.en: Be with us all.
rows.ar_lat: A’alla game’ana.

rows.en: A Psalm of our teacher David the prophet and king may his blessings.
rows.ar_lat: Men mazameer tarateel mo’alemna Dawood al-naby wal-malek barakatahu.

rows.en: Be with us all.
rows.ar_lat: A’alla game’ana.

rows.en: (The Psalm)
rows.ar_lat: (El Mazmoor)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia.
Blessed is He who comes in the Name of the Lord, O Lord, God, Saviour and King of us all Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God, glory be to You.
rows.ar_lat: Mubarak howa al-aaty be-esm al-Rab, Rabana wa Ellahona wa mokhalesna wa malekna kollena Yasoua al-Massieh ebn Allah el ‘hay’e. Allazy lahu al-magd aldaemu.

rows.en: Forever Amen.
rows.cop_lat: Ellal abad. Amen.

rows.en: (The Gospel)
rows.ar_lat: (El Engeel)

rows.en: Glory be to God Forever.
rows.cop_lat: Wal magdu lellahy dae-man.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ϧⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Let us worship our Saviour : The lover of mankind : For He had compassion on us : And came and saved us.
rows.cop_lat: Maren-o-osht empensoteer : pi-mairomi en-aghathos : je enthof af-shenheet kharon : af-ee owoh af-soty emmon.

rows.en: Responses for Saint Mary & other saints may be recited, then continue with:

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Blessed is the Father the Son : and the Holy Spirit : the perfect Trinity : we worship and glorify.
rows.cop_lat: Je ef-ezmaro-ot enje Efyot nem Ep-shiri : nem pi Epnevma ethouab : ti etrias etjik evol : ten-o-osht emmos ten-ti o-onas.

rows.en: (Concluding Prayer: Page 97)
THE THREE MAJOR LITANIES
Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Eshleel.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲡⲓ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲓⲑⲉ. ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉ̀ⲩⲕⲓ
rows.en: Stand prayer.
rows.ar_lat: up
rows.cop_lat: for Lel sala kefu. Epi epros-evki es-ta-thite.

rows.en: Peace be with you all.
rows.ar_lat: Al-salam le gameakom.
rows.cop_lat: Irini Pasi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲧⲟ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ϯ ⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: And also with you.
rows.cop_lat: Ke to epnevmati so.

rows.en: Again let us ask God the Pantokrator, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ. We ask and entreat Your goodness, O lover of mankind, remember O Lord, the peace of Your one, holy, universal and apostolic Orthodox Church of God.
rows.ar_lat: Wa aydan falnas-al Allah dabet al-kol Abba Rabana wa Elahona wa mokhalesna Yasoua elMassieh. Nas-al wa natlob men salahika ya moheb al-bashar, ozkor Yarab salam kanisatika al-wahida al wahida al mokadasa al-game’a al rasoleya.
rows.cop_lat: Palin on maren-tiho eEfnoty pi-pantokrator : Efyot em-Penchoise owoh Pennnoty owoh Pensoteer Isous piEkhristos. Tentiho owoh ten-toveh en-tek-metaghathos pi-mairomi. Ariefmev-ee Epetchoise enti-hirini ente tekowi emmavats ethouab enkatholiki en-apostoliki en-ek-ekleseya.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲡⲉⲣ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲏⲛⲏⲥ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁⲥ ⲙⲟⲛⲏⲥ ⲕⲁⲑⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏⲥ ⲟⲣⲑⲟⲇⲟⲝⲟⲩ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲑⲉⲟⲩ ⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Pray for the peace of the One, Holy, universal and apostolic Orthodox church of God.
rows.ar_lat: Salu men agl al waheda al wahida al-mokadassa algame’a al-rasoleya kaneesaat Allah elOrthozoxeya.
rows.cop_lat: Epros eveksaste eper tees ereenees tis agias monees katholikees ke apostolikees Orthozoxo to Theo ekekliseyas.

rows.en: That which exists from one end of the world to the other. Remember O Lord, our Patriarch, the honoured Father, the high priest Abba (…..) and for his partner in the apostolic ministry the Bishop Abba (…..).

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲡⲉⲣ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲱⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲟⲩ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲙⲉⲅⲁⲗⲟ ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲑⲥ Ⲁⲗⲉⲝⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲕⲉϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲗⲓⲧⲟⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲟ̀ⲣⲑⲟⲇⲟⲝⲱⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲱⲛ.
rows.en: Pray for our Pontiff, Pope Abba (…..), Patriarch and Lord archBishop of the great city of Alexandria, and his partner in the apostolic ministry the Bishop Abba (…..) and for our Orthodox Bishops.
rows.ar_lat: Salu men agl ra-ees kahanatena al-baba al mo’azem alAnba (…) : baba wa patriark wa raees asakefat almadeena al-‘ozma al-Eskandereya wa shareekahi fe el khedma al rasoleya al-Anba (…) : wa sa-er asakefatena al-Orthozoxeyeen.
rows.cop_lat: Epros-evek-saste iper to archi ere-os emon papa ava (…..) : papa ke patriarkho ke arshi episkopotees meghalo pole-os Alexandrias nem pefke eshfir enlitorghos enapostolikos penyot ethouab ava (…..) : ke ton orthozoxon imon episkopon.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: In keeping, keep him unto us for many years and peaceful times. Remember O Lord, the safety of this holy place, which is Yours, and every place, and every monastery of our Orthodox fathers.
rows.cop_lat: Ari efmevee Epetchoise enetsotereya em-paytopos ethouab entak fay. Nem topos niven : nem monastireyon niven ente nenyoty en Orthozoxos.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲡⲉⲣ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲱⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲧⲁⲩⲧⲏⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲥⲱⲛ ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲭⲱⲣⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲛⲏⲥⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲙⲟⲛⲁⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲱⲛ.
rows.en: Pray for the safety of the world, and for our city and all the cities, districts, islands and monasteries.
rows.ar_lat: Salu men agl khalas el-’alam wa madinatina hazihi wa sa-er el-modon walakaleem walgaza’er waladyera.
rows.cop_lat: Epros eveksaste iper tees sotireyas to kosmo ke tees pole-os immon tavtees ke pason pole-on ke ton khoron ke nison ke monastireyon.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: And every city, and every region, and the villages and all their ornaments. And save us all from famine, plagues, earthquakes, drowning, fire, the captivity of the barbarians, the sword of the stranger and the rising up of heretics.
rows.cop_lat: Nem polees niven : nem khora niven : nem ni-timi : nem po-sol-sel tirf. Owoh nah-men tiren evol ha o-eh-von nem omo-o nem o-mon-men nem o- kata-pontis-mos nem o-ekrom nem o-ekhmalo-sia ente han-barbaros : nem evol ha et-sifi ente pi shemmo nem evol ha epgin-tonf e-epshoi ente han- here- ti-kos.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Graciously, O Lord, bless the land plantations, trees, crops, and the fruits of the earth, the winds, the rains and the waters of the rivers, this year.
rows.ar_lat: Wal sakeneena fiha be eman Ellah. Tafadal Yarab ahweyat al-sama-e wa thamarat al-ard wa meyah el-anhar, wal zeroo’e wal-’oshb, wa nabat al-hakl fi hazihy alsana barek-ha.
rows.cop_lat: Ari kataxeyon Epetchoise ni en-aier ente etfe nem ni karpos ente ep-kahi nem ni mo-oo ente efi-aro nem ni sity nem ni-sim nem ni-roti ente et-koy : et khen tai-rompi thai : esmo ero-oo.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓ ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫ̀ⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲕⲟⲓ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲁⲓⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲁ̀ϣⲁⲓ ϣⲁⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲅⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ϧⲁⲡⲉϥⲡ̀ⲗⲁⲥⲙⲁ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ ⲛⲉϥϫⲓϫ ⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray for the plants, the vegetation, crops, vines and all the fruit-bearing trees in the whole world, the winds of the heavens, the rains and the fullness of the rivers this year. That Jesus Christ our Lord may bless them and raise them to their measure, grant a cheerful touch to the land, support the human beings, save the cattle and forgive us our sins.
rows.ar_lat: Otlobu ‘an ahweyat al-sama’e wa thamarat al-ard wa se-’ood meyah alanhar wal zero-o wal ‘oshb wa nabat al-hakl fi hazihy alsana, lekay yobarikuha al Massieh Ellahona letanmu wa takthur illa an takmul be thamaraten ‘azima, wa yatahanan ‘alla goblatehi allaty sana’ataha yadah, wa yaghfer lana khatayana.
rows.cop_lat: Tovh ejen ni-a-er ente etfe nem ni karpos ente epkahi nem ni mo-o ente efiaro nem ni siti nem ni sim nem ni rot ente et koy hina ente pi-Ekhristos Pennoty esmo eroo ento ay-ay owoh ento ashay sha ento-gok evol khen onishty en karpos owoh en tef-shenheet kha pef eplazma eta nef jig thameyof : entef ka nenovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ (x3)
rows.en: Lord have mercy (x3)
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson (x3)

rows.en: Bring them up to their measure according to Your grace, that it may be ready for seeding and harvesting. Accord, O Lord, a cheerful touch unto the earth, water it and dispose our life as deemed fit. Crown this year with Your goodness, for the sake of the poor of Your people, the widow, the orphan, the stranger and for our sake.
rows.ar_lat: Es’edha ka-mekdareha kane’amatek. Farreh wagh el-ard le yorwa harthoha wal takthur athmaroha. A-’edaha lel zar’e wal hassad wa dabber hayatana kama yaleek. Barek ekleel el sana be-salahek, men agl fokara’e sha’ebek, men agl el-armala wal yateem, wal ghareeb, wal deyf. Wa men aglena kolena nahnu allazina nargoka wa natlob esmok alKoddous.
rows.cop_lat: Anito e-Epshoy kata noshi kata fi ete fook en ehmot ma ep-onof em epho em- epkahy marothikhi enje nef- ethlom maro a-shay enje nef otah. Sebtotf e-o egrog nem o-oskh : owoh ari oykonomeen em-penjin onkh kata peternofry. Esmo epi eklom ente ti rompi heeten tekmet Ekhristos ethve nihiki ente pekla-os : ethve tishira nem pi orfanos nem pi-shemmo nem pi remengoily :

rows.en: For our eyes are focused upon You, our hope, and seek Your Holy Name. You provide our food in due course. Deal with us according to Your goodness, You the feeder of everybody. Fill our hearts with joy and grace that as we always have sufficiency of all things, we grow in every good deed.
rows.ar_lat: Le-anna a’eyon el-koli tata-ragaka, le annaka anta allazy to’atehum ta-’aamahum fi heenen hasan. Esna’a ma’ana hasab salahek ya mo’eteyan ta-a’aman le koli gasad. Emla’ kolubana farahan wa naeeman, lekay nahnu aydan ez yakoona lana alkafaf fi kol shay-en koli heenen nazdada fi koli ‘amalen saleh.
rows.cop_lat: nem ethvi-ten tiren kha ni-et er-helpees erok : owoh etoveh empekran ethouab. Ji nenval eno-o-oon niven se-erhelpees erok je enthok ety ento-ekhri nooo khen o-seyo enanef. Ari-owi neman kata tekmet-aghathos : fi ety ekhri en sarex niven moh en-enheet en-rashi nem oonof, hina anon hon eri ef-roshy en-toten khen hob niven enseyo niven : enten er-ho-o khen hob niven en agathon.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Again let us ask God the Pantokrator, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ. We ask and entreat Your goodness, O lover of mankind, remember O Lord, our gatherings, bless them.
rows.ar_lat: Wa aydan falnas-al Allah dabet al-kol Abba Rabana wa Elahona wa mokhalesna Yasoua el-Massieh. Nas-al wa natlob men salahika ya moheb albashar, ozkor Yarab ektema’atena barekha.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲡⲉⲣ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁⲥ ⲧⲁⲩⲧⲏⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲥⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲩⲥⲉⲱⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.
rows.en: Pray for this holy Church and for our gatherings.
rows.ar_lat: Salu men agl hazihy al-kaneesa al-mokadassa wa egtema’atena.
rows.cop_lat: Epros eveksasti iper tees agias ekeklisias tavtees ke ton seen-elen-se-on emon.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Grant that they may be unto us without obstacles or hindrance that we may hold them according to Your holy and blessed will. Houses of prayer, houses of purity, houses of blessing, grant them unto us, O Lord, and Your servants who shall come after us forever. The worship of idols, utterly uproot from the world. Satan and all his evil powers, trample and humiliate under our feet speedily.
rows.ar_lat: Ega’alna a’an takuna lana be-ghayr mane’a wala a’aek lenasna’aha ka mashe’atika al-mokadasa al-tobaweya. Beyout salah, beyout tahara, beyout barraka an-’em beha ‘allayna Yarab wa ‘alla abeedak al-aatien ba-adana ella alabad. Ebadat el-awthan bel-kamal eklaha mena al-a’lam. Al shaytan wa kol kuwatahu al-shereera es-hak-hom wa ‘azilahom tahta akdamena sare-an.

rows.en: All offences and their instigators, abolish. May all dissension of corrupt heresies cease. The enemies of Your Holy Church, O Lord, as at all times, now also humiliate. Strip their vanity, show them their weakness speedily.
rows.ar_lat: Al shekouk wa fa-eloha abtelhom, wal yankady efterak fassad al-bede’a. A’ada kanisatika al-mokadasa Yarab methla kol zaman wal-an azelahom.

rows.en: Bring to naught their envy, their intrigues, their madness, their wickedness and their slander which they commit against us. O Lord, bring them all to avail, disperse their counsel, O God, who dispersed the counsel of Akhithophel.
rows.ar_lat: Hel taazumihom, arrefhom da’afahom sare’an, abtel hasadahum wa sa-ayatehum wa ginoonahom wa sharahum wa namematehum allaty yasna-ounaha fina. Yarab egalhom kalahum kala she’a, wa badded mashoratihum ya Allah allazy baddada mashorat Akhitofel.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Arise, O Lord God, let all Your enemies be scattered, and let all that hate Your Holy name flee before Your face. But let Your people be in blessing thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousands doing Your holy will.
rows.ar_lat: Kum ayoha al-Rab al-Ellah, wal yatafarrak game’a a’da-ek wal yahrab men kuddam wag-hek kol mob-ghedy esmak al-Koddous. Wa amma sha’abak fal-yakun bel-baraka oluf oluf wa rebwat rebwat yasna-’ona eradatika almokaddassa.

rows.en: Our Father, who art in Heaven…
rows.ar_lat: Ya Abana allazi…
rows.cop_lat: Je Penyout et-khen nifiowi…

rows.cop: Ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅.
rows.en: Through Jesus Christ our Lord.
rows.ar_lat: Bel Massieh Yasoua Rabena.
rows.cop_lat: Khen pi-Ekhristos Isous Penchoise.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲁⲥ ⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲁⲥ ⲩ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲧⲱ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲱ̀ ⲕ̀ⲗⲓⲛⲁⲧⲉ.
rows.en: Bow Your heads before the Lord.
rows.ar_lat: Ehno ro-osakom amam al-Rab.
rows.cop_lat: Tas ke-falas emmon to Kireyo eklinate.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲛⲱⲡⲓⲟⲛ ⲥⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀.
rows.en: Before Lord.
rows.ar_lat: You,
rows.cop_lat: O Ammak khade’eana sagedeen. Yarab wa Enopiyon so Kiriye.

rows.en: PRIEST : [Concluding Prayer]

O Master, Lord Jesus Christ, the only begotten Son and Logos of God the Father, who has broken every bond of our sins through His saving, life giving sufferings; who breathed into the face of His holy disciples and saintly apostles, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit.

Those whose sins you will forgive, they are forgiven them, and those which you retain, they shall be retained.” You also now, our Master, through Your holy apostles, have given grace to those who for a time labored in the priesthood in Your holy church, to forgive sin upon the earth, and to bind and to loose ever bond of iniquity. Now, also, we ask and entreat Your goodness, O lover of mankind, for Your servants, my fathers, and my brethren, and my weakness those who bow their heads before Your holy glory.

Dispense unto us Your mercy, and loose every bond of our sins, and if we have committed any sin against You, knowingly or unknowingly, or through anguish of heart, or in deed, or in word, or from faint-heartedness, do, O Master, who knows the weakness of men, as a good and lover of mankind, O God, grant us the forgiveness of our sins;

purify us, make us absolved, and all Your people absolved. Fill us with Your fear, and straighten us unto Your holy, good will, for You are our God, and the glory, honor, dominion, and the adoration are due to You, together with Your gracious father and the Holy Spirit, the life giver, who is of one essence with You, now and at all times, and unto the age of all ages. Amen.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲕⲉ̅ Ⲕⲉ̅ Ⲕⲉ̅.
rows.en: Amen. Lord have mercy. (x3)
rows.ar_lat: Amen. Yarabu erham (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Amen.Kiriye eleyson. (x3)

rows.en: CONCLUDING PRAYER
Introduction:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀ ⲕ̀ⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ: ⲁⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Amen alleluia : glory be to the Father, and to the Son : and to the Holy Spirit : Now and forevermore : amen.
rows.cop_lat: Amen alleluia : zoxa patri ke Eyo ke Agio Epnev-mati. Ke nin ke a-e ke estos eonas ton e-onon : amen.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲱ̀Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: We cry out saying : “Our Lord Jesus Christ.”
rows.cop_lat: Ten-osh evol engo emmos : je O Penshoyse Isous pe Ekhristos.

rows.en: Standard verse: (For seasonal verses, see page 401)

rows.cop: Ⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ ⲫ̀ⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲥⲓϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓ ⲁⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Bless waters of the rivers : the seeds and the herbs : and the air of Heaven : may Your mercy and Your peace be a fortress for Your people.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo enimo-oo emefyaro : nem enisity nem nisim : nem eni-aer ente etfe mar-e peknai nem tek-hirini oy en-soft em-peklaos.

rows.en: Conclude with :

rows.cop: Ⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ**. ⲕⲩⲣⲓ̀ⲉ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏⲥⲟⲛ: ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏⲥⲟⲛ: ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲓ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲓ: ⲓⲥ ϯⲙⲉⲧⲁⲛⲟⲓⲁ̀: ⲭⲱ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Save us and have mercy**. Lord have mercy : Lord have mercy : Lord bless amen : give the blessing : we prostrate : absolve us : and give the blessing.
rows.cop_lat: Soty emmon owoh nai nan**. Kiriye eleyson : Kiriye eleyson : Kiriye evlogison amen : esmo eroi : esmo eroi : esti matanya : ko-ni evol go empi esmo.

rows.en: ** If a Pope, Metropolitan or Bishop is present, the following verses are sung :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲕϭⲓ ⲧ̀ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ: ϯⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲙⲉⲗⲭⲓⲥⲉⲇⲉⲕ ϯⲙⲉⲧϧⲉⲗⲗⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ ⲡⲓⲛⲟϫ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ϩⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲙⲁⲑⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲁ: ⲡⲓⲕⲁϯ ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ϯⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲥⲟⲗⲟⲙⲱⲛ: Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ.
rows.en: May you be bestowed the Grace of Moses, the Priesthood of Melchizedek, the old of Jacob and the long life of Metosalah, the chosen intelligence of David, the wisdom of Solomon and the Comforter Spirit that came upon the apostles.
rows.cop_lat: Aket-chee et kharis em Moysees timet oweeb ente Melchisadek : timet khello ente Yacoub pinog en-ahi ente Matosala : pikati et sotp ente David ti sofia ente Solomon : pi epnnevma emparakliton fi-etav e-ejen ni Apostolos :

rows.cop: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϥⲉ̀ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲉ̀ⲙⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ ⲡ̀ⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ / ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲏⲧⲓⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...).**
rows.en: O Lord preserve the life and the reign of our honourable father, the archBishop and Pope Abba (…..) and our father the Bishop/Metropolitan Abba (…..).**
rows.cop_lat: Epetchoise ef-e areh eeponkh nem eptaho eratf em penyot ettayot en archi erefs baba ava (…..), nem penyot en epeskopos/metropolitees ava (…..). **

rows.cop: Ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟⲩ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲓⲕⲟⲛ. Ⲛⲧⲉϥⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϫⲁϫⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϭⲁⲗⲁⲩϫ ⲛ̀ⲭⲱⲗⲉⲙ.
rows.en: May the Lord of Heaven firm him on his throne for many years and peaceful durations. Subdue all his enemies promptly under his feet quickly.
rows.cop_lat: Efnoty ente etfe ef etagroo hijen-noo ethronos : enhanmish enrompi nem han-seyo en hiriny-kon. Entef theveyo enno gaji tiro sapee seet enno etshalafg enkolem.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲉϥⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.en: Pray to Lord Christ for us that He may forgive us our sins in peace according to His great mercy.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh e pi-Ekristos e ehri egon entef kan nen novee nan evol khen o hiriny kata nefnishty ennay.

rows.en: **If more than one Bishop/Metropolitan are present, the following is recited instead of a name.

rows.cop: ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲕⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ
rows.en: who are present
rows.cop_lat: ni etki neman

rows.en: May God have compassion upon us, bless us, manifest His face upon us and have mercy upon us. Lord save Your people, bless Your inheritance, pasture them and raise them up forever. Exalt the horn of the Christians through the power of the life giving Cross, through the supplications and prayers which our lady, the lady of us all, the holy Theotokos, the mother of God, Saint Mary, makes for us,

and those of the three great holy luminaries, Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, the four Incorporeal Creatures, the twenty four priests, all the heavenly ranks, Saint John the Baptist, the hundred and forty four thousand, our Lords the fathers the apostles, the three holy youths, Saint Stephen.

The beholder of God Saint Mark the evangelist, the holy apostle and martyr Saint George, Saint Theodore, Philopateer Mercorius, Saint Mina of Fayat, Saint Demiana and the forty virgins, Saint Abanoub and the whole choir of the martyrs, our righteous father Saint Athanasius, the great Abba Anthony, the righteous Abba Paul, the three saints Abba Macarii, our father Abba John.

Our father Abba Bishoi, our father Abba Paul of Tammoh, our Roman fathers Maximos & Domadios, our father Abba Moses, the forty nine martyr and the whole choir of the cross-bearers, the just, the righteous, Anba Abraam the Bishop of El-Fayoum, all the wise virgins, the angel of this day, and the blessing of the holy Theotokos first and last, and the blessing of the Lord’s day of our Saviour. May their holy blessings, their grace, their might, their favor, their love and their help be with us all forever. Amen.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ.
rows.en: Christ our God.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-Ekhristos Pennoty.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ⲉⲥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ.
rows.en: Amen. So be it.
rows.cop_lat: Amen. Es-eshopi.

rows.en: O King of peace, grant us Your peace, confirm Your peace upon us, and forgive us our sins. For Thine is the power, the glory, the blessing and the majesty forever. Amen. O Lord make us worthy to pray thankfully:
Our Father, who art in Heaven…
rows.ar_lat: Ya Abana allazi…
rows.cop_lat: Je Penyout et-khen nifiowi…
