THE VIRGIN’S DOXOLOGY (For Morning Incense)

rows.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲥⲁⲃⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲉ ϯⲙⲁⲏⲥ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲕⲏⲛⲏ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ϩⲟ ⲙ ⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ⲧⲓⲕⲟⲙ. : : :
rows.en: + Blessed are you, O Mary : the prudent and the chaste : the second tabernacle : the spiritual treasure.
rows.cop_lat: O-oniati entho Maria : ti-savee owoh ensemne : ti-mah-esnoty en-eskini : pi-aho emEpnevmatikon.

rows.cop: Ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁⲗ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅.
rows.en: The pure turtle-dove : that declared in our land : and brought unto us : the fruit of the Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-etchrom-epshal enkatharos : thi-etasmoty khen penkahi : owoh asfiri nan evol : en-o-karpos ente Piepnevma.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉϣⲏⲣⲓ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲓⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲛⲱⲉ̀.
rows.en: + The Spirit the Comforter : who came upon your Son : on the waters of the Jordan : as in the type of Noah.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-epnevma emparakliton : fi-etaf-ee ejen pe-Shiri : hijen nimo-oo ente Piordanees : kata eptipos en-Noe.

rows.cop: Ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲥ ⲁⲥϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲛ̀ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
rows.en: For the dove which is here : has declared to us : the peace of God : which is towards mankind.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-etchrombi ghar ete em-mav : enthos ashishenofi nan : entihirini ente Efnoty : thi-etas-shopi sha niromi.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲑⲟ ϩⲱⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ: ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲧ̀ⲏⲉ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ.
rows.en: + Likewise you, O our hope : the rational turtle-dove : have brought the mercy to us : and carried Him in your womb.
rows.cop_lat: Entho hoy o-tenhelpees : ti-etchromepshal eno-ite : are-ini em-pinai nan : arefay kharof khen teneji.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅: ⲡⲓⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ: ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏϯ: ⲁϥⲉⲣ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉⲙϩⲉ.
rows.en: That is Jesus our Lord : the only begotten of the Father : was born to us of you : and set our race free.
rows.cop_lat: Ete fay pe Isous : pimisi evol khen Efyot : avmasf nan evol enkhity : afer pengenos en-remhe.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲧⲁⲟⲩⲟϥ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛ ϩⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ϣⲟⲣⲡ: ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲥ ⲟⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲛⲕⲉⲗⲁⲥ: ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Let us all declare this : first within our heart : and then with our tongues : proclaiming and saying :
rows.cop_lat: Fay ghar marenta-o-of : evol khen penheet enshorp : menensos on khen penkelas : enosh evol engo emmos.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲙⲁⲑⲁⲙⲓ̀ⲟ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲛ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲕⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲉⲩϯⲇⲟⲝⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲁⲕ.
rows.en: “O our Lord Jesus Christ : create in us for Yourself : a Sanctuary for Your Holy Spirit : ever glorifying You.”
rows.cop_lat: Je Penchoise Isous piEkhristos : mathameyo nak en-ekhri enkheeten : en-o-er-fei ente pek-Epnevma Ethouab : evtizoxologeya nak.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲱⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O virgin : the true queen indeed : hail to the pride of our race : who bore for us Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne o tiparthenos : ti oro emmi en alithini : shere ep-shosho ente pen-genos : ari egfo nan en Emmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: We ask you, remember us : O faithful advocate : before our Lord Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-ti ho ari-pen-meve : o-ti epros-ta-tis eten hot : nahren Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: THE VIRGIN’S DOXOLOGY (For Evening Incense)

rows.cop: Ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ: ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ: ⲉⲥⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ.
rows.en: + The adornment of Mary is : in the highest heavens : at the right hand of her beloved : asking Him on our behalf.
rows.cop_lat: Ere-epsolsel em-Mariam : khen nifiowi etsa-epshoi : sa-owi-nam empesmenreet : estovh emof e-ehri egon.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ϥⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲯⲁⲗⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ: ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
rows.en: As David has spoken : in the psalm saying : the queen stood at : your right hand O King.
rows.cop_lat: Kata efrity etafgos : enje David khen pi-epsalmos : je as-ohi erats enje ti-oro : sa-owi-nam emok ep-oro.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲟⲗⲟⲙⲱⲛ ⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓϫⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲱ: ϫⲉ ⲧⲁⲥⲱⲛⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲁϣ̀ⲫⲉⲣⲓ: ⲧⲁⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅.
rows.en: + Solomon called her : in the Song of Songs saying : “my sister and my Spouse : my true city Jerusalem.”
rows.cop_lat: Solomon moty eros : khen pigo ente nigo : je tasoni owoh ta-eshfiri : tapolees emmi Yerosaleem.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥϯⲙⲏⲓⲛⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲩϭⲟⲥⲓ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲙⲏ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲏ̀ⲡⲟⲥ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ.
rows.en: For he has given a symbol of her : in many exalted names saying : “come out of your garden. : O choicest aroma.”
rows.cop_lat: Aftimini ghar eros : khen hanmish enran ev-etchosi : je ami evol khen pekipos : o thi-etsotp enaromata.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲱⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O virgin : the true queen indeed : hail to the pride of our race : who bore for us Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne o tiparthenos : ti oro emmi en alithini : shere ep-shosho ente pengenos : are egfo nan en Emmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: We ask you, remember us : O faithful advocate : before our Lord Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-ti ho ari-pen-mev-e : o-ti epros-ta-tis eten hot : nahren Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: HEAVENLY HOST’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲍ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲥⲉⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲉⲣϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲥ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ: ⲉⲩϣⲉⲙϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲉⲧϩⲏⲡ.
rows.en: + Seven archangels stand : praising as the stand : before the Almighty : serving the hidden mystery.
rows.cop_lat: Shashf en-arshi-angelos : se-ohi erato ev-er-hemnos : em-pe-emtho em-pipantokrator : ev-shemshi em-mesterion et-heep.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓϩⲟⲩⲓⲧ: Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲃ̅: Ⲣⲁϥⲁⲏⲗ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲅ̅: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Michael is the first : Gabriel is the second : Rafael is the third : according to the type of the Trinity.
rows.cop_lat: Mikhael pe pi-howeet : Ghabriel pe pimah esnav : Rafael pe pimah shomt : kata eptipos en-ti-etrias.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲟⲩⲣⲓⲏⲗ Ⲥⲉⲇⲁⲕⲓⲏⲗ: Ⲥⲁⲣⲁⲑⲓⲏⲗ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲛⲁⲛⲓⲏⲗ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲛⲧ.
rows.en: + Souriel, Sedakiel : Sarathiel and Ananiel : these luminous and holy : who Him for the creation.
rows.cop_lat: Sorieel Sedakiel : Sarathiel nem Ananiel : nai nishty enref er-o-oini ethouab : ni-etovh emof e-ehri ejen pisont.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ: ⲛⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲧϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ: ⲡⲓϥ̀ⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲍⲱⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲥⲱⲙⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲉⲧϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓϩⲁⲣⲙⲁ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ.
rows.en: The Cherubim, and the Seraphim : the thrones, the dominions and powers : and the four incorporeal creatures : who are carrying the throne of God.
rows.cop_lat: Nisherobeem nem Niserafeem : ni-ethronos ni-met-choise nigom : piefto enzo-on en-asomatos : etfay kha piharma enTheos.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓϫⲟⲩⲧ ϥ̀ⲧⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲓⲥⲓ: ⲉⲩϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧⲁⲧⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ: ⲉⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + And the twenty four priests : in the church of the first-born : praise Him without ceasing : proclaiming and saying.
rows.cop_lat: Pigot efto emepresviteros : khen ti-ekekleseya ente ni-shorp emisi : ev-hos eros khen o-met-at-monk : evosh evol evgo emos.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ: ⲛⲏⲉⲧϣⲱⲛⲓ ⲙⲁⲧⲁⲗϭⲱⲟⲩ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲓⲥⲭⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲉⲛⲕⲟⲧ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲙⲁⲙ̀ⲧⲟⲛ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Holy, O God : the sick, heal them : holy, O mighty : those who departed, O Lord repose them.
rows.cop_lat: Je agios O Theos : nietshoni metal-etcho-oo : agios yes-sheros : nietavenkot Epchoise maemton no-oo.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ̀: ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲛⲏⲛ: ⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Holy O Immortal : bless Your inheritance : may Your mercy and Your peace : be a fortress to Your people.
rows.cop_lat: Agios athanatos : esmo etek-eklironomia : mare peknai nem tek-hirini : oi ensovt em-pekla-os.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲥⲁⲃⲁⲱⲑ: ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀.
rows.en: Holy, and holy : holy, Lord of Hosts : Heaven and earth are full : of Your honour and Your glory.
rows.cop_lat: Je ekouab owoh ekouab : ekouab Epchoise sava-ot : etfe nem epkahi meh evol : khen peko-o nem pektayo.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩϣⲁⲛϫⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲁⲗ̅: ϣⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲟⲩⲱϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ Ⲡⲉⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.
rows.en: + And when they chant, “Alleluia” : the heavenly respond saying : “Holy, amen alleluia : glory to our God.”
rows.cop_lat: Avshangos empi-alleluia : share na nifiowi owoh emo-oo : je agios amen alleluia : pi-o-oo fa Pennoty pe.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣ̅ⲓⲡ̅: ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲣⲁⲧⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O angelic hosts : and the heavenly orders : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ari-epresve-vin e-ehri egon : ni-estratia enangelikon : nem nitaghma en-eporanion : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: SAINT JOHN THE BELOVED’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲍⲉⲃⲉⲇⲉⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲣⲉⲙ ⲙ̀Ⲃⲏⲇⲥⲁⲓⲇⲉ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲍⲉⲃⲟⲗⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + Saint John the virgin : the son of Zebedee : a native of Bethsaida : from the tribe of Zebulon.
rows.cop_lat: Yoaness pi-parthenos : epshiri en-Zebede-os : evol khen nirem emBidsaide : khen etfili ente Zebolon.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁϥⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲩⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲁϥⲙⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ.
rows.en: Christ has chosen him : and made him a disciple of Himself : and also an apostle : He loved Him very much.
rows.cop_lat: Afsotp emmof enje piEkhristos : aferomatheetees naf : owoh pi-apostolos : nafmei emof emasho.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲟⲛ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲡⲓⲇⲏⲡⲛⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲣⲱⲧⲉⲃ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ: ⲑ̀ⲙⲉⲥⲧⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲁⲧⲏⲓⲕ. Ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏⲧϥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ϧⲉⲛ ⲣⲱϥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡ ⲉⲓϣⲁⲛⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲭⲁϥ: ⲉ̀ⲫⲁⲓ ϣⲁⲧⲓ̀ ⲁ̀ϧⲟⲕ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱⲕ.
rows.en: + He also after dinner : rested upon the shoulder : of our Saviour and said to Him : “who will betray You ?” Christ Has spoken of you : through His Holy mouth : “if I will that he remain will I come :
rows.cop_lat: Enthof on menensa pizipnon : af-roteb emmof e-ehri ejen : ethmestenheet em-Pensoteer : owoh afgos nim fiethnatik. Enthof on etafsaji eth-vitf : enje pi-Ekhristos khen rof ethouab : je eshop eishano-osh ekaf : efay shaty a-khok ensok.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲙⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ: ⲉ̀ϯⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲁϥⲥ̀ϧⲁⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲛ: ⲁϥϩⲓⲱⲓϣ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲏⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ.
rows.en: what is that to You.” + And after thirty years : from the holy resurrection : he wrote his Gospel : and preached to the entire world. Hail to you O martyr : hail to the evangelist : hail to the apostle : of Christ the disciple.
rows.cop_lat: Owoh menensa map enrompi : e-ti-anastasees ethouab : af-es-khai empefev-angelion : af-hioish emmof khen pikosmos. Shere nak o pimartiros : shere pi-evangelestees : shere pi-apostolos : ente pi-Ekhristos owoh matheetees.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁⲧⲕ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲱ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲍⲉⲃⲉⲇⲉⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Blessed are you indeed : O beloved of Christ : John the truly chosen one : the son of Zebedee.
rows.cop_lat: Ooniatk khen omethmi : o pimenreet ente pi-Ekhristos : Youaness pisotp emmi : epshiri en-Zebedeos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲏⲥⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲁ̅ Ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O disciple of Christ : Saint John the beloved and apostle : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise eehri egon : o piparthenos enevangelestees : Youaness pi-apostolos : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: APOSTLES DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲉⲁⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲁ̅ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Our Lord Jesus Christ : has chosen His apostles : Peter and Andrew : and John and James.
rows.cop_lat: Kireyos Isous piEkhristos : afsotp e-nefapostolos : ete Petros nem Anedreas : Youaness nem Yakobos.

rows.cop: Ⲗⲟⲓⲡⲟⲛ Ⲫⲓⲗⲓⲡⲡⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲙⲁⲧⲑⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲃⲁⲣⲑⲟⲗⲟⲙⲉⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲑⲱⲙⲁⲥ: Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁⲗⲫⲉⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁⲛⲁⲛⲉⲟⲥ.
rows.en: And Phillip and Mathew : Bartholomew and Thomas : James the Son of Alphaeus : and Simon the Canaanite.
rows.cop_lat: Loipon Filipos nem Mathe-os : Bartholom-eos nem Thomas : Yakobos ente Alfe-os : nem Simon pik-anan-eos.

rows.cop: Ⲑⲁⲇⲇⲉⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲙⲁⲧⲑⲓⲁⲥ: Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲗⲟⲩⲕⲁⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ.
rows.en: + Thaddeus and Matthias : Paul, Mark and Luke : and the rest of the disciples : who followed our Saviour.
rows.cop_lat: Thade-os nem Mathias : Pavlos nem Markos nem Lokas : nem epsepi ente nimatheetees : ni-etavmoshi ensa Pensoteer.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲧⲑⲓⲁⲥ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲃⲓⲱ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ϫⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ⲇⲉⲥⲡⲟⲧⲁ.
rows.en: Matthias was chosen : instead of Judas : and was numbered with : the rest of the apostles.
rows.cop_lat: Mathias fi-etaf-shopi : enetsheveyo en-Yodas ; nem epgok evol nem epsepi : ni-etav-moshi ensa Zespota.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲡⲟⲩϧ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲁⲩⲫⲟϩ: ϣⲁ ⲁⲩⲣⲏϫⲥ ⲛ̀ϯⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏ.
rows.en: + Their sound went forth : into all the earth : and their words unto : all the ends of the world.
rows.cop_lat: Apo-ekhro-o shenaf evol : hijen epho em-epkahi tirf : owoh no-saji av-foh : sha av-rigs en-ti-oikomeni.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲉ ⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : Our Lords and fathers the apostles : and the seventy two disciples : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise eehri egon : o nashoys enyoty en-apostolos : nem pi-eshve esnav emmatheetees : entef ka nennovi nan evol.

rows.en: SAINT MARK’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲙ̀ⲕⲁⲩϩ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ.
rows.en: + O Mark, the apostle : and the evangelist : the witness to the suffering : of the only begotten God.
rows.cop_lat: Markos pi-apostolos : owoh pi-evangelestees : pi-methre kha ni-emkavh : ente pimonogenees ennoty.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲛ: ⲁⲕⲧ̀ⲥⲁⲃⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: You came and enlightened us : through your Gospel : and taught us the Father and the Son : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Ak-ee akero-oini eron : heeten pek-evangelion : ak-etsavon em-Efyot nem Epshiri : nem Pi-epnevma Ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲕⲉⲛⲧⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲭⲁⲕⲓ: ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲁⲕⲧⲉⲙⲙⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲱⲓⲕ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ.
rows.en: + You brought us out of darkness : into the true Light : and fed us the Bread of life : which descended from Heaven.
rows.cop_lat: Akenten evol khen epkaki : ekhon epi-o-oini emmi : aktemon empi-oik ente ep-onkh : etaf-ee epeseet evol khen etfe.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩϭⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲕ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲕⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲁⲩⲫⲟϩ: ϣⲁ ⲁⲩⲣⲏϫⲥ ⲛ̀ϯⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏ.
rows.en: All the tribes of the earth : have been blessed by you : and your sayings reached : all the ends of the world.
rows.cop_lat: Av-echi-esmo en-ekhri en-khitk : enje nifili tiro ente ep-kahi : owoh neksaji av-foh : sha avrigs en-ti-oi-komeni.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲑⲉⲱⲣⲓⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O martyr : hail to the evangelist : hail to the apostle : Mark the beholder of God.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o pi-martiros : shere pi-evangelestees : shere pi-apostolos : Markos pi-Theo-rimos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲑⲉⲱⲣⲓⲙⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O beholder of God the evangelist : Mark the apostle : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise eehri egon : o-pi-Theorimos en-evangelestees : Markos pi-apostolos : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: SAINT GEORGE’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲍ̅̅̅ ⲛ̀ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲁϥⲅⲟⲕⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫⲏⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲅⲉⲱⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲉ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ: ⲉⲩϯϩⲁⲡ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲛⲓ.
rows.en: + Saint George has endured : for seven whole years : seventy impious kings : judged him every day.
rows.cop_lat: Shashf enrompi afgoko evol : enje fi-ethouab George-os : eri pi-eshve enoro en-anomos : evti-hap erof emini.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲡⲟⲩϣ̀ⲫⲱⲛϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲗⲟⲅⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁϩϯ ⲉⲧⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ: ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲡⲏ: ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: They could not change his mind : nor his upright faith : nor the great love he had : for the King Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Empo-esh-fonh empeflogesmos : oze pefnahty etsoton : oze tefnishty enaghapi ekhon e-ep-oro piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲁⲣⲉϥⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲕⲱϯ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁⲓϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲓϣ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ.
rows.en: + And he sang with David: “all the nations surrounded me : but in the name of the Lord Jesus : I destroyed them.”
rows.cop_lat: Nafer-epsalin nem David : je avkoty eroi enje niethnos tiro : alla khen efran en-Isous Panoty : ai-etchi empa-etchi emepshish nemo-oo.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲅⲉⲱⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ: ϧⲉⲛ Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ.
rows.en: Great is your honour : my master George the prince : Christ rejoices with you : in the heavenly Jerusalem.
rows.cop_lat: Onishty ghar pe pektaio : O Patchoise eporo George-os : ere pi-Ekhristos rashi nemak : khen Yerosaleem ente etfe.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϭⲱⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲅⲉⲱⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O martyr : hail to the courageous hero : hail to the victorious : my master the prince Saint George.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o pimartiros : shere pi-etchoig en-geneos : shere pi-athloforos : Patchoise ep-oro George-os.

rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our Toveh em Epetchoise e- Ⲧⲱ : ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ behalf : O victorious ehri egon : o pi-athloforos ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ : Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ martyr : my master the em-martiros : Patchoise Ⲅⲉⲱⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ : ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ prince Saint George : that ep-oro Ge-orge-os : entef ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ. He may forgive us our ka nen-novi nan evol. sins. SAINT MINA’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ϫⲉⲙϩⲏⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϯⲟ̀ⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲁⲓ ⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲗⲏⲟⲩ.
rows.en: + What shall it profit a man : if he gains the whole world : but loses his own soul? : oh, the vanity of the world!
rows.cop_lat: Eshop on ente piromi : jemheyo em-pikosmos tirf : entef-ti-osi entefepsishi : o-pe pai-onkh en-efleyo.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ: ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁ ϯⲥⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁϥⲭⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲧⲁⲕⲟ.
rows.en: The saint Abba Mina : heard the divine voice : and forsook the whole world : with its vain glory.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-agios ava Mina : afsotem ensa ti-esmi ennoty : afko empikosmos tirf ensof : nem pef o-oo ethnatako.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ: ⲁϥϣⲉⲡ ϩⲁⲛⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲃⲁⲥⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉⲑⲃⲉ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ.
rows.en: + He gave his soul unto death : and his body unto the fire : and received great afflictions : for the Son of the living God.
rows.cop_lat: Afty entef-epsishi eefmoo : nem pefsoma : epi-ekrom : afshep hannishty em-vasanos : ethve Epshiri em-Efnoty etonkh.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲁ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲟⲗϥ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉϥⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁϥϯⲛⲁϥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲏⲉⲧⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲃⲁⲗ ⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Therefore, our Saviour : raised him to His Kingdom : and granted him the good things : which an eye has not seen.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay a-Pensoteer : olf ekhon etef-met-oro : afti-naf enni-agathon : eni-ete empeval nav erooo.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓϭⲱⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲅⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ.
rows.en: + Hail to you O martyr : hail to the courageous hero : hail to the victorious : the saint Abba Mina
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o pimartiros : shere pit-choig en-genne-os : shere pi-athloforos : pi-agios Abba Mina.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲁ̀ⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲏⲛⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O victorious martyr : the Saint Abba Mina : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise eehri egon : o piathloforos em-martiros : pi-agios Abba Mina : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: SAINT DEMIANA’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ϯⲁⲗⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲃⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ.
rows.en: + The young virgin : the prudent, and truly chosen lady : the bride of Christ : the holy Demiana.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-alo ensave emparthenos : ti-sotp enkiriya emmi : ti-shelet ente pi-Ekhristos : ti-agia Timiani.

rows.cop: Ⲑⲁⲓ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲙⲉⲧⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲩ: ⲁⲥⲙⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ̀: ⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲁⲥⲙⲉⲛⲣⲉ ⲛ̀ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: This is she who was filled : with wisdom since her young age : despising the worldly matters : and loving virginity.
rows.cop_lat: Thay es-jen tes-met-alo : asmeh evol khen ti-sofeya : asmosty en-ni-kosmikon : asmenre en-ti-parthenia.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲁⲣⲭⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲗⲩⲙⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲡⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲥⲓⲱⲧ ⲕⲟⲧϥ.
rows.en: + She became a leader : and a harbour of salvation : a mother for forty virgins : in the mansion her father built.
rows.cop_lat: As-shopy en-ti-arshi : enlimin ente pi-ogay : ethmav en-ehme emparthenos : khen pipirghos eta pesyot kotf.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥϫⲱⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉϥϣⲉⲣⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲉⲣⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ: ⲁϥϭⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: When he denied Christ : his daughter Demiana restored him : whom she loved faith : and he attained the martyrdom.
rows.cop_lat: Afgol evol em-piEkhristos : astas-to emmof enje tef-shere : etas-menre emmof enje Timianee : af-etchi enti-met-marteria.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲁϩⲥⲁϩⲛⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲥϧⲓⲥⲓ: ⲁⲥϣⲉⲡⲙ̀ⲕⲁϩ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲡ: ⲁⲥϭⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: + Therefore the king sent : and ordered her to be tortured : and she accepted suffering many times : and she attained martyrdom.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay af o-orp enje ep-oro : af o ah-sahni khen nes-kheesee : asshep-emkah eno-mish ensop : aset-chee en-timet-marteria.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲙ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲛⲁⲩϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲡⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ: ⲁⲩϭⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲓⲁ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲥ.
rows.en: And the forty virgins : who were with her in the mansion : attained martyrdom: with her on the same day.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-ehmi ethouab emparthenos : enavshopi nemas khen pi-pirghos : avet-chi en-ti-metmarteria : khen pi-ehooo en-o-ot nemas.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁ̀ϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ: ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲛⲩⲙⲫⲓⲟⲥ: ϯⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Blessed are you O Demiana : the bride of the bridegroom : the virgin nun : the truly chosen martyr.
rows.cop_lat: O oniati entho Timianee : ti-shelet ente pinimfeyos : timonaki em-parthenos : ti-sotp emi emmartiros.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O bride of Christ : the pure Saint Demiana : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o ti-shelet ente pi-Ekhristos : tiagia emmi Timianee : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: SAINT ATHANASIUS’ DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲕⲩⲃⲉⲣⲛⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲉⲧⲧⲁϫⲣⲏⲟⲩⲧ: ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲓϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲗⲱⲥ: ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϭⲣⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲱⲧⲥ: ⲡⲓϧⲏⲃⲥ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ.
rows.en: + O you who are strong in managing the ship : O the distinguished fighter : who is victorious in the wars : the luminous lamp.
rows.cop_lat: Piki bernetees etagreyot : pirefmishi enkalos : pref-etchro khen nivots : pi-khebs etafer-o-oini.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲕⲏⲣⲝ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲟⲣⲑⲟⲇⲟⲝⲓⲁ: ⲡⲉ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϯⲥ̀ⲃⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟϩⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲗⲟⲅⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: The leader orthodoxy : Athanasius apostolic : instructor of eloquent sheep : are for Christ.
rows.ar_lat: of is the the the that
rows.cop_lat: Pikirix ente tiorthozoxeya : peAthanasios piapostolikos : pireftiesvo ente pi-ohi : enlogikon ente piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲁ ⲛⲉⲕⲇⲟⲅⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ: ⲙⲓϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ϩⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϩⲉⲣⲉⲧⲓⲕⲟⲥ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲟ ⲃ̅: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ.
rows.en: + Your truthful doctrine : pierced the hearts of the heretics : like a double-edged sword : by the power of the Trinity.
rows.cop_lat: A nek-dogma etsoton : mishi em-epheet eniheretikos : em-efrity en-osifi enro esnav : heeten etgom en-tietreyas.

rows.cop: Ⲁ ⲕⲉⲗⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲕⲱⲗϫ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁⲗⲁⲥ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ: ⲁⲡ̀ⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ: ⲁϥⲙⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ϩⲟ ⲛ̀ϯⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏ.
rows.en: Every knee bowed to the Lord : and every tongue praised Him : the glory of God was announced : and filled the entire universe.
rows.cop_lat: A keli niven kolg emEpetchoise : a-las niven esmo erof : a epoo-o o-osh evol : afmoh em-epho en-tioi-komeni.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲥⲁⲩⲧⲱⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲇⲟⲥ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲱⲓⲃ ϣⲁ ⲉⲛⲉϩ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧ̀ⲧⲁⲝⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲉⲗⲭⲓⲥⲉⲇⲉⲕ.
rows.en: + Likewise we exalt you : along with David the psalmist : for you are the priest forever : according to the order of Melchizedek.
rows.cop_lat: Osavtos ten-etchisi emmok : nem pihimnodos David : je enthok pe pi-oweeb sha eneh : kata ettaxees emMelshisedek.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ: ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁ ⲛⲉϥⲥ̀ⲃⲱⲟⲩⲓ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to the great Patriarch : our saintly father Abba Athanasius : whose holy teachings : enlightened our minds.
rows.cop_lat: Shere pinishty empatriarshees : penyot ethouab Abba Athanasios : fi eta nefesvo-owi ethouab : eroo-oini em-pennos.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁⲧⲕ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Truly blessed are you : our saintly father the Patriarch : Abba Athanasius the apostolic : the beloved of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: O-oniatk khen omethmi : penyot ethouab empatriarshees : Abba Athanasios piapostolikos : pimenreet ente pi-Ekhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : our saintly father the Patriarch : Saint Athanasius the apostolic : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : penyot ethouab empatriarshees : ava Athanasios piapostolikos : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: POPE’S COMMEMORATION

rows.cop: Ⲱ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲓⲗⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϫⲣⲏⲟⲩⲧ: ⲡⲓⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ. Ⲱ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲛⲉϥ: ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲓϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥϭⲣⲟ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲟⲛⲟⲑⲉⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧϫⲟⲧⲡ: ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ. Ⲧⲉⲣⲙⲉⲛⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲕⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲧϩⲟⲗϫ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲕⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥϯ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ: ⲱ̀ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ: ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ.
rows.en: O firm pillar, and true star, of Christ the great King, Pope Abba (...) the high priest. O good shepherd, the victorious teacher, the undefeated struggler, and faithful high priest. The explanations of your sweet sayings, and lifegiving words, enlightened our souls, O son of our father Mark.
rows.cop_lat: O pi-estilos etagreyot : pifosteer enta-efmi : ente pinishti enouro pi-Ekhristos : papa Abba (…) pi-arshi-erevs. O pimanesoo ethnanef : pirefmishi enref-etchro : piagonothetees enatgotp : piarshi-erevs etenhot. Etermenia en-neksaji et-holg : nem neksaji enrefti em-eponkh : o epshiri empeniot Markos : aver-o-oini en-nenepsishi.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲁⲕⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲉⲥⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲟⲡⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲥ̀ⲛⲟϥ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲇⲁⲥⲕⲁⲗⲟⲥ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲫⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...).
rows.en: You shepherd the sheep, of the Church of Christ, which He purchased with His Blood, O great teacher. Hail to our father the Patriarch, the blessed Pope Abba (…), who became a shining star, for his people. Hail to you O true shepherded, that is of Christ, O great high priest, our holy father Abba (…).
rows.cop_lat: Nakamoni en-ni-esoo : ente ti-ekeklisia ente pi-Ekhristos : etaf-shops khen pef-esnof : o pinishti en-nidaskalos. Shere peniot em-patriarshees : pimakarios papa Abba (…) : fi-etafshopi em-pefla-os : eno-fosteer eter-o-oini. Shere nak o piman-esoo : enalithinon ente pi-Ekhristos : o pinishti en-arshi-erevs : peniot ethouab Abba (…).

rows.cop: Ⲱ ⲥⲁⲩⲧⲱⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲇⲟⲥ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧ̀ⲧⲁⲝⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲉⲗⲭⲓⲥⲉⲇⲉⲕ.
rows.en: Likewise we exalt you, with David the psalmist, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
rows.cop_lat: O savtos ten-etchisi emmok : nem pihimnodos David : je enthok pe pi-oweeb sha eneh : kata et-taxees emMelcheesedek.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf, O our holy father the Patriarch, Pope Abba (…) the high priest, that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em-Epetchoise e-ehri egon : peniot ethouab empatriarshees : papa Abba (…) pi-arshi-erevs : entefka nennovi nan evol.

rows.en: THE POPE & BISHOP’S DOXOLOGY

rows.cop: Ⲁⲕϭⲓ ⲧ̀ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ: ϯⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁⲁⲣⲱⲛ: ⲁⲕϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲁⲧⲓⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ Ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲁⲛϫⲱϫ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + You had bestowed the grace of Moses : the priesthood of Aaron : and the honour of our father Peter : the first of the apostles.
rows.cop_lat: Aket-chi et-kharis emMoisees : ti-metoweeb ente Aaron : aket-chi em-eptayo em-penyot Petros : pi-angog en-ni-apostolos.

rows.cop: ⲀⲠⲭⲥ̅ ⲧⲁⲗⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϫⲓϫ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲁ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲁϥⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲩⲧⲕ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓϣⲟϣⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲑ̀ⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀.
rows.en: Christ has raised His right hand : upon your head : and he trusted you : to the keys of the Kingdom of heavens.
rows.cop_lat: A-pi-Ekhristos talo entefjeej : en-owi-nam ejen tek-afe : aften-hotk eni-shosht : ente ethmet-ooro enni-fiowi.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲕϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥⲉⲣϩⲉⲙⲓ: ⲥⲁⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲕⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ.
rows.en: + In order to become : a Bishop for the church : and shepherd your people : by your purity and righteousness.
rows.cop_lat: Ethrek-shopi en-ooreferhemi : sa-epshoi enti-ekekleesia : erthrek-amoni empekla-os : khen otovo nem omethmi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀Ⲁⲁⲣⲱⲛ: ⲡⲁⲩⲣⲏϯ ϩⲱϥ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: As Saint Paul : the apostle has said : as Aaron the prophet : the Christ likewise.
rows.cop_lat: Kata efrity etaf-gos : enje Pavlos pi-apostolos : je kata efrity en-Aaron : pairity hof em-pi-Ekhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲥⲁⲩⲧⲱⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲇⲟⲥ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ϩⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧ̀ⲧⲁⲝⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲉⲗⲭⲓⲥⲉⲇⲉⲕ.
rows.en: + We worthily honour you : with David the psalmist saying : you are the priest forever : after the order of Melchizedek.
rows.cop_lat: Osavtos ten-etchisi emmok : nem pihimnodos David : je enthok pe pi-oweeb sha eneh : kata et-taxees emMelshisedek.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲓ ⲉⲣⲉϥⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : our father the righteous saint : Ava (.....) the archBishop : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : penyot ethouab en-zike-os : Abba (…..) piarchi-erefs : entef ka nennovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : our father the righteous saint : ava (.....) the Bishop : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : penyot ethouab en-zike-os : Abba (…..) piepiskopos : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.en: EXTRA DOXOLOGIES – LAST VERSES ONLY
Archangel Michael:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O holy archangel : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : o pi-archiangelos ethouab : Mikhaeel ep-arkhon en-na nifiowi : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Archangel Gabriel:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓϥⲁⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟϥⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O holy archangel : Gabriel the announcer : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : o pi-archiangelos ethouab : Ghabrieel pi-fayshennofi : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Archangel Rafael:
(13 Kiahk & 3 Nasi)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲣⲁⲫⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϩⲏⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O holy archangel : Rafael the joy of all hearts : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : o pi-archiangelos ethouab : Rafaeel ep-oonof enheet : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Archangel Souriel:
(27 Toubah & 27 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲥⲟⲩⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O holy archangel : Souriel the trumpeter : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : o pi-archiangelos ethouab : Souriel pisalpestees: entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: The four incorporeal creatures:
(8 Hatoor)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓϥ̀ⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲍⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲥⲱⲙⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲗⲓⲧⲟⲣⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϣⲁϩ ⲛ̀ⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O four incorporeal creatures : the ministers fervent as fire : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : o pi efto enzo-on en-asomatos : enlitorghos ensha enekrom : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: The twenty four priests:
(24 Hatoor)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲡⲓϫⲟⲩⲧ ϥ̀ⲧⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : the priests of truth : the twenty four presbyters : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : ni-oweeb ente timethi : pigoot efto em-epresviteros : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint John the baptist:

rows.ar_lat: (3 Tout, 30 Amshir, 2 Baouna & 30 Baouna)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲇⲣⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲃⲁⲡⲧⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲁ̅ Ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϯⲱⲙⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O forerunner and baptiser : John the baptist : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehri egon : o pieprodromos em baptistees : Youannes pireftioms : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Peter & Saint Paul:
(5 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ Ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲁϧ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O my masters and fathers the apostles : our father Peter and our father Paul : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o nashoys enyoty en apostolos : peniot Petros nem pensakh Pavlos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Any apostle:

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: (...) ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O disciple of Christ : (…) the apostle : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o pimatheetees ente piEkhristos : (…) piapostolos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Stephen:

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲇⲓⲁⲕⲱⲛ ⲉⲧⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ: Ⲥⲧⲉⲫⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O blessed archdeacon : Stephen the first of the martys : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o pi archiziakon etesmaro-ot : Stefanos pishorp emmartiros : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Theodore:
(20 Hatoor & 20 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: Ⲑⲉⲟⲇⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲣⲁⲧⲓⲗⲁⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O strife mantled martyr : Theodore the general : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o piathlofors emmartiros : The-odoros pi-estratilatis : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Philopateer Mercorious:
(25 Hatoor & 25 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: Ⲫⲓⲗⲟⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ Ⲙⲉⲣⲕⲟⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O victorious martyr : Philopateer Mercorious : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o piathloforos em-martiros : Philopateer Mercorious : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Marina:
(23 Tout & 23 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲛⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O bride of Christ : the pure Saint Marina : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o ti-shelet ente pi-Ekhristos : tiagia emmi Marini : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Anthony & Saint Pavle:
(22 Toubah)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲛⲟⲩϣⲏⲣⲓ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲛⲧⲱⲛⲓⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲉ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O my masters and fathers who loved their children : Abba Anthony and Abba Paul : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o nashoys enyoty em-mai-noshiri : Abba Antonios nem Abba Pavle : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Paul the hermit:
(2 Amshir)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲉ: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧϥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O great and holy Abba Paul : that the Lord whom you have loved : may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o pinishti ethouab Abba Pavle : hina ente Epcoise fietakmenritf : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Shenouda the Archmandrite:
(1 Kiahk & 7 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲥⲕⲏⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ϣⲉⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲙⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O my master the ascetic father : Abba Shenouda the Archmandrite : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : O Patchoise eniot en askeetees : Abba Shenouti pi-archi-manedretees : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Bishoy & Saint Paul of Tammouh:
(7 Babah & 8 Abeeb)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲛⲟⲩϣⲏⲣⲓ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲓϣⲱⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲉ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O my masters and fathers who loved their children : Abba Bishoi and Abba Pavle : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o nashoys enyoty em-mai-noshiri : Abba Bishoy nem Abba Pavle : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Maximous & Saint Dometious:
(14 Toubah & 17 Toubah)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲝⲓⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲇⲟⲙⲉⲧⲓⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : our holy Roman fathers : Maximous and Dometious : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o nenioti ethouab enrome-os : Maximous nem Dometious : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Samel the Confessor:
(8 Kiahk)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲥⲁⲙⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉϥϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O our holy father Abba Samuel : and all his children the monks : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : o peniot ethouab Abba Samoeel : nem nefshiri emmonakhos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Takla Himanot:
(24 Kiahk & 24 Misra)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲣⲉⲙⲈⲑⲁⲩϣ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲑⲉⲕⲗⲁ Ϩⲩⲙⲁⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O Ethiopian apostle : Saint Takla Himanot : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e-ehri egon : O piapostolos en-niremEth-avsh : pi-agios Tekla himanos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Saint Abraam:
(8 Kiahk)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ: ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫⲓⲟⲙ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : our holy father Abba Abraam : the Bishop of Fayoum : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Tovh em Epchoise eehri egon : peniot ethouab Abba Abraam : pi-episkopos ente Efiom : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: DOXOLOGIES CONCLUSION

rows.cop: Ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲟⲙⲥ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲣⲉⲭⲏ ϧ̀ⲏⲧⲟⲩ: ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ϯⲑⲉⲟⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ.
rows.en: + Be our advocate : from the heights where you are : O Lady of us all the mother of God : the ever-virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Shopi entho ere-soms egon : khen nima etetchosi etere-khi enkhito : o tenchoyse eniv tiren ti-theotokos : etoy em-parthenos enseyo niven.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲣⲉⲙⲁⲥϥ: Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲱ̀ⲗⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ.
rows.en: Ask of Him whom you have born : our good Saviour : to take away our afflictions : and establish for us His peace.
rows.cop_lat: Matiho em-fietaremasf : Pensoteer en-aghathos : entefooli en-nai-khisi evolharon : entef-semni nan entef-hirini.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲱⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O virgin : the true queen indeed : hail to the pride of our race : who bore for us Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne o tiparthenos : ti-oro emmi en alithini : shere ep-shosho ente pen-genos : arei egfo nan en Emmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: We ask you, remember us : O faithful advocate : before our Lord Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-ti ho ari-pen-meve : o-ti epros-ta-tis eten hot : nahren Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Continue with: Introduction to the Creed (We honour you, mother of the True Light…) Page : 82
