COPTIC NEW YEAR DOXOLOGY
[Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ϩⲱⲥ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲱⲥ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲣⲓ: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϫⲉ ⲁϥϫⲉⲙⲡⲉⲛϣⲓⲛⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
rows.en: + Praise the Lord with a new praise : all people who love Christ our God : for He has visited us with his salvation : as a good and Philanthropic One.
rows.cop_lat: Hos Epetchoise khen ohos em-veri : o neela-os emmai pi-Ekhristos Pennoty : je af-gempenshini khen pef-ogay : hos aghathos owoh ammairomi.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ϯⲇⲟⲝⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ̀: ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲙⲁⲧⲁϫⲣⲟⲛ ϣⲁ ϯⲥⲩⲛⲧⲉⲗⲓⲁ.
rows.en: We ascribe praise unto You : with the voices of glorification : O our good Saviour : confirm us unto the end.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-o-orp nak empihimnos : khen han-esmi en-ti-zoxologeya : o Pensoteer en-aghathos : ma-tagron sha tisenteleya.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲛⲁϩⲙⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲙⲁⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲥⲟϭⲛⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲁⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛϣⲱⲛⲓ.
rows.en: + Grant us, O Lord, Your peace : and save us from the hands of our enemies : humiliate their counsel : and heal our sicknesses.
rows.cop_lat: Moi nan Epetchoise entek-hirini : nahmen khen nenjeg ente nen-gaji : ma-thevio em-po-soetchni : owoh metal-etcho en-nen-shoni.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲗⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲛⲓⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲙⲟⲩⲙⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲧϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Bless the crown of the year : with your goodness, O Lord : the river and the springs : and the seeds and the fruits.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo e-pi-eklom ente tirompi : heeten tek-metEkhristos Epetchoise: niiaro-oo nem ni-momi : nem ni-siti nem ni karpos.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϩ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕϭⲓⲥⲓ: ⲡⲉⲕϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲕⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + Bless us in our work : with Your heavenly blessings : and send us from on high : your grace and Your goodness.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo eron khen nenehbe-owi : khen pekesmo en-eporaneyon : oorp nan evol khen teketchisi : pek-ehmot nem nek-agathon.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲏⲉⲧϩⲉϫϩⲱϫ ⲛⲁϩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩϣⲉ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲙⲁⲧⲁⲥⲑⲉⲟⲩ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲥⲱⲛϩ ⲃⲟⲗⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲉⲛⲕⲟⲧ ⲙⲁⲙ̀ⲧⲟⲛ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ.
rows.en: The afflicted, save them : the travelers, return them : the bound, unbind them : those who slept, repose them.
rows.cop_lat: Ni-et-heg-hog nahmoo evol : nietavshe eepshemmo matas-te-o : nem ni-etsonh volo evol : ni-etavenkot maemton no-oo.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕϫⲱⲛⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛⲁϩⲙⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲁ ⲟⲩϩ ⲃⲱⲛ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲫⲁϣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲇⲉⲙⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲫ̀ⲣⲉϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + Take away Your wrath from us : and deliver us from famine : and from the wiles of the demons : O giver of good things.
rows.cop_lat: Oli em-pekgont evol haron : nahmen evol ha o-ehvon : nem ni-fash ente nidemon : o efrefty enni-agathon.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.en: We praise Him and glorify Him : and exalt Him above all : as a good and Philanthropic One : have mercy on us according to Your mercy.
rows.cop_lat: Tenhos erof tenti-o-oo naf : tenerho-oo etchisi emmof : hos aghathos owoh em-mairomi : nai nan kata peknishty ennai.

rows.en: FEAST OF THE CROSS DOXOLOGY
[Sha’anenee Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲣⲑⲟⲇⲟⲝⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀+: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: + We also the sons : of the Orthodox people : worship the cross : of our Lord Jesus Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Anon hon kha nila-os : nishiri en-orthozoxos : enten-o-osht em-piEstavros : ente Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲙ̀+: ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲁⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲏⲗ ϧⲉⲛ + ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Paul the apostle utters : with honour of the cross saying : I should not glory : except in the cross of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Pavlos pi-apostolos : efgo em-eptaio em-pi-Estavros : je ten-nashosho emmon an : eveel khen piEstavros ente piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲥ ⲱ̀ ⲛⲓⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓϣⲉ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Let all the faithful glorify : our Lord Jesus Christ : and prostrate ourselves before His cross : the sacred and immortal wood.
rows.cop_lat: Tener-hemnos o ni-pistos : em-Penchoise Isous piEkhristos : owoh ten-oosht em-pef-estavros : pishe ethouab enathanatos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲓ̀ϣⲓ ⲉϫⲱⲕ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅: ϫⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ: ⲁⲛϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲛⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲩⲑⲉⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: We are proud of you, O Cross : on which Jesus was crucified : for because of you : we have become liberated.
rows.cop_lat: Tenshosho emmok o piEstavros : fe-etav-eshi egok en-Isous : je evol heeten pektipos : an-shopi en-elev-theros.

rows.cop: Ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲟⲣⲑⲟⲇⲟⲝⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲍ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲥⲉϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + The mouths of the Orthodox : and the seven groups of angels : are proud of you : O Cross of our good Saviour.
rows.cop_lat: Ro-oo en-ni-orthozoxos : nem shashf entaghma angelos : se-shosho emmok o pi-Estavros : ente Pensoteer enaghathos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲗⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲫ̀ⲛⲁϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲙⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲇⲩⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲣⲏⲧⲱⲥ.
rows.en: We carry you O Cross : supporter of Christians : around our necks in all courage : and we cry aloud saying.
rows.cop_lat: Tentalo emmok o piEstavros : efnashty enni-ekhristianos : ejen nenmoty en-zinatos : owoh enten-osh evol ritos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓϭⲣⲟ ⲟⲩⲃⲉ ⲡⲓⲧⲩⲣⲁⲛⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Hail to you O Cross : the rejoice of Christians : victorious over all evil : and our steadfastness we the believers.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o piEstavros : efrashi enni-ekhsristianos : pietchro ovee pitiranos : nem pentagro anon kha nipistos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲙϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓ̅: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩϫⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃⲁⲥⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to you O Cross : the comfort of the believers : and the steadfastness of the martyrs : who endured in their sufferings.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o piEstavros : efnomty enni-pistos : owoh eptagro en-nimartiros : sha entogok evol enovasnos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲡⲓϩⲟⲡⲗⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓϭⲣⲟ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
rows.en: + Hail to you O Cross : the weapon of victory : hail to you O Cross : the throne of the king.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o piEstavros : pihoplon ente pi-etchro : shere nak o pi-Estavros : piethronos empi-oro.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲡⲓⲙⲏⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲁⲓ.
rows.en: Hail to you O Cross : the sign of salvation : hail to you O Cross : the glorious light.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o piEstavros : pimini ente pi-ogay : shere nak o pi-Estavros : pi-oo-oini etaf-shai.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ϯⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ϯⲙⲟⲩⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥⲙⲁ.
rows.en: + Hail to you O Cross : the sword of the spirit : hail to you O Cross : the source of grace.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o piEstavros : ti-sifi ente pi-epnevma : shere nak o pi-Estavros : ti-momi en-ni-karisma.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲡⲓⲑⲩⲥⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ϣⲁ ⲡ̀ϫⲱⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ.
rows.en: Hail to you O Cross : the treasure of goodness : hail to you O Cross : to the ends of ages.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nak o piEstavros : pi-thi-savros ente ni-agathon : shere nak o pi-Estavros : sha epgok o evol enni-oon.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ +: ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲕⲱⲥⲧⲁⲛⲧⲓⲛⲟⲥ: ⲟⲗϥ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ: ⲁϥϣⲁⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲂⲁⲣⲃⲁⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Hail to you O Cross : which King Constantine : carried with him to war : and killed the barbarians.
rows.cop_lat: Je shere nak o piEstavros : fi-eta ep-oro Kostantinos : olf nemaf epipolemos : af-shari enni-Barbaros.

rows.cop: Ϥⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲏⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ +: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ: Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲁⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Highly honoured is : the sign of the Cross : of Jesus Christ : the King our true God.
rows.cop_lat: Eftayot ghar emasho : enje pimini ente piEstavros : ente Isous pi-Ekhristos ep-oro : Pennoty en-alithinos.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲁϣϥ ⲉ̀+: ϣⲁⲉ̀ⲛⲧⲉϥⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲇⲉ ϩⲱⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲧⲁⲓⲟϥ: ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Who was crucified on the cross : for us to be redeemed : let us also honour it : crying out and saying.
rows.cop_lat: Fi-etav-ashf epiEstavros : sha-entefsoty em-pengenos : anon ze hoon marentaiof : en-osh evol engo emmos.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲉⲛϩⲟⲗⲡⲟⲛ ⲧⲉⲛϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛⲉⲛϩⲟϫϩⲉϫ ⲑ̀ⲗⲓⲯⲓⲥ. : +: +: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛ
rows.en: The Cross is our sword : the Cross is our hope : the Cross is our steadfastness : in our hardships and tribulations.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-estavros pe penholpon : piEstavros pe tenhelpees : pi-Estavros pe pentagro : khen nenhogheg nem nenethli-epsis.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲧⲁⲛϧⲟ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲁϣϥ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱϥ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲟⲧⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: + Blessed is Jesus our God : and His life giving Cross : on which He was crucified : to deliver us from our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Je ef-esmaro-ot enje pi-Ekhristos Pennoty : nem pef-estavros enreftankho : fi-etavashf e-ehri egof : sha entef-soten khen nennovi.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.en: We praise Him and glorify Him : and exalt Him above all : as a good and Philanthropic One : have mercy on us according to Your mercy.
rows.cop_lat: Tenhos erof tenti-o-o naf : tenerho-oo etchisi emmof : hos aghathos owoh emmairomi : nai nan kata peknishty ennai.

rows.en: KIAHK DOXOLOGY
[Kiahk Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁⲓϣⲁⲛⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏϯ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓϩⲁⲣⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲡⲁⲗⲁⲥ ⲛⲁϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲍⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ.
rows.en: + For if I spoke about you : O Cherubimic vessel : my tongue will never quit : blessing you forever.
rows.cop_lat: Ke ghar ai-shansaji ethvity : o piharma ensherobimikon : palas nakhisi an eneh : tenermakarizin emmo.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲟⲛⲧⲱⲥ ⲅⲁⲣ ϯⲛⲁϣⲉⲛⲏⲓ: ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲁⲩⲗⲏⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩ̀ⲏⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲓⲧⲟⲧϥ: ⲉⲑⲣⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀.
rows.en: For I go truly : to the house of David : to be granted a voice : in which I will utter your honour.
rows.cop_lat: Je ontos ghar tinasheni : sha ni-avlio ente epi en-David : enta-etchi en-o-esmi evol-hitotf : ethrisaji em-petayo.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁⲫϯ ⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧϥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲑⲱϣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲒⲟⲇⲉⲁ̀: ⲁϥϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭ̀ⲙⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ⲁ̀ⲧ̀ⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁ ϩⲟⲡϥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + For God went : to the border of Judea : and spoke rejoicefully : and was accepted by Judah’s tribe.
rows.cop_lat: Je a-Efnoty ohi eratf : khen nithosh ente tiYodea : afti entef-esmi khen otheleel : a-etfili en-Youda shopf eros.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁ ⲧⲉ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲣ̅: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲛ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲑ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲙⲁⲥϥ: ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲥⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: The virgin is the tribe of Judah : that gave birth to our Saviour : and after her birth : she remained a virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Etfili en-Youda te tiparthenos : thi-etasmisi em-Pensoteer : owoh on menensa ethresmasf : as-ohi esoi emparthenos.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲅⲁⲣ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ϯⲫⲱⲛⲏ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲧⲉⲛϯ ⲛⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲉⲣⲉⲧⲓⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ.
rows.en: + Along with : archangel Gabriel : we honour you : O Mary the mother of God.
rows.cop_lat: Evol ghar heeten tifonee : ente Ghabriel pi-angelos : tenti ne em-pi-shere-tismos : o ti-theotokos Maria.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲫϯ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲓⲧⲟⲧⲉⲛ: ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ.
rows.en: Hail to you from God : hail to you from Gabriel : hail to you from us : we magnify you saying hail to you.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne evol-heeten Efnoty : shere ne evol heeten Ghabriel : shere ne evol-hitoten : je shere ne ten-etchisi emmo.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: ⲁϥϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟϥⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ⲡⲓⲁⲥⲡⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲁϥⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲥⲁϫⲓ.
rows.en: + Gabriel the holy angel : announced to the virgin : and after granting her the peace : he strengthened her saying :
rows.cop_lat: Pi-angelos ethouab Ghabriel : af-hishennofi en-tiparthenos : menensa pi-aspasmos : aftagro emmos khen pef-saji.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣϩⲟϯ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫⲓⲙⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ: ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲧⲉⲣⲁⲉⲣⲃⲟⲕⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϣⲏⲣⲓ.
rows.en: “Do not be afraid Mary : for you have found peace unto the Lord : for you shall conceive : and give birth to a Son.
rows.cop_lat: Je em-pererhoti Mariam : arejimi ghar en-o-ehmot : khaten Efnoty hippe ghar tera-er-voki : owoh entemisi en-o-shiri.

rows.cop: Ⲉϥⲉ̀ϯ ⲛⲁϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲫϯ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ϥ̀ⲛⲁⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ: ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: + And the Lord God shall give Him : the throne of David His father : and will reign over the house : of Jacob forever.”
rows.cop_lat: Ef-eti naf enje Epetchoise Efnoty : em-pi-ethronos ente David pefiot : efna-eroro ejen ep-ee enYakob : sha eneh ente pi-eneh.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ
rows.en: For this we glorify you : as the mother of God : always intercede to God : on our behalf to forgive our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenti-o-o ne : hos Theotokos enseyo niven : matiho Epetchoise e-ehri egon : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲱⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O virgin : the true queen indeed : hail to the pride of our race : who bore for us Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne o tiparthenos : ti oro emmi en alithini : shere ep-shosho ente pen-genos : ari egfo nan en Emmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: We ask you, remember us : O faithful advocate : before our Lord Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-ti ho ari-pen-meve : o-ti epros-ta-tis eten hot : nahren Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: VIRGIN MARY’S KIAHK DOXOLOGY
[Kiahk Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲛ̀ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ.
rows.en: + The adornment of the virgin : Mary the daughter of King David : at the right hand of Jesus Christ : the beloved Son of God.
rows.cop_lat: Ere-epsolsel en-tiparthenos : Maria etsheri em-ep-oro David : saowinam en-Isous piEkhristos : Epshiri emEfnoty pimenrit.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲡⲓϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲇⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲯⲁⲗⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ: ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: As David the king and psalmist : has said in the psalm : upon the right hand of the throne : did stand the queen.
rows.cop_lat: Kata epsaji en-David eporo : pihimnodos khen piepsalmos : je as-ohi erats enje ti-oro : sa-owi-nam em-pi-ethronos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲱ̀ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ: ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀Ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ. ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ.
rows.en: + You are higher than the Cherubim : O mother of the God of powers : and more honoured than the Seraphim : in Heaven and on earth.
rows.cop_lat: Te-etchosi eNisherobeem : o-ethmav em-Efnoty fa pi-amahi : te-tayot e-Niserafeem : khen etfe nem hijen pikahi.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ϥⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉⲥⲧⲟⲃ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ̀: ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Blessed are you, O Mary : for you have borne the true One : while remaining virgin : and your virginity ever sealed.
rows.cop_lat: O-o-niati entho Maria : je ari-egfo em-pi-alithinos : estob enje te-parthenia : ere-ohi ere-oi emparthenos.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲏⲥⲁⲏ̀ⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲉⲥⲉ̀ⲙⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + As Isaiah has said : with the voice of rejoicing : “behold, a virgin shall conceive : and bring forth Emmanuel.”
rows.cop_lat: Kata efrity etafgos : enje Isaeeas khen o-esmi entheleel : je is-alo emparthenos : es-emisi nan en-Emmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲛⲓ: ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲕⲉⲭⲁⲣⲓⲧⲱⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟ̀ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: We magnify you every day : saying with Gabriel : “hail to you, O filled with grace : the Lord is with you.”
rows.cop_lat: Ten-etchisi emmo emmeeni emeeni : engo emmos nem Ghabriel : je shere kekhari-to-meni : o Kireyos meta-so.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲱⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲏ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲟ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O virgin : the true queen indeed : hail to the pride of our race : who bore for us Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne o tiparthenos : ti oro emmi en alithini : shere ep-shosho ente pen-genos : ari egfo nan en Emmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲉⲛⲙⲉⲩⲓ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲧⲁⲧⲓⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛϩⲟⲧ: ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: We ask you, remember us : O faithful advocate : before our Lord Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-ti ho ari-pen-meve : o-ti epros-ta-tis eten hot : nahren Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: NATIVITY FEAST DOXOLOGY
[Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲣⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲙⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲛⲗⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ.
rows.en: + Our mouth is filled with joy : and our tongue with rejoicing : for our Lord Jesus Christ : was born in Bethlehem.
rows.cop_lat: Tote roon afmoh enrashi : owoh penlas khen o-theleel : je Penchoise Isous piEkhristos : avmasf khen Bethle-em.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲧ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲟⲛϧ: ⲫ̀ⲙⲁⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅.
rows.en: Hail to you, O city of our Lord : the land of the living : the home of the righteous : which is Jerusalem.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ti vaki emPennoty : etpolees ente ni-etonks : efmaenshopi en-nizike-os : ete thai te Yerosaleem.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲧ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ: ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡ̀ϫⲓⲛⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: + Hail to you, O Bethlehem : the city of prophets : who have prophesied of : the birth of Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne O Bethle-em : etpolees eni-eprofitees : enni-etav-ereprofitevin : ethve epjinmisi enEmanoeel.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲁϥϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: The true light : has shone upon us : today from the virgin : Mary the pure bride.
rows.cop_lat: Api-o-oini enta-efmi : afshai nan hoon em-foo : khen ti-parthenos Mariam : ti-shelet enkatharos.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅: ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϮⲓⲟⲇⲉⲁ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ.
rows.en: + Mary gave birth to our Saviour : the Philanthropic One : in Bethlehem Judea : according to the prophets sayings.
rows.cop_lat: Maria asmisi emPensoteer : pimairomi en-aghathos : khen Bethle-em ente tiYodea : kata ni-esmi ente ni-eprofitis.

rows.cop: Ⲏⲥⲁⲏ̀ⲁⲥ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲉⲥⲉ̀ⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Isaiah the prophet : shouts with rejoice saying : “she is giving birth : to Emmanuel our good Saviour.
rows.cop_lat: Isaeeas pi-eprofitees : osh evol khen o-esmi en-theleel : je es-emisi en-Emmanoeel : Pensoteer en-aghathos.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲛ ϧⲁ ⲛⲓⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + The heavens rejoice : along with the earth : for she bore to us : Emmanuel, we the Christian.”
rows.cop_lat: Ees nifiowi e-onof : nem epkahi theleel : je asmisi nan enEmmanoeel : anon kha ni-Ekhristianos.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲁϩϯ ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ: ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Therefore, we are rich : in all perfect gifts : and in faith let us sing : saying alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenoy enrama-o : khen niagathon etjeek evol : khen onahty tenerepsalin : engo emmos : je alleluia.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ.
rows.en: + Alleluia, alleluia : alleluia, alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : was born in Bethlehem.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : avmasf khen Bethle-em.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: This is to whom glory is due : with His good Father : and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore.
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-oo ereprepee naf : nem Pefyot en-aghathos : nem Pi-epnevma ethouab : eesjen tino nem sha eneh.

rows.en: EPIPHANY FEAST DOXOLOGY
[Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲣⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲙⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲛⲗⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁϥϭⲓⲱⲙⲥ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ.
rows.en: + Our mouth is filled with joy : and our tongue with rejoicing : for our Lord Jesus Christ : was baptised by Saint John.
rows.cop_lat: Tote roon afmoh enrashi : owoh penlas khen o-theleel : je Penchoise Isous piEkhristos : af-etchioms heeten Youannes.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲙⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲟⲥ̅ ⲫⲁ ϯϫⲓϫ ⲉⲧⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϣⲱⲃϣ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩϫⲟ.
rows.en: Heaven and earth are in truth : full of Your honour : O Lord the mighty hand : and the delivering arm.
rows.cop_lat: Alithos etfe nem epkahi : meh evol khen pektayo : O Epetchoise fa ti-jeej ete-amahi : nem pi-shobsh enreftogo.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϭⲓⲱⲙⲥ: ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ: ⲁϥⲧⲟⲩϫⲟⲛ ⲁϥⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲉⲧϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ.
rows.en: + For the Lord came : and was baptised for the sake of our sins : and He saved and redeemed us : with great mercy.
rows.cop_lat: Je Epetchoise afi owoh af-etchi-oms : ethve nen-novi anon hoon : eftogon afsoty emmon : khen onishty em-metshenheet.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲁ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲕϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲓϣⲁⲓ: ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ: Ⲫϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲁϥⲉⲣϧⲁⲣⲁⲃⲁⲓ.
rows.en: O David, come today in our midst : to proclaim in honour of this feast : saying “the voice of the Lord : God of glory, has thundered over the waters.”
rows.cop_lat: David amoo ten-mity em-fo-o : ethrekgo emeptaio em-paishai : je ep-ekhro-o emEpetchoise hijen nimooo : Efnoty ente ep-o-o afer-khara-bai.

rows.cop: Ⲏⲥⲁⲏ̀ⲁⲥ ⲁϥⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ: ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲧⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϩⲓ ⲛⲓϣⲁϥⲉⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ: ⲡ̀ⲓⲃⲓⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: + Isaiah called him : a joyful voice crying : in the wilderness : asking for full endeavor.
rows.cop_lat: Isaeeas afmoty erof : je ep-ekhro-o em-pet-osh evol : hi nishafev khen o-onof : epi-vios etgik evol.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲓⲟⲙ ⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲫⲱⲧ: ⲁ̀Ⲡⲓⲓⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ ⲕⲟⲧϥ ⲉ̀ⲫⲁϩⲟⲩ: ⲟⲩⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ⲫ̀ⲓⲟⲙ ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲫⲱⲧ: ⲙⲁⲧⲁϫⲣⲟⲕ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϭⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ.
rows.en: The river looked and fled : and the Jordan retreated : what is ailing you O sea that you escape? : stand firm that you become blessed.
rows.cop_lat: Efiom afnav owoh affot : a-Pi-Yordanees kotf efahoo : o-petshop efiom je akfot : matagrok hina enteketchi-esmo.

rows.cop: Ⲏⲡⲡⲉ ⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ: ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲇⲏⲙⲓⲟⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲥⲱⲛⲧ: ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲧⲁϩⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲟⲩϣ̀ⲑⲟⲣⲑⲉⲣ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲧⲱⲙⲧ.
rows.en: + There they are : the waters have seen the Creator and the Maker : they were frightened and overtaken : by agitation and confusion.
rows.cop_lat: Ippe avnav enje nimooo : epi-dimiorghos enref-sont : aferhoty owoh aftahoo-o : enje o-esh-tor-ter nem otomt.

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲕⲁⲗⲁⲙⲫⲱⲟⲩ: ⲡⲓⲓⲁϩϣ̀ϣⲏⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓϣⲉⲛⲥⲓϥⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲓϥⲓ.
rows.en: Rejoice O mountains and hills : thickets and cedar trees : before the face of the King : who created the breath of man.
rows.cop_lat: Rashi nito-o nem nikalam-fo-o : peyahesh-sheen nem ni-shensifi : evol kha et-hi emepho em-ep-oro : fietaf-thamio enni-nifi.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲃ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲡⲓⲱⲟⲩ ϥ̀ⲉⲣϣⲁⲩⲛⲁϥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + Holy You are O Lord and holy : holy O Lord Jesus Christ : glory is due You with Your Father : and with the comforting Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Ekouab Epetchoise owoh ekouab : ekouab Epetchoise Isous piEkhristos : pi-o-oo efer-shav naf nem Epfyot : nem Pi-epnevma emparakliton.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲓ ⲣ̀ⲁⲙⲁⲟ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲁϩϯ ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ: ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Therefore we are rich : with the fullness of good : and we chant hymns in faith : saying alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenoy enrama-o : khen niagathon etjeek evol : khen o-nahty tenerepsalin : engo emmos je alleluia.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲱⲙⲥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓⲓⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ.
rows.en: + Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : was baptised in the Jordan.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : av-etchioms khen PiYordanees.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: This is to whom glory is due : with His good Father : and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore.
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-o-oo er-eprepee naf : nem Pefyot en-aghathos : nem Piepnevma ethouab : eesjen tino nem sha eneh.

rows.en: LENT DOXOLOGY ( For Weekdays)
[Lent Tune]

rows.cop: Ϯⲛⲏⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲗⲏⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ: ⲡⲓⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ϣⲁⲩⲣⲁⲛⲁϥ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ.
rows.en: + Fasting and prayer : are the salvation for our souls : purity and righteousness : they are what please God.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-nistia nem pi-eshleel : entho-o pe epsoty en-nenepsiki : pi-tovo nem timethmi : en-etho-o pe shavranaf em-Efnoty.

rows.cop: Ϯⲛⲏⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲱ̀ⲗⲓ: ⲙ̀Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ: ϣⲁⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϭⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲫϯ.
rows.en: Fasting has raised Moses : up to the mountain : until he received the Law for us : from the Lord our God.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-nistia thi-etas-oli : emMoisees hijen pito-o : shaentef-echi em-pinomos nan : evol heeten Epetchoise Efnoty.

rows.cop: Ϯⲛⲏⲥⲧⲓⲁ̀ ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥⲱ̀ⲗⲓ: ⲛ̀Ⲏⲗⲓⲁⲥ ⲥ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲛ̀Ⲇⲁⲛⲓⲏⲗ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲗⲁⲕⲕⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲟⲩⲓ̀.
rows.en: + Fasting has raised Elijah : up to Heaven : and has saved Daniel : from the den of lions.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-nistia thi-etas-oli : enElias es-epshoi e-etfe : owoh asnohem en-Daniel : evol khen eflakos ennimowi.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲟⲧⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Our Lord Jesus Christ : has fasted for us : forty days and forty nights : to save us from our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Apenchoise Isous piEkhristos : ernesteveen eehri egon : en-ehme en-eho-o nem en-ehme en-egorh : sha entef-soten khen nen-novi.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲉⲥⲑⲉ: ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + And we too should also fast : with purity and righteousness : and let us also pray : proclaiming and saying :
rows.cop_lat: Anon hoon maren-ernesteveen : khen o-tovo nem o-methmi : owoh enten-er-epros-ev-keste : en-osh evol engo emmos.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲧⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲫⲱⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓ̀ⲱⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Our Father who art in Heaven : hallowed be Your Name : may Your Kingdom come : for Yours is the glory forever amen.
rows.cop_lat: Je Penyot et-khen nifiowi : mareftovo enje pekran : mares-ee enje tekmet-oro : je fok pe pi-o-o sha eneh amen.

rows.en: LENT DOXOLOGY (For Sundays)
[Lent Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲛⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϯⲛⲁϩⲱⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ: ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϫⲱⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ϫⲱⲟⲩ: ϯⲛⲁϫⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲣⲱⲓ.
rows.en: + I glorify Your mercies O Lord : to the end of time : and I tell out of my own mouth : and form generation to generation of Your right.
rows.cop_lat: Neknai o Patchoise tinahos emmo-oo : sha eneh ente pi-eneh : owoh isjen go-oo sha go-oo : tinago entekmethmi khen roi.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲁⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ̀ ⲁⲩϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲁ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩϩ̀ⲣⲟϣ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲓ: Ⲫϯ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲡⲁϥⲓⲁ̀ϩⲟⲙ: ϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗϩⲁⲣⲟⲓ.
rows.en: My sins have become taller : than my head and heavier than I can bear : O God hear my sighs : and cast them away from me.
rows.cop_lat: Na-anomia av-etchisi eta-afe : owoh avehrosh e-ehri egoi : Efnoty sotem epafiahom : hi-o-owi emmo-o evol haroi.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲧⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲧⲉⲗⲱⲛⲏⲥ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ: ⲁⲕϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱϥ: ⲁⲕⲭⲁ ⲛⲉϥⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: + Make me like the publican : who sinned against You : yet You had mercy on him : and forgave his sins.
rows.cop_lat: Arit em-efrity empitelonees : fi-etafernovi erok : akshenheet e-ehri egof : ak-ka nef-novi naf evol.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲧⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϯⲡⲟⲣⲛⲏ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲁⲕⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥ ⲁⲕⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲣⲁⲛⲁⲕ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ.
rows.en: Make me like the adulteress : whom You delivered : rescued and saved : because she pleased You.
rows.cop_lat: Arit em-efrity en-tipornee : thi-etak-soty emmos evol : aktonos aknohem emmos : je asranak em-pek-emtho.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲧⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲟⲛⲓ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲙⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲧⲉⲕⲟⲩ ⲓ ⲛⲁⲙ: ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + Make me like the thief : who was crucified : on Your right hand : and accepted You saying.
rows.cop_lat: Arit em-efrity em-pisoni : fi-etav-ashf ensatek-owi-nam : aferomologin emmok : empairity efgo emmos.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁⲕϣⲁⲛⲓ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
rows.en: Remember me O God : remember me O Lord : remember me O King : when I come to Your Kingdom.
rows.cop_lat: Je ari-pamev-ee O Patchoise : ari-pamevee O Panoty : aripamev-ee O Pa-o-ro : akshan-ee khen tekmet-or-oo.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲇⲉ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅: ⲁⲕϣⲱⲡ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ̀: ⲁⲕϣⲉⲛϣⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱϥ: ⲁⲕⲟⲩⲟⲣⲡϥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲓⲥⲟⲥ.
rows.en: + For You my Saviour : did accept his confession : had pity on him : and sent him to Paradise.
rows.cop_lat: Enthok ze o Pasoteer : akshop erok entefomologia : akshenheet e-ehri egof : ak-o-orpf epi-paradisos.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ϩⲱ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲁⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ϣⲁⲛⲁϩ ⲑⲓⲕ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲓ: ⲁⲣⲓⲧⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.en: And I too am a sinner : O Jesus my God and true King : have mercy on me : and make me one of those.
rows.cop_lat: Anok hoo kha prefernovi : Isous Panoty pa-oro emmi : shanaeh-thik e-ehri egoi : arit em-efrity en-owai en-nai.

rows.cop: Ϯⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲟⲩⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲏⲧ: ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ: ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: + I know You are righteous : kind and merciful : remember me in Your mercy : to the end of time.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-soo-on je enthok Oaghathos : enrefshenheet owoh en-naeet : ari-pamev-ee khen peknai : sha eneh ente pi-eneh.

rows.cop: Ϯⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲟϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕϫⲱⲛⲧ: ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲟⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲙ̀ⲃⲟⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϯⲥ̀ⲃⲱ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲉⲧⲁⲧⲉ̀ⲙⲓ.
rows.en: I beg You O Jesus my Lord : do not admonish me with Your anger : and do not enlighten my ignorance : with your rebuke.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-toveh emmok O Patchoise Isous : empersohi emmoi khen pek-gont : oze on khen pek-emvon : em-pertiesvo enta-metat-emi.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲟⲧϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲱⲟⲛϧ: ϣⲁⲛⲁϩ̀ⲑⲏⲕ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲉⲧϫⲱⲃ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲟⲙⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉⲙⲃⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + For You do not want the sinner : to die but to repent and live : have pity on my weakness : and do not look angrily upon me.
rows.cop_lat: Je eko-osh em-efmo-o an em-pirefernovi : em-efrity entef-kotf owoh entef-onkh : shan-ehthik entametgob : em-persoms eroi khen o-emvon.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲓⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲓⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲁⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲱⲡ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲁⲓⲧⲟⲩ. : : :
rows.en: I have sinned O Lord Jesus : I have sinned O Jesus Father : O my King do not hold me responsible : for the sins I have committed.
rows.cop_lat: Ay-ernovi Isous Patchoise : ay-ernovi Isous Panoty : pa-oro em-perop eroi : enninovi etai-ai-to.

rows.cop: Ϯϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅: ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲙⲉⲑⲛⲁⲏⲧ ⲧⲁϩⲟⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁⲛⲁⲛⲕⲏ: ⲉⲧϯ ⲟⲩⲃⲉ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲯⲩⲭⲏ.
rows.en: + I beg of You : My redeemer : let Your mercies overtake me : and save us form the hardships that assault me.
rows.cop_lat: Ti-tiho erok O Pasoteer : mare nek-methna-eet tahoi : ento-nohem emmoi khen ni-anan-ki : et-ti ove eta-epsi-ki.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲡⲉⲣϩⲓ ⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲙⲉⲧⲁⲧⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ϩⲱϥ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲟⲇⲟⲙⲁ: ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲧⲁⲕⲟⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ϩⲱϥ ⲛ̀Ⲅⲟⲙⲟⲣⲣⲁ.
rows.en: Do not burn me for my ignorance : as You did to Sodom : and do not destroy me : as You did to Gomorrah.
rows.cop_lat: Em-per-hi ekrom etamet-atso-on : em-efrity hoof en-Sodoma : oze on em-pertakoi : emefrity hoof en-Gomora.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲉⲙⲏⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲣⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲛⲉⲩⲏ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲉⲣⲙⲉⲧⲁⲟⲓⲛ: ⲁⲕⲭⲁ ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: But do with me : as You did with people of Nineveh : who repented : and You forgave their sins.
rows.cop_lat: Alla Patchoise ari-owi nemi : em-efrity ennirem Ninevee : nai etav-er-meta-oin : akka no-novi no-o evol.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲉⲕⲙⲉⲑⲛⲁⲏⲧ: ⲧⲁϩⲟⲓ Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲓⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲁⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲭⲁⲣⲱⲥ.
rows.en: Let Your mercies O God come quickly : O my Lord that I may cry out : with these people : in an unceasing voice.
rows.cop_lat: Alla mare nek-methna-it : tahoi Patchoise khen o-ees : enta-osh evol nem pay-la-os : khen o-esmi en-atkharos.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ϯⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲫϯ Ⲡⲁⲥⲱ̅ⲣ̅: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲓ̀ⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϩⲁⲡ ⲛⲉⲙⲏⲓ: ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓϫⲱⲃ ⲛ̀ⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Thus O Lord God my redeemer : I ask of You : not to judge me : for I am weak and sinful.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay ti-toveh emmok : Epetchoise Efnoty Pasoteer : emper-eeree en-o-hap nemi : anok kha pigob en-refer-novi.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲃⲱⲗ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲭⲱ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲡⲁⲣⲁⲡ̀ⲧⲱⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲟϣ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.en: But absolve me and forgive me : for You are righteous and a Philanthropic One : have mercy on us : for Your mercy is great.
rows.cop_lat: Alla vool evol ko-ni evol : en-na-paraeptoma etosh : hoos aghathos owoh emmairomi : nai nan kata peknishty en-nai.

rows.en: PALM SUNDAY
(Sha’anenee Tune)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲍⲓⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥⲟⲩⲁⲓ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉⲛϣⲁⲓ: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲁϩⲥⲁϩⲛⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Blow the trumped at the new moon : with the sound of the instruments : on your festive day : for it is an order from God.
rows.cop_lat: Arisalpezeen khen osowai : khen o-esmi ensalpengos : khen oe-ho-oo entenshai : je o-ah-sahni en-Theos.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉⲧϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲗⲟϥ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲱ̀: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅: ⲟⲩⲡⲉ ⲡⲁⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ.
rows.en: He who sits above the Cherubim : rode on a colt : and entered Jerusalem : O what great humility.
rows.cop_lat: Fiet-hemsi hijen Nisherobim : aftalof eo-e-oo : afshe ekhon eYerosalem : ope painishti enthevio.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲯⲁⲗⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ. Ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲟⲛ ⲁϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲕⲟⲩϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲱⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲟⲩⲉⲙϭⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲉⲃⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ.
rows.en: As David has said : in the book of the Psalms : “Blessed is He who comes in : the Name of the Lord of Hosts.” And again he said : “Out of the mouths of the babes : and young infants : You have perfected praise.”
rows.cop_lat: Kata efrity etafgos : enje David khen pi-epsalmos : je efesmaro-ot enje fiethnio : khen efran emEpetchoise ente nigom. Palin on afgo emmos : je evol khen ro-oo enhankoji : en-alo-owi nem ni-eth-o-emetchi : enthok aksebte piesmo.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲁϥϫⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲗⲟⲩϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲱⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Then David the spirit bearer : completed his saying : “Out of the mouths of babes : and young infants likewise say.”
rows.cop_lat: Tote afgok evol empisaji : ente David piEpnevma toforos : je evol khen ro-oo enhankoji : en-alo-owi empairiti efgo emmos.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲉϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲉϩⲥⲓ: ⲁⲩϫⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: Ⲱⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙ̀ⲠⲓⲒⲥⲗ̅.
rows.en: They praise Him watchfully : saying “this is Emmanuel : Hosanna in the highest : this is the King of Israel.”
rows.cop_lat: Sehos erof khen o-nehsi : avje fay pe Emmanoeel : osanna khen ni-etet-chosi : fay pe e-poro empi-Israel.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ: ⲁⲛⲓⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲙⲠϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲉ̀ϣⲗⲏⲗⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲇⲟⲝⲟⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Ascribe to the Lord O sons of God : ascribe to the Lord glory and honour : rejoice in our God : with doxologies of blessing.
rows.cop_lat: Ani-owi emEpetchoise eni-shiri ente Efnoty : ani-owi em-Epetchoise en-o-oo nem otayo : eshlilowi evol em-Pennoty : khen hanzoxologia enesmo.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲑⲟⲕ Ⲫϯ ϥ̀ⲉⲣϣⲁⲩ ⲛⲁⲕ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓϫⲱ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ϯ ⲛⲁⲕ: ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲉⲩⲭⲏ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ.
rows.en: Praise is due to You O God : in Zion and Jerusalem : they send to You prayers : unto the ages.
rows.cop_lat: Enthok Efnoty efershav nak : enje pigo khen Sion : nem Yerosaleem eveti nak : enhan-evki sha ni-e-on.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲫⲁⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲗ̅: ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲱⲙ.
rows.en: Hosanna in the highest : this is the King of Israel : blessed is He who comes in : the Name of the Lord of Hosts.
rows.cop_lat: Osanna khen nietetchosee : fay pe ep-oro em-pi-Israel : efesmaro-ot enje fiethneyo : khen efran em-Epetchoise ente nigom.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟⲩⲟ̀ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.en: We praise and glorify Him : and exalt Him above all : as a good one and lover of mankind : have mercy on us according to Your great mercy.
rows.cop_lat: Tenhoos erof tenti-ooo naf : tenerho-oo etchisi emmof : hoos aghathos owoh ammairomi : nai nan kata peknishty ennai.

rows.en: RESURRECTION & FIFTY DAYS DOXOLOGY
[ Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲣⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲙⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲛⲗⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: + Our mouth is filled with joy : and our tongue with rejoicing : for our Lord Jesus Christ : has risen from the dead.
rows.cop_lat: Tote roon afmoh en-rashi : owoh penlas khen otheleel : je Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : aftonf evol khen ni-eth-mo-ot.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲱⲣϥ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ: ⲁϥⲑ̀ⲣⲉⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲟⲛ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϣⲉⲛϣⲁϥ: ⲛ̀ⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
rows.en: By His power He abolished death : and made life to shine on us : He who descended to : the lower parts of the earth.
rows.cop_lat: Afkorpf em-efmo khen tefgom : af-ethre-ep-onkh ero-oini eron : enthof on fi-etaf-shen-shaf : enima etsapeseet em-ephaki.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲉⲛϯ: ⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲁⲩⲉⲣϩⲟϯ: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲛⲁⲕϩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩϣ̀ϫⲉⲙϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲁⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ.
rows.en: + The gate keepers of Hades : saw Him, and were afraid : He abolished the pangs of death : and He was not held by it.
rows.cop_lat: Ni-emnot ente amenti : avnav erof averhoty : aftako enni-nak-hi emefmo : empo-esh-gemgom en-amoni emmof.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥϧⲟⲙϧⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ: ⲁϥⲕⲱϣ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲙⲟⲭⲗⲟⲩⲥ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲛⲓⲡⲓ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ.
rows.en: He has broken the gates of brass : and cut asunder the bars of iron : and brought out His elect : with joy and rejoicing .
rows.cop_lat: Af-khom-khem enhanpilee en-ehmot : afkosh en-hanmokhlos em-venipi : afini en-nef-sotp evol : khen o-onof nem otheleel.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲟ̀ⲗⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ: ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϥⲙⲁⲛ̀ⲉⲙⲧⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲛⲁϩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲟⲛϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: + He lifted them up with Him : into His place of rest : he saved them for the sake of His holy name : and revealed His power to them.
rows.cop_lat: Af-oloo e-epet-chisi nemaf : ekhon enef-maen-emton : afnahmo ethve pefran : af-o-onh entefgom no-oo evol.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲁϩϯ ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲓⲛ: ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Therefore, we are rich : in all perfect gifts : and in faith let us sing : saying alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenoy en-ramao : khen ni-agathon etgik evol : khen o-nah-ty tener-epsalin : engo emmos je alleluia.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲕ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: + Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the King of glory : has risen from the dead.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Isous piEkhristos ep-oro ente epo-oo : aftonf evol khen ni-ethmo-ot.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡ̀ⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: This is to whom glory is due : with His good Father : and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore.
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-o-oo er-ep-repi naf : nem Pefyot enaghathos : nem Piepnevma ethouab : eesjen tino nem sha eneh.

rows.en: RESURRECTION – ARCHANGEL MICHAEL
[ Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲥⲁⲧ̀ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟ̀ⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ϥⲁⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ: ⲁⲩⲓ̀ ⲁⲩⲕⲱϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲇⲏ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ.
rows.en: At the resurrection of Christ : the women carrying fragrant oil : came and sought earnestly : and Michael appeared to them.
rows.cop_lat: Sa-etanastasis ente piEkhristos : enje nihiomi emfaisojen : av-ee avkoti khen oespozi : afo-onh no-oo enje Mikhaeel.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉϥⲇ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁϥⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ: ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲥⲉⲧⲉⲃⲣⲏϫ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉϥϩⲉⲃⲥⲱ ⲥ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲃϣ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲭⲓⲱⲛ.
rows.en: His appearance became : illuminated like lightning : and his clothes : became white like snow.
rows.cop_lat: Pef-ezmos ze nafoi em-efreety : enosetevrig en-o-oini : owoh tefhebso esoobsh : em-efreety enosheion.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ̀ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟ̀ⲙⲓ ⲙ̀ϥⲁⲓⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ: ϫⲉ ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲕⲱϯ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϥ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ϥ̀ⲭⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲓ ⲙⲁ ⲁⲛ.
rows.en: He answered and said : to the women carrying the spices : “who are you looking for : He is risen He is not here.”
rows.cop_lat: Afero-oo owoh pegaf : en-ni-hiomi emfaisojen : je fi-etenkoti ensof : aftonf efki empai ma-an.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲱⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲁϣⲉⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ: ⲁ̀ϫⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ̀ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ.
rows.en: Now go quickly : tell His apostles : He has risen from the dead : as He said to you.
rows.cop_lat: Yos owoh mashenoten : agos en-nef-apostolos : je aftonf evol khen niethmo-ot : kata efriti etafgos noten.

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ϫⲉ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲁϣϥ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ: ϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ ϥ̀ⲛⲁⲉⲣϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ϯⲅⲁⲗⲓⲗⲉⲁ̀ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲩ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲓϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ.
rows.en: Rejoice for He who was crucified : arose and goes before you : to Galilee there you will see Him : behold I have told you.
rows.cop_lat: Rashi je fi-etaf-ashf aftonf : hipe efna-ershorp eroten : eti-galileya tetennav erof emmav : je aygos noten.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲱ̀ Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓϥⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲕϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Great is your honour : O Michael the head of the heavenly : for you preached to us : the resurrection of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: O-nishty ghar pe pektaio : o-Mikhaeel ep-arkhon enna nifiowi : je enthok etakhishenofi nan : khen ti-anastasis em-piEkhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲱ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲱⲑⲓⲥ ⲇⲓ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ: ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥ ⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲱⲛ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕϯ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ.
rows.en: O You who were crucified for us : O Christ the King of glory : You have risen from the dead : and granted us Your joy.
rows.cop_lat: O estavros zi eemas : opi-Ekhristos ep-oro ente ep-o-oo : anastas ekton nekron : owoh akti nan empekonof.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲯⲁⲗⲡⲓⲥⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O announcer of the resurrection : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen e-ehri egon : o pi-epsalpistis ente ti-anastasis : Mikhaeel ep-arkhon enna nifiowi : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: ASCENSION DOXOLOGY
[Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ: ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ.
rows.en: + And after forty days : he ascended to the heavens : with honour and glory : and sat at the right hand of His Father.
rows.cop_lat: Owoh menensa ehme eneho-o : afshenaf e-epshoi enifiowi : khen o-oo nem o-tayo : afhemsi sa-owinam em-Pefyot.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲡⲉϫⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅: ϫⲉ ϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁⲧⲁⲟⲩⲓⲛⲁⲙ.
rows.en: As David has said : by the Holy Spirit : “the Lord said to my Lord : sit at My right Hand.”
rows.cop_lat: Kata efrity etafgos : enje David khen Pi-epnevma ethouab : je pege Epetchoise em-Patchoise : je hemsi sata-owi-nam.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩϭⲛⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲁ̀ⲙⲁϩⲓ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲁ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲝⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ̀: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ.
rows.en: + The heavenly and the earthly : were subdued unto him : the principalities, the authorities : and them that are under the earth.
rows.cop_lat: Av-etchi-nego-o em-pefamahi : enje na etfe nem na epkahi : ni-archi nem ni-exoseya : nem nietsapeseet em-epkahi.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁⲩϩⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϧ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ: ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲁⲩϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ.
rows.en: All the powers of Heaven : fell down and worshipped Him : the heavenly and the earthly : praised Him and blessed Him.
rows.cop_lat: Nigom tiro ente nifiowi : avhito e-ekhri av-o-osh emmof : na nifiowi nem na-epkahi : khen hanesmo avhos erof.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲥⲁⲛⲓⲙⲁⲛ̀ϣⲁⲓ: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ.
rows.en: + He ascended to the heavens : towards the east : that He may send us : the Spirit of Truth the Comforter.
rows.cop_lat: Afshenaf e-epshoi e-etfe : ente etfe sani-ma-enshai : hina entef-o-orp nan empi-parakliton : Piepnevma ente timethmi.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲗⲩⲙⲯⲓⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϣⲁⲛⲁϩ̀ⲑⲏϥ ϧⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Therefore we glorify : his holy ascension : that He may compassion on us : and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay maren-ti-ooo : entef-analem-epsis ethouab : maren-shanaeh-thif kharon : entef ka nen-novi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ.
rows.en: + Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Christ has risen from the dead : and ascended to Heaven.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : piEkhristos aftonf evol khen ni-ethmo-ot : owoh afshenaf eepshoi enni-fi-owi.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡ̀ⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: This is to whom glory is due : with His good Father : and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore.
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-o-oo er-eprepee naf : nem Pefyot en-aghathos : nem Piepnevma ethouab : eesjen tino nem sha eneh.

rows.en: PENTECOST DOXOLOGY
[Joyful Tune]

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩⲑⲱⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲡⲉⲛⲧⲏⲕⲟⲥⲧⲏ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲁϩⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ: ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁ ϯⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ.
rows.en: + On the day of Pentecost : the apostles met : on Mount Zion : after the resurrection.
rows.cop_lat: Av-tho-oty enje niapostolos : khen epshai en-ti-pentikosti : khen o-ahmi ente Sion : menensa ti-anastasees.

rows.cop: ⲀⲠⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲁϥⲙ̀ⲧⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: The Spirit the Comforter : that descended from Heaven : settled on each one of the : holy apostles.
rows.cop_lat: A pi-Epnevma emparakliton : etafi epeseet evol khen etfe : af-emton ejen ef-owai ef-owai : ente niapostolos ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲗⲁⲥ ⲉⲩⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲭ̀ⲣⲱⲙ: ⲁⲩⲫⲱϣ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲉϥⲭⲱⲣⲁ.
rows.en: + They spoke with fiery tongues : in many languages : and divided up the world among themselves : for every one of them in his own area.
rows.cop_lat: Avsaji khen hanmish enlas : khen hanlas evoi en-ekrom : avfosh e-ehrav e-epkahi tirf : ef-owai ef-owai kata tefkora.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲛⲁϩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲁⲩⲓⲣⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛϫⲟⲙ: ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲟⲝⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙ̀ⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩ.
rows.en: They spoke to all the nations : of the faith that was Christ’s : and worked out miracles : and showed miraculous powers before kings.
rows.cop_lat: Avsaji nem ni-ethnos tiro : khen efnahty ente pi-Ekhristos : aviri enhan-esh-firi nem hangom : emparazoxon empe-emtho enni-or-oo.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ.
rows.en: + Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Christ has ascended to Heaven : and sent to us the Paraclete.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia: piEkhristos afshenaf eepshoi enni-fi-owi : afo-orp nan em-piparakliton.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: This is to whom glory is due : with His good Father : and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore.
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-o-oo er-eprepee naf : nem Pefyot en-aghathos : nem piEpnevma ethouab : eesjen tino nem sha eneh.

rows.en: EXTRA DOXOLOGIES – LAST VERSES ONLY
Feast of the Circumcision:
(6 Toubah)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲱⲡ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲉⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : accepted the circumcision.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afshop erof empisevi.

rows.en: Saint Jonah’s fasting:

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϩⲓⲱⲓϣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲛⲉⲩⲏ: Ⲓⲱⲛⲁ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray to the Lord on our behalf : O preacher of the people of Ninevah : Jonah the Prophet : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise eehri egon : o pirefhi-oish ente nirem Ninevi : Youna pi-eprofitees : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Archangel Michael:
(Standard. For the 50 days of the Ressurection, see page 76)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ̅ⲡ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O holy archangel : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen e-ehri egon : o pi-archi-angelos ethouab : Mikhaeel eparkhon en-na nifiowi : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Feast of the Transfiguration:
(13 Misra)

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲱⲃⲧ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲁⲃⲱⲣ.
rows.en: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : was transfigured on Mount Tabour.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : alleluia alleluia : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : af-shobt ejen pito-oo en-Tabour.

rows.en: THIRD HOUR AGPIA PRAYER
THE PRAYER OF THE THIRD HOUR
The prayer of the third hour of this blessed day is offered to Christ my King and my God, beseeching Him to forgive my sins.
From the psalms of our teacher David the prophet and king may his blessings be with us all. Amen.
PSALM 20 (19)

May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble, may the name of Jacob defend you, may He send you help from the sanctuary, and strengthen you out of Zion, may He remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice. May He grant you according to your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your purpose. We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners!

May the Lord fulfill all your petitions. Now I know that the Lord saves His anointed, He will answer him from His holy Heaven with the saving strength of His right hand. Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we will remember the name of the Lord our God. They have bowed down and fallen, but we have risen and stand upright. Save, Lord! May the King answer us when we call. Alleluia .
PSALM 23 (22)

The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want. He makes me to lie down in green pastures, He leads me beside the still waters. He restores my soul, He leads me in the paths of righteousness for His name’s sake. Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me, Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies, You anoint my head with oil, my cup runs over. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever. Alleluia .
PSALM 24 (23)

The earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness, the world and those who dwell therein. For He has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the waters. Who may ascend into the hill of the Lord? Or who may stand in His holy place? He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who has not lifted up his soul to an idol, nor sworn deceitfully.

He shall receive blessings from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation. This is Jacob, the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face. Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors!

And the King of glory shall come in. Who is this King glory? The Lord is strong and mighty, the Lord is mighty in battle. Lift up your heads, O you gates! And lift them up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of glory. Alleluia .
PSALM 26 (25)

Vindicate me, O Lord, for I have walked in my integrity. I have also trusted in the Lord, I shall not slip. Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my mind and my heart. For Your loving-kindness is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth. I have not sat with idolatrous mortals, nor will I go in with hypocrites.

I have hated the congregation of evil-doers, and will not sit with the wicked. I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about Your altar, O Lord, that I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all Your wondrous works. Lord, I have loved the habitation of Your house, and the place where Your glory dwells.

Do not gather my soul together with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men, in whose hands is a sinister scheme, and whose right hand is full of bribes. But as for me, I will walk in my integrity, redeem me and be merciful to me. My foot stands in an even place; in the congregations I will bless the Lord. Alleluia .
PSALM 29 (28)

Give unto the Lord, O you mighty ones, give unto the Lord glory and strength. Give unto the Lord the glory due to His name, worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness. The voice of the Lord is over the waters, the God of

glory thunders, the Lord is over many waters. The voice of the Lord is powerful, the voice of the Lord is full of majesty. The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars, yes, the Lord splinters the cedars of Lebanon. He makes them also skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox. The voice of the Lord divides the flames of fire.

The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness, the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh. The voice of the Lord makes the deer give birth, and strips the forests bare, and in His temple everyone says, “Glory!” The Lord sat enthroned at the flood, and the Lord sits as King, forever. The Lord will give strength to His people, the Lord will bless His people with peace. Alleluia .
PSALM 30 (29)

I will extol You, O Lord, for You have lifted me up, and have not let my foes rejoice over me. O Lord my God, I cried out to You, and You have healed me. O Lord, You have brought my soul up from the grave, You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit. Sing praise to the Lord, you saints of His, and give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.

For His anger is but for a moment, His favour is for life, weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning. Now in my prosperity I said, “I shall never be moved.” Lord, by Your favour You have made my mountain stand strong, You hid Your face, and I was troubled. I cried out to You, O Lord, and to the Lord I made supplication : “What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit?

Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your truth? Hear, O Lord, and have mercy on me, Lord, be my helper!” You have turned for me my mourning into dancing, You have put off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness, to the end that my glory may sing praise to You and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to You forever. Alleluia .
PSALM 34 (33)

I will bless the Lord at all times, His praise shall continually be in my mouth. My soul shall make its boast in the Lord, the humble shall hear of it and be glad. Oh, magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt His name together. I sought the Lord, and He heard me, and delivered me from all my fears. They looked to Him and were radiant, and their faces were not ashamed. This poor

man cried out, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles. The angel of the Lord encamps all around those who fear Him, and delivers them. Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good, blessed is the man who trusts in Him! Oh, fear the Lord, you His saints! There is no want to those who fear Him.

The young lions lack and suffer hunger, but those who seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing. Come, you children, listen to me, I will teach you the fear of the Lord. Who is the man who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good? Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile. Depart from evil, and do good, seek peace, and pursue it.

The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and His ears are open to their cry. The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth. The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles. The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves such as have a contrite spirit.

Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them all. He guards all his bones, not one of them is broken. Evil shall slay the wicked, and those who hate the righteous shall be condemned. The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, and none of those who trust in Him shall be condemned. Alleluia .
PSALM 41 (40)

Blessed is he who considers the poor, the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble. The Lord will preserve him and keep him alive, and he will be blessed on the earth, You will not deliver him to the will of his enemies. The Lord will strengthen him on his bed of illness, You will sustain him on his sickbed.

I said “Lord, be merciful to me, heal my soul, for I have sinned against You.” My enemies speak evil of me, “When will he die, and his name perish?” And if he comes to see me, he speaks vain words, His heart gathers iniquity to itself, when he goes out, he tells it. All who hate me whisper together against me, against me they devise my hurt. An evil disease, they say “clings to him.

And now that he lies down, he will rise up no more.” Even my own familiar friend in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, has lifted up his heel against me. But You, O Lord, be merciful to me, and raise me up, that I may repay them. By this I know that You are well pleased with me, because my enemy does not triumph over me. As for me, You uphold me in
integrity, and set me before Your face forever. Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen. Alleluia .
PSALM 43 (42)

Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation, Oh, deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man! For You are the God of my strength, why do You cast me off? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy? Oh, send out Your light and Your truth!

Let them lead me, let them bring me to Your holy hill and to Your tabernacle. Then I will go to the altar of God, to God my exceeding joy, and on the harp I will praise You, O God, my God. Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him, the help of my countenance and my God. Alleluia .
PSALM 45 (44)

My heart is overflowing with a good theme, I recite my composition concerning the King, my tongue is the pen of a ready writer. You are fairer than the sons of men, grace is poured upon Your lips, therefore God has blessed You forever. Gird Your sword upon Your thigh, O mighty One, with Your glory and Your majesty, and in Your majesty ride prosperously because of truth, humility, and righteousness, and Your right hand shall teach You awesome things.
Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies, the peoples fall under You. Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, a scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your Kingdom.

You love righteousness and hate wickedness, therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness more than Your companions. All Your garments are scented with myrrh and aloes and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad. Kings daughters are among Your honourable women, at Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.

Listen, O daughter, consider and incline your ear, forget your own people also, and your fathers house, so the king will greatly desire your beauty, because He is your Lord, worship Him. And the daughter of Tyre will be there with a gift, the rich among people will seek your favour. The royal daughter is all glorious within the palace, her clothing is woven with gold. She shall be brought to the king

in robes of many colours, the virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to You. With gladness and rejoicing they shall be brought, they shall enter the king’s palace. Instead of Your fathers shall be Your sons, whom You shall make princes in all the earth. I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations, therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever. Alleluia .
PSALM 46 (45)

God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we will not fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea, though its waters roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with its swelling. There is a river whose streams shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacle of the Most High.

God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved, God shall help her, just at the break of dawn. The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved, He uttered His voice, the earth melted. The Lord of hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our refuge. Come, behold the works of the Lord, who has made desolations in the earth.

He makes wars cease to the end of the earth, He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two, He burns the chariot in the fire. Be still, and know that I am God, I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth! The Lord of hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our refuge. Alleluia .
PSALM 47 (46)

Oh, clap your hands, all you people! Shout to God with the voice of triumph! For the Lord Most High is awesome, He is a great King over all the earth. He will subdue the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet. He will choose our inheritance for us, the excellence of Jacob whom He loves. God has gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises! For God is the King of all the earth, sing praises with understanding. God reigns over the nations, God sits on His holy throne. The princes of the people have gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God, He is greatly exalted. Alleluia .
THE GOSPEL

“But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all things that I said to you. “Peace I leave with you, My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

You have heard me say to you ‘I am going away and coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice because I said, ‘I am going to the Father’, for My Father is greater than I. And now that I have told you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe. I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.

But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father gave me commandment, so I do. Arise let us go from here. I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser. Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit He takes away, and every branch that bears fruit He prunes, that it may bear more fruit. You are already clean because of the word which I have spoken to you. Abide in me, and I in you.”
Glory be to God forever. Amen.

O Good Lord, do not take your Holy Spirit away from us, this which You sent upon Your holy disciples and honourable apostles at the third hour. Create a pure heart in me, O God and put a new and loyal Spirit within me, do not banish me from Your presence and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.

rows.en: O Lord, who sent Your Holy Spirit upon the Holy disciples and honourable apostles at the third hour, do not take this away from us, O righteous Lord.

We ask You our Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of God the Logos, renew within us a right and life giving spirit, a filial spirit of chastity, holiness, justice and authority. Our Almighty God, the light of our souls, illuminating every person who comes into this world, have mercy upon us.

rows.en: O mother of God, full of grace, you are the true vine that carries the fruit of life. We ask you and all the apostles to pray for the salvation of our souls. Blessed be the Lord our God whom we praise each day, because He prepares our path as He is the God of our Salvation.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and amen.

rows.en: O Heavenly King, the Spirit of truth, the comforter, who is everywhere and fills everybody. You are the treasure of goodness and giver of life, we ask You to graciously come and dwell within us, purify us from iniquity and save our souls.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.

rows.en: Lord, abide with us as You did with the apostles, when You gave them Your peace, we ask You to grant us Your peace, our Saviour, save us and spare our souls.

rows.en: Whenever we stand in Your Holy Temple, we are considered as those who abide in Heaven, O mother of God, you are the gate of Heaven, open to us the door of mercy.

Holy God, holy Almighty, Holy Immortal, who was born of the virgin, have mercy upon us. Holy God, holy Almighty, Holy Immortal, who was crucified for our sake, have mercy upon us. Holy God, holy Almighty, Holy Immortal, who arose from the dead and ascended to the heavens, have mercy upon us. Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit, now and forevermore Amen.
O Holy Trinity, have mercy upon us. O Holy Trinity, have mercy upon us. O Holy Trinity, have mercy upon us.
O Lord, forgive us our sins. O Lord, forgive us our trespasses. O Lord, forgive us our transgressions.

O God be with those who are sick, heal them for the sake of Your Holy Name. O Lord repose the souls of those who have passed over to You. O Lord, who is without fault, have mercy upon us, support us and accept our prayers, for Thine is the glory, honour, and triple holiness. Lord have mercy, Lord have mercy, Lord bless us. Amen.
O Lord make us worthy to pray thankfully; Our Father, who art in Heaven…

Hail to Saint Mary, full of grace, the ever-virgin, mother of God, mother of Christ, may you lift our prayers to Your beloved Son to forgive us our sins. Hail to the holy virgin, mother of the True Light, Christ our Lord, may You ask our Lord to have mercy upon our souls and forgive us our sins.

O virgin Mary, mother of God, who pleads for mankind, pray for the forgiveness of our sins before Christ to whom you gave birth. Hail to you, O virgin and true queen, Hail to the pride of mankind, mother of Emmanuel, remember us O faithful pleader, before our Lord Jesus Christ, may He forgive us our sins.
SIXTH HOUR AGPIA PRAYER
THE PRAYER OF THE SIXTH HOUR
The prayer of the sixth hour of this blessed day is offered to Christ my King and my God, beseeching Him to forgive my sins.
From the psalms of our teacher David the prophet and king may his blessings be with us all. Amen.
PSALM 54 (53)

Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your strength. Hear my prayer, O God, give ear to the words of my mouth. For strangers have risen up against me, and oppressors have sought after my life, they have not set God before them. Behold, God is my helper, the Lord is with those who uphold my life.

He will repay my enemies for their evil. Cut them off in Your truth. I will freely sacrifice to You, I will praise Your name, O Lord, for it is good. For He has delivered me out of all trouble, and my eye has seen its desire upon my enemies. Alleluia .
PSALM 57 (56)

Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me! For my soul trusts in You, and in the shadow of Your wings I will make my refuge, until these calamities have passed by. I will cry out to God Most High. To God who performs all things for me. He shall send from Heaven and save me. He reproaches the one who would swallow me up. God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.

My soul is among lions, I lie among the sons of men who are set on fire, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword. Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, let Your glory be above all the earth. They have prepared a net for my steps, my soul is bowed down, they have dug a pit before me, into the midst of it they themselves have fallen.

My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast, I will sing and give praise. Awake, my glory! Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn. I will sing to You among the nations. For Your mercy reaches unto the heavens, and Your truth unto the clouds. Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, let Your glory be above all the earth. Alleluia .
PSALM 61 (60)

Hear my cry, O God, attend to my prayer. From the end of the earth I will cry to You, when my heart is overwhelmed, lead me to the rock that is higher than I. For You have been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy. I will abide in Your tabernacle forever, I will trust in the shelter of Your wings.

For You, O God, have heard my vows, You have given me the heritage of those who fear Your name. You will prolong the king’s life, His years as many generations. He shall abide before God forever. Oh, prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him! So I will sing praise to Your name forever, that I may daily perform my vows. Alleluia .
PSALM 63 (62)

O God, You are my God, early will I seek You, my soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You in a dry and thirsty land where there is no water. So I have looked for You in the sanctuary, to see Your power and Your glory. Because Your loving-kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise You.

Thus I will bless You while I live, I will lift up my hands in Your name. My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness, and my mouth shall praise You with joyful lips. When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches. Because You have been my help, therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.

My soul follows close behind You, Your right hand upholds me. But those who seek my life, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth. They shall fall by the sword, they shall be a portion for jackals. But the king shall rejoice in God, everyone who swears by Him shall glory, but the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped. Alleluia .
PSALM 67 (66)

God be merciful to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us. That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations. Let the people praise You, O God, let all the peoples praise You.

Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For You shall judge the people righteously, and govern the nations on earth. Let the peoples praise You, O God, let all the peoples praise You. Then the earth shall yield her increase, God, our own
God, shall bless us. God shall bless us, And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him. Alleluia .
PSALM 70 (69)
Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Make haste to help me, O Lord! Let them be ashamed and confounded who seek my life, let them be turned back and confused who desire my hurt.

Let them be turned back because of their shame, who say, “Aha, aha!” Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You, and let those who love Your salvation say continually, “Let God be magnified!” But I am poor and needy, make haste to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer, O Lord, do not delay. Alleluia .
PSALM 84 (83)

How lovely is Your tabernacle, O Lord of hosts! My soul longs, yes, even faints for the courts of the Lord, my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God. Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young – even Your altars, O Lord of hosts, my King and my God. Blessed are those who dwell in Your house, they will still be praising You.

Blessed is the man whose strength is in You, whose heart is set on pilgrimage. As they pass through the valley of Baca, they make it a spring, the rain also covers it with pools. They go from strength to strength, every one of them appears before God in Zion. O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer, give ear, O God of Jacob! O God, behold our shield, and look upon the face of Your anointed.

For a day in Your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of wickedness. For the Lord God is a sun and shield, the Lord will give grace and glory, no good thing will He withhold from those who walk uprightly. O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man who trusts in You! Alleluia .
PSALM 85 (84)

Lord, You have been favourable to Your land, You have brought back the captivity of Jacob. You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people, You have covered all their sin. You have taken away all Your wrath, You have turned

from the fierceness of Your anger. Restore us, O God of our salvation, and cause Your anger toward us to cease. Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger to all generations? Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

Show us Your mercy, O Lord, and grant us Your salvation. I will hear what God the Lord will speak, for He will speak peace to His people and to His saints, but let them not turn back to folly. Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that glory may dwell in our land.

Mercy and truth have met together, righteousness and peace have kissed each other, truth shall spring out of the earth, and righteousness shall look down from Heaven. Yes, the Lord will give what is good, and our land will yield its increase. Righteousness will go before Him, and shall make His footsteps our pathway. Alleluia .
PSALM 86 (85)

Bow down Your ear, O Lord, hear me, for I am poor and needy. Preserve my life, for I am holy, You are my God, save Your servant who trusts in You! Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I cry to You all day long. Rejoice the soul of Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul. For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, and abundant in mercy to all those who call upon You.

Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer, and attend to the voice of my supplications. In the day of my trouble I will upon You, for You will answer me. Among the gods there is none like You, O Lord, nor are there any works like Your works. All nations whom You have made shall come and worship before You, O Lord, and shall glorify Your name. For You are great, and do wondrous things, You alone are God.

Reach me Your way, O Lord, I will walk in Your truth, unite my heart to fear Your name. I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify Your name forevermore. For great is Your mercy toward me, and You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol. O God, the proud have risen against me. And a mob of violent men have sought my life, and have not set You before them.

But You, O Lord, are a God full of compassion, and gracious, long-suffering and abundant in mercy and truth. Oh, turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give Your strength to Your servant, and save the son of Your maidservant. Show me a sign for good, that those who hate me may see it and be ashamed, because You, Lord, have helped me and comforted me. Alleluia .
PSALM 87 (86)

His foundation is in the holy mountains. The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob. Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God! “I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know me, Behold, O Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia,’ This one was born there.’”

And of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself shall establish her.” The Lord will record, when He registers the peoples : “This one was born here.” Both the singers and the players on instruments say, “All my springs are in You.”. Alleluia .
PSALM 91 (90)

He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of the Lord, “He is my refuge and my fortress, My God, in Him I will trust.” Surely He shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler and from the perilous pestilence. He shall cover you with His feathers, and under His wings you shall take refuge, His truth shall be your shield and buckler.

You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day, nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that lays waste at noonday. A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, but it shall not come near you. Only with your eyes shall you look, and see the reward of the wicked.

Because you have made the Lord, who is my refuge, even the Most High, your habitation, no evil shall befall you, nor shall any plague come near your dwelling, for He shall give His angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways. They shall bear you up in their hands, lest you dash your foot against a stone.

You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra, the young lion and the serpent you shall trample under foot. Because he has set his love upon me, therefore I will deliver Him, I will set him on high, because he has known my name. He shall call upon me and I will answer Him, I will be with Him in trouble, I will deliver Him and honour Him. With long life I will satisfy Him, and show Him my salvation. Alleluia .
PSALM 93 (92)

The Lord reigns, He is clothed with majesty, the Lord is clothed, He has girded Himself with strength. Surely the world is established, so that it cannot be moved. Your throne is established from of old, You are from everlasting.

The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice, the floods lift up their waves. The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, than the mighty waves of the sea. Your testimonies are very sure, Holiness adorns Your house, O Lord, forever. Alleluia .
THE GOSPEL
(Mathew 5:1-16)

And seeing the multitudes, He went up on a mountain, and when He was seated His disciples came to Him. Then he opened His mouth and taught them saying : “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.

Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled. Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy. Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God. Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God. Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

Blessed are you when they revile and persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely for My sake. Rejoice and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in Heaven, for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you. You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt loses its flavour, how shall it be seasoned?

It is then good for nothing but to be thrown out and trampled under foot by men. You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden. Nor do they light a lamp and put it under a basket, but on a lamp stand, and it gives light to all who are in the house. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify Your Father in Heaven.”
Glory be to God forever. Amen.

O Lord, who on the sixth day, at the sixth hour You were nailed to the Cross for the sin that Adam dared to commit in Paradise. Break the bonds of our sins, Lord Christ and save us. I cried to the Lord and He heard me. Lord accept my prayer and answer my supplication, hear me in the evening and in the morning and at noon. Hear my words and spare my soul.

rows.en: O Jesus Christ, our Lord, who was nailed to the Cross at the sixth hour. You mortified sin by the cross, by your death You raised the dead; Man, whom You created with Your hands, who died to sin. O Lord, may all our pains be ended through Your life giving and healing sufferings. May our minds be saved from foolishness and worldly desires to the remembrance of Your heavenly laws.

rows.en: Now and amen.
