rows.en: Because of our many sins, we are without liberty, pretext or excuse, we can only plead to you, O virgin Mary, mother of God, to pray to whom you gave birth, because your supplications are acceptable to our Saviour, O pure mother, do not turn the sinners back, plead for them, because He to whom you gave birth is the merciful redeemer. He suffered to rescue us. O Lord, we
are helpless, we badly need Your compassion, help us for the sake of Your glory, God save us and forgive us our sins for the sake of Your Holy Name.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and amen.

rows.en: O Lord Christ, You gave salvation to the whole world when You spread Your undefiled hands on the Cross, for this all nations give You praise saying : “glory be to You O Lord”.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father and to the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
rows.ar_lat: Zoxa Patri ke Eyo Agio Epnevmati.
rows.cop_lat: ke

rows.en: O Good Lord, we worship Your incorruptible person, praying for the remission of our sins, for You were pleased to willingly go to the Cross to rescue Your creation from the slavery of the enemy. We thank You Christ, for You filled us all with joy, when You came to help the world, glory be to You.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ
rows.en: Now and forevermore amen.
rows.cop_lat: Ke neen ke-a-ee ke estose-onas ton e-onon amen.

rows.en: O mother of the Lord, full of grace, virgin Mary, we praise you, because the Cross of your Son, hades has fallen and death destroyed. We were dead before, but we have
been raised, and made worthy to inherit eternal life and to regain Paradise, for this we thankfully glorify our Immortal Lord Jesus.
We honour you, mother of True Light and glorify you, O Holy virgin mother of God, for you gave birth to the Saviour of the world. He came and saved our souls.

Glory to You, our Master and King Jesus Christ, Pride of the apostles, Crown of the Martyrs, joy of the righteous, Steadiness of the churches, remission of sins. We preach the Holy Trinity, the One Divinity, whom we worship and honour. Lord have mercy, Lord have mercy, Lord bless us. Amen.

We believe in One God, the Almighty God the Father, maker of Heaven and earth, of all things visible and invisible. We believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ the only begotten Son of the Father, before all ages; light out of light, true God out of true God, begotten not made; coessential with the Father, through whom all things came into being.

He descended from Heaven for us and for our salvation, and was incarnated of the Holy Spirit and of the virgin Mary, and became man. He was crucified for us at the time of Pontius Pilate. He suffered and was buried; arose from the dead on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures. He ascended to the heavens and sat at the right hand of His Father;

He shall also come back in His glory to judge the living and the dead; of whose Kingdom there will be no end. Truly we believe in the Holy Spirit, the life giving Lord, who proceeds from the Father, we worship and glorify Him together with the Father and the Son, who spoke in the prophets. And in one, holy, universal and Apostolic Church. We acknowledge one baptism for the remission of sins.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ϩⲓ ⲛ̀ϯ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁ̀ⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥ ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: And we look to the resurrection of the dead and the life of the world to come : amen.
rows.ar_lat: Wa nantazeroo keyamat el-amwat, wa hayat el-dahr elaaty : amen.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-gosht evol kha et-hi enti anastasis ente ni-ref mo-ot : nem pi onkh ente pi e-oon ethneyo : amen.

rows.en: TEN-O-OSHT

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡⲛⲁ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ⲟ̀ⲙⲟⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲥ.
rows.en: We worship the Father of the light : and His only begotten Son : and the Holy Spirit, the Comforter : the One in essence Trinity.
rows.cop_lat: Ten o-osht em efyot : ente pee-o-oynee : nem pef-sheeree emmonogenees : nem pee epnevma emparakleeton : teeetreyas en-omoseyos.

rows.en: SHERE MARIA

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ϯⲃⲱ: ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲗⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲉⲣϧⲉⲗⲗⲱ: ⲑⲏⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲟⲩⲱⲓ ⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ⲁⲩϫⲉⲙ ⲡⲓ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to Mary the queen : the unaged vine : that no farmer toiled : in her was found the cluster of life .
rows.cop_lat: Shere Mareya tee-ooro teevo : en alolee en ater-khelow : thee-ete em-pee-o-oy ero-oy eros : avjem pee-esmah ente ep-onkh en-khets.

rows.cop: Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Truly, the Son of God : took flesh from the virgin : she gave birth to Him, He saved us.
rows.cop_lat: Epsheeree em-Efnoty khen oo-methmee : avetchee-sarex khen tiparthenos : asmeesee emmof afsoty emmon : afka nen novee nan evol

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲉϫⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲱ̀ⲧⲁⲓϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ: ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ϫⲉ ⲁⲡⲓⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ: ⲓ̀ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϧⲏϯ.
rows.en: You have found grace, O bride : many spoke of your honour : for the Word of the Father : came and took flesh from you.
rows.cop_lat: Arejem o-ehmot o tayshelet : han-meesh avsajy e-petayo : je apeeloghos ente Efyot : e-avetchee-sarex evol enkheety.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙ ⲛ̀ⲥ̀ϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲉⲧ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲁⲥⲉⲣⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲉ̀ⲃⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ϩⲓⲙⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲣⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉⲉⲣ ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲥⲱⲛⲧ.
rows.en: Which of the women on earth : has become mother of God, but You : for while you are a woman of the faith : you became mother of the Creator.
rows.cop_lat: Nieem en-es-heemee et heejen pee-kahee : asermav em Efnoty eveel ero : je entho o-es-heemee : enrem en-kahee areer mav empee-ref-sont.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ ⲥ̀ϩⲓⲙⲓ ϭⲓⲧⲁⲓⲟ ⲁⲩϣⲁϣⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ϯⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲁ̀ⲗⲗⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲟⲩϣ̀ϥⲟϩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲑⲏⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ.
rows.en: Many women have attained honour : and gained the Kingdom : but have not reached your honour : O you, the beautiful among women.
rows.cop_lat: A-omeesh en esheemee etchee-tayo : avsha-shnee etee-metooro allah empo-eshfoo e-pe-tayo : theeethnesos khen nee-heeyomi.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲑⲟ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲡⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ: ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩϫⲉⲙ ⲡⲓ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ.
rows.en: You are the high tower : in which the Jewel was found : that is, Emmanuel : who came and dwelt in your womb.
rows.cop_lat: Entho ghar pe peeperghos : et-etchosy etavjem pee anamee en-khetf : ete fay pe Emmanoeel : etaf-e afshopee khen tenejee.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲧⲁⲓⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ̀: ⲛ̀ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲕⲁⲕⲓⲁ̀: ϯⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲛⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ̀: ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: Let us honour the virginity : of the bride without blemish : the pure, that all saintly : the mother of God, Mary.
rows.cop_lat: Marentayo enetpartheneya : enteeshelet en-atkakeya : tee-katharos em-panageya : ti-theotokos Mareya.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲉϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ: ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲥⲱⲛⲧ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲣⲉⲉⲣⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲥⲱⲛⲧ.
rows.en: You rose higher than the heavens : and you are more honoured than earth : and all the creatures on it : because you became the mother of the Creator.
rows.cop_lat: Aretcheesee ehoty : etfe te-tayot ehote epkahee : nem sont neeven ete enkhetf : je are-ermav empeerefsont.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲑⲟ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲟⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲓⲛⲩⲙⲫⲓⲟⲥ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓ ⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ.
rows.en: You are truly : the sacred place : of Jesus the groom : as the prophecies said.
rows.cop_lat: Entho ghar aleethos : peema ensheleet enkatharos : ente piEkhristos peenemfeyos : kata nee esmee emeprofeeteekon.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede for us : O lady of us all the Theo-tokos : Mary the mother of our Saviour : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehree egon : o tenchoyse en-nev teeren ti-theotokos : Mareya ethmav en Isous pi-Ekhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: (Further intercession verses may be recited.)
EPOURO

rows.cop: Ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛⲧⲉ ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: O King of peace : give us peace : establish Your peace : and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ep-ooro ente teeheereene : moy nan entek heereene : semnee nan entek heereene : ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.cop: Ϫⲱⲣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϫⲁϫⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲁⲣⲓⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲓⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉⲏ.
rows.en: Disperse the church enemies : and fortify her : to be unshakeable : forever.
rows.cop_lat: Goor evol enee gajee : ente tee-ek-ekleseya : areesoft eros : enneskem sha eneh.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲙⲏϯ ϯⲛⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: Emmanuel our God : is among us now : with His Fathers glory : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Emmanoeel Pennoty : khen ten meety teeno : khen epo-oo ente pefyot : nem pi epnevma ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲧⲉϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϣⲱⲛⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ.
rows.en: To bless us all : and purify our heart : and heal the sickness : of our souls and bodies.
rows.cop_lat: Entef esmo eron teeren : entef tovo en-nenheet : entef taletcho enneeshony : ente nen epseekee nem nen soma.

rows.cop: Ϯⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
rows.en: We worship You O Christ : with Your Good Father : and the Holy Spirit : for You have come and saved us.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-oo-osht emmok o pi-Ekhristos : nem Pekyot en aghathos : nem pee epnevma ethouab : je ak-ee aksoty emmon.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ (x41)
rows.en: Lord have mercy (x41)
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson (x41)

rows.en: + Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord of hosts…
- [1] OFFERTORY -

Glory and honour, honour and glory may be given to the Holy Trinity; the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. Grant peace and holiness to the One, Holy, universal and apostolic Church of God, Amen. Remember O Lord, those who have offered these oblations and those on whose behalf they are offered and those who are presenting them. Grant them all a heavenly reward.
rows.ar_lat: Magdan wa ekraman, ekraman wa magdan le Thaluth al-mokadass. Al-Aab wal-Ebn walRoh El-Koddous. Salaman wa bonyanan le kaneesat Allah elwaheda al waheeda alMokadassa al-game’a al-Rasoleya Amen. Ozkor Yarab allazina kadamu laka hazehi alkarabeen wa allazina kodemat a’anhom wa allazina kodemat be wasetat-hem, a’atehom kolohom al-agr alsama-e.
rows.cop_lat: O-oo nem otayo, otayo nem o-oo, ente pan agia etreyas Efyot nem Epshiri nem Piepnevma Ethouab. O hiriny nem o kot ejen ti-owi emavats Ethouab, en-katholiky en apostoliky enekekleseya ente Efnoty Amen. Ari-efmev-ee Epetchoise eni etav-eni nak ekhon ennay zoron, nem ni etav eno ego-o, nem ni etav eno evol hi-totu, moy no-o tiro empiviky pi evol khen nifiowi.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲡⲉⲣ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱⲛ ⲧⲓⲙⲓⲱⲛ ⲇⲱⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲑⲩⲥⲓⲱⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥϥⲉⲣⲟⲛⲧⲱⲛ. Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Pray for these sacred and worthy oblations, and our sacrifices and for those who offered them. Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Salu men agl hazihi alkarabeen almukadassa alkareema wa takdimatina waalazeena kadamuha.
rows.cop_lat: Eprose eveksasty e per-ton agion timion zoron to-ton ke sis-yon imon ke epros firon ton. Kiriye eleyson.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲁ̀ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟϥ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ: ⲱ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉⲕⲉ̀ⲛⲁϩⲙⲉⲛ ⲱ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉⲕⲉ̀ⲥⲟⲩⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲙⲱⲓⲧ: ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia : This is the day the Lord has made. Let us rejoice and be glad in it. O Lord save us, O Lord ease our ways. Blessed is He who comes in the Name of the Lord : alleluia.
rows.ar_lat: Alleluia : Haza howa al yawmu allazy san’ahu alRab. Falnafrah wanab-taheg feeh. Yarabu khalesna Yarabu sahel sobolana. Mubaraku al-aty be-esm alRab : alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia : Fay pepee e-ho-oo eta Epetchoise thameyof : maren theleel enten o-nof emmon en-khetf : o Epetchoise ek enahmen O Epchoise ek e-soten nen-moyt : Efesmaro-ot enje fi ethneyo Khen Efran em Epetchoise : alleluia

rows.en: * During Lent and fasting days, the above is replaced with the following:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅: ϫⲉ ⲫ̀ⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉϥⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϫⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲉϥ ⲉ̀ⲉⲣϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ: ⲛⲓⲑⲩⲥⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲫⲟⲣⲁ ϣⲟⲡⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲕ: ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia : the thought of man shall confess to You, O Lord. And the rest of thought shall keep a feast to You. The sacrifices and the offerings receive them unto You : alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia : je efmev-e enoroomi ef-e-o-onh nak evol Epetchoise. Owoh epsogp ente o-mev-e efeershai nak : nithisia nieprosfora shopo erok : alleluia.

rows.en: In the Name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, the One God. Blessed be God the Father the Almighty.
rows.ar_lat: Be-esm al-Aab wal-Ebn wal-Rouh el-Koddous Elahan Wahedan. Mobarak Allah al-Aab dabet el-kol.
rows.cop_lat: Khen Efran em Efyot nem Epshiri nem Piepnevma Ethouab O-noty eno-ot. Efesmaro-ot enje Efnoty Efyot PiPantokrator.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Amen.
rows.cop_lat: Amen.

rows.en: Blessed be His begotten Son, Christ our Lord.
rows.ar_lat: only Jesus
rows.cop_lat: Mobarak Ebnahu waheed Yasoua Massieh Rabena. elal- Efesmaro-ot enje pef Monogenees en shiri Isous pi-Ekhristos Penchoise.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Amen.
rows.cop_lat: Amen.

rows.en: Blessed be the Holy Spirit the Comforter.
rows.ar_lat: Mobarak el-Rouh Koddous el-Moa’zy.
rows.cop_lat: el- Efesmaro-ot enje epnevma Ethouab Parakliton. Piem

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲓⲥ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲓⲧⲟⲥ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲟⲱⲛⲁⲥ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲙⲁⲣⲟ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲟⲱⲟϩ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϣⲱⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Amen. One is the Holy Father, One is the Holy Son, One is the Holy Spirit amen. Blessed be the Lord God forever amen. Praise the Lord, all you nations. Acclaim Him all you peoples. For strong is His mercy upon us; He is faithful forever amen alleluia. Or the following is said
rows.ar_lat: Amen. Wahedon how al-Aab al Koddous, Wahedon howa al-Ebn al Koddous, Wahedon how al Roh al Koddous amen. Mubaraku al-Rabu al-Ellah ella alabad. Ya game’a al-omam bareku alRab, waltubarekahu game’a al-she’oob, le ana rahmatahu thabutat ‘alayna, wa haku al-Rabu yadoom ella-al abad : amen alleluia. :
rows.cop_lat: Amen. Es Pateer agios O-Theos agios en Epnevma Agion amen. Evlogitos Kiriyos o-Theos yestos eonas amen. Niethnos tiro esmo Epetchoise, maro esmo erof enje neela-os teero, je a pefnay tagro e ehri egon, owoh ti methmi ente Epetchoise shop sha eneh : amen alleluia.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲥ Ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ: ⲓⲥ Ⲩⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲉⲛ Ⲡⲛⲁ̅ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲛ: ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲥϣⲟⲡ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲁⲣⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲕϫⲱⲙ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲛⲉϫⲓ ϧⲁϫⲱϥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϩⲁⲛ ⲁ̀ⲧⲟⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲁ̀ⲛⲟⲕ ⲁⲓϫ̀ⲫⲟⲕ.
rows.cop_lat: Ees Pateer ageyos es Eyos ageyos en Epnevma ageyon amen. Es-shop nemak enje tee-arshee : khen ep-eho-oo ente-tekgom khen efo-o-oynee ente nee ethouab : evol khen ethnejee khagof empeeseyo ente han ato-owee : anok ay-egfok.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲱⲣⲕ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲑⲏϥ: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲉⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲏⲃ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧ̀ⲧⲁⲝⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲉⲗⲭⲓⲥⲉⲇⲉⲕ.
rows.cop_lat: Af-ork enje Epetchoise owoh ennefo-oom en eh-theef : je enthok pe efoweeb sha eneh kata et-taxees em Melchisedek.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ (ⲭ3) ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉϥⲕⲉϣ̀ⲫⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲗⲓⲧⲟⲩⲣⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...).
rows.cop_lat: Penyot ethouab en arshee erefs (x3) baba ava (…..) : nem pefke eshfeer en-leetorghos en-apostoleekos : penyot ethouab ava (…..).

rows.cop: Ⲫϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲉϥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩⲁⲛⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲓⲕⲟⲛ. Ⲛⲧⲉϥⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥϫⲁϫⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥⲁⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉϥϭⲁⲗⲁⲩϫ ⲛ̀ⲭⲱⲗⲉⲙ.
rows.cop_lat: Efnoty ente etfe ef etagrof heejen pef-ethronos : enhanmeesh enrompee nem hanseyo enheereeneekon. Entef-theveyo ennefgajy teero sapeseet en-nefetchalavg enkolem.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁⲓ.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh e-pi-Ekhristos e-ehree egon : entef ka nen novee nan evol khen oheereenee : kata pefneshty en-nay.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲓⲧⲟⲥ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲟⲱⲛⲁⲥ ⲁⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲙⲁⲣⲟ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ ⲡⲉϥⲛⲁⲓ ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲟⲱⲟϩ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϣⲱⲡ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ. Ⲁⲙⲏⲛ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.cop_lat: Evlogeetos Kiriyos O-Theos yestos e-onas amen. Nee-ethnos teero esmo Epetchoise : maro esmo erof enje neela-os teero : je a pefnay tagro e ehree egon : owoh tee methmee ente Epetchoise shop sha eneh. Amen alleluia.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ: ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ: ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit. Now and forevermore amen : alleluia
rows.ar_lat: Al magd lel Aab wal-Ebn wal Roh el-Kodoss. Alaan wa kolla awan wa ella dahr al-dehoor amen : alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri keEyo ke-Agio Epnevmati : Ke neen ke-a-ee keestos e-onas ton e-onon amen : alleluia

rows.cop: Ϣⲗⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Eshleel.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲡⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲕⲏ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲑⲏⲧⲉ.
rows.en: Stand prayer.
rows.ar_lat: up
rows.cop_lat: for Lel sala kefu. Epi epros-evki es-ta-thite.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲡⲁⲥⲓ.
rows.en: Peace be with you all.
rows.ar_lat: Al-salam le game-akom.
rows.cop_lat: Irini Pasi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲥⲟⲩ. ⲧⲱⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ
rows.en: And you.
rows.ar_lat: also
rows.cop_lat: with Wa ma’a roheka aydan. Ke to epnevmati so.

rows.en: Let us give thanks to the good and merciful God, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ, for He has protected, assisted, preserved, accepted us, had compassion upon us, supported us and brought us till this hour.
rows.ar_lat: Falnashkor sane’a alkhayrat al-rahum Allah, Abu Rabena wa Ellahona wa Mokhalisna Yasoua alMassieh, le-anahu satarna, wa a’anana wa hafizana wa kabilana elleh wa ashfakta alayna wa a’adadana wa ata bina ella hazehi el-sa’a.
rows.cop_lat: Maren shep ehmot entotf empi refer pethna-nef, owoh enaeet Efnoty Efyot em Penchoise owoh Pennoty owoh Pensoteer Isous piEkhristos, je afer eskepazin egon, afervo-ethin eron af-areh eron, afshoptin erof, afty aso-eron, afti-toten afenten sha e-ehri etay ono thay.

rows.en: Let us ask the Almighty God to keep us in peace this blessed day, and all the days of our life.
rows.ar_lat: Howa aydan falnas-alahu a’an yahfazana fi haza al-yom al-mokaddas wa-kol ayam hayatena bekol salam el-dabet el-kol al-Rabu Ellahona.
rows.cop_lat: Enthof-on marenti-ho erof hoppose entef ari-eron khen pai eho-o Ethouab fay nem nieho-o tiro ente penonkh khen hiriny niven enje pi pantokrator Epetchoise Pennoty.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ.
rows.en: Let us pray.
rows.ar_lat: Salu.
rows.cop_lat: Epros evek-saste.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: O Lord, Master and Almighty God, the Father of our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ. We thank You on every occasion, in every condition and for all things. For You have protected, assisted, preserved, accepted us, had compassion upon us, supported us and brought us till this hour.
rows.ar_lat: Ayoha al-Sayedo al-Rabu el-Ellah dabet el-kol, Abu Rabena wa-Elahena, wa Mokhalesna Yasoua elMassieh. Nashkoroka a’ala kol haal wa men agl kol hal wa fi kol hal. Le anaka satartana wa a’antana wa hafeztana wa kabeltana elayka, wa ashfakta a’alayan wa a’adad-tana wa atayta bena ella hazeh el-sa’a.
rows.cop_lat: Efneeb Epetchoise Efnoty Pi-Pantokrator, Efyot em Penchoise owoh Pennoty owoh Pensoteer Isous piEkhristos. Ten shep ehmot en-totk kata hob niven nem ethve hob niven nem khen hob niven. Je aker eskepazin egon aker vo ethin eron ak-areh-eron, akshopten erok akty aso eron, akty toten aken ten sha e-ehry etay ono thay.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱⲃϩ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ϧⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲉⲣⲃⲟⲏ̀ⲑⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓϯϩⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲁⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛ̀ⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁ ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛϭⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲕⲟⲓⲛⲱⲛⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉϥⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲉⲧⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲡ̀ⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Let us pray that God may have mercy and compassion upon us, hear us, sustain us, and continuously accept the prayers and supplications of His saints on our behalf, and make us worthy to partake of these holy sacraments, for the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.ar_lat: Otlobu lekay yarhaman Allah, wa yatar-af ‘allayna, wa yasma’ana wa yo‘eenana wa yakbal so’alat wa telbat kedeeseeh, menhum bessalahy ‘ana fi kol heen, wa yeg’alana mostahekeen an nanala men sharekat asrarihy al-mokadassa al-mobaraka le maghferat khatayana.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh heena ente Efnoty nay nan entef shenheet kharon, entef sotem eron, entef ervo-ethin eron, entef-etshy enni tiho nem ni-toveh ente ni ethouab entaf entotu e ehri egon epi agathon en seyo niven, entef aiten enem epsha ethrin etshi evol khen tikenonia, ente nef mestereyon ethouab etesmaro-ot epiko evol ente nenovi.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Lord have mercy.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erham.
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson.

rows.en: Therefore, we ask and appeal to Your goodness, O lover of mankind that You grant us to conclude this blessed day and all the days of our life in peace and in Your fear.
rows.ar_lat: Men agl haza nas-al wa natlob men salahika ya moheb el bashar amnahna an nokamil haza al-yawm el-mokaddas wa kol ayam hayatina bekol salAmen ma-a’a khawfik. Kol hasad wa kol tagreba wa kol fa’el al-shaytan wa mu-amarat alnas al ashrar wa keyam al a’ada al khafeyeen wa al zahereen.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenty-ho owoh tentoveh entekmet aghathos pimayromi mees nan ethrengok evol em paiky eho-o ethouab fay nem ni eho-o tiro ente pen-onkh khen hiriny niven nem tek-hoty. Efthonos niven pirasmos niven, energia niven ente epsatanas, epsotshini ente hanromy evho-o nem eptonf e-epshoy ente han gaji ney et-heep nem ni etho-onh evol.

rows.en: All envy, all temptation, all works of satan, all intrigues of the wicked, uprising of enemies, seen and unseen, do cast away from us, and from all Your people, and from this church and from this holy place of Yours. Grant us endowments and benefactions, as You have given us the power to tread underfoot serpents, scorpions and the whole strength of the enemy.
rows.ar_lat: Enza’aha a’na wa ‘an sa-er sha’abek, wa ‘an hazihi al-maeda. Wa ‘an mawde’ak al mokaddas haza. Amma al-salehat wal nafe’at fa erzukna eyaha, le anaka anta allazy a’taytana al soltan an nadusa ‘alla al hayat wal a’karib wa kol kowat al a’dow.
rows.cop_lat: Alito evol haron nem evol ha peklaos tirf nem evol ha etrapeza thay nem evol ha payma ethouab entak fay. Ni ze ethnanev nem ni eternofry sahny emoonan, je enthok pi etakty empe ershishy nan, ehomy ejen nihof nem ni-etshly, nem ejen tigom tirs ente pigaji.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲱ...
rows.en: You…
rows.cop_lat: So…

rows.en: (NISAVEV) In the presence of the Pope, Metropolitan or Bishop, the following is sung instead:

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲥⲁⲃⲉⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲒⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉⲣϩⲱⲃ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲙⲁⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϣ̀ⲑⲏⲛ ⲛ̀Ⲁⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀ϯⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲏⲃ:
rows.en: O all you wise men of Israel, the makers of golden thread, make a robe of Aaron befitting the honour of the priesthood of our honourable father :
rows.cop_lat: Neesavev teero ente peeIsra-eel nee-eterhob eneekap en-nob mathameyo eno-esh-teen en-Aaron : kata eptayo en-teemet-oweeb :

rows.en: May Your servants, ministers of this day : the protopriests, priests, deacons, clergymen, and all the people, and my weak self; be absolved (from their sins) by the Holy Trinity; the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit; and through the One, Holy, Universal and apostolic Church. And through the mouths of the twelve apostles;
rows.ar_lat: ‘Abeedak khodam haza al-yum, al-kamamesa wal kesoos wal-shamamesa, wal ekliros wakol al-sha’ab wa da’efy fal-yakoonu muhalaleen men fam al Thalouth al Mokadass; al-Aab wal Ebn wal Rouh elKoddous. Wa men fam al-kaneesa al waheda al waheeda al-mukaddasa al game’a alrasoleya. Wa men afwah al-ethnay ‘ashar rasulan. Wa men fam nazer al-Ellah alEngeely Marcos al-Rasul al-tahir wal shaheed;

rows.en: the beholder of the Lord evangelist Mark the apostle and martyr; Saint Severus the Patriarch; and our holy teacher Dioskoros; The apostolic Saint Athanasius, Saint, John Chrysostom; Saint Cyril; Saint Basil; Saint Gregory; The three hundred and eighteen assembled at Nicea; the hundred and fifty at Constantinople;
rows.ar_lat: Wal batriark al kedees Sawiros wa mo’alemna Dioskoros wal kedees Athanasius al-rasuly, al kedees Botros khatem elshohada’a wa ra-ees al-kahana, wal kedees Youhanna zahabey el-fam, wal kedees Kyrillos, wal kedees Basilios, wal kedees Eghrighorious.

rows.en: and the two hundred at Ephesus; And through the mouth of our honourable and blessed father, the Pontiff Pope Abba (…..) (and his brother in the apostolic Ministry Abba (…..). And through the mouth of my weak-self. For blessed and glorious is Your holy Name, O Father, Son and Holy Spirit. Now and forevermore. Amen. CONGREGATION :
rows.ar_lat: Wa men afwahi al tholthomeya wal thamania ‘ashar allazina egtame’a-o be Nikea, wal meya walkhamseen be madinat al-kostantineya, walmeya-tayni be Afasos.Wa men fam abina almokarram ra-ees al kahana al-Baba al mo’azam Anba (…..). Wa shareekahu fe el khedma al rasoleya Abeena al Oskof Anba (.....). Wa men fam hakaraty, le annahu mubarak wal mamlo’e magdan esmok alkoddous ayoha al-Aab wal Ebn wal Rouh el Koddous. Al-aan wakol awan wa ella dahr eldehoor. Amen.

rows.cop: Ⲑⲓⲥ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Redeemed us by Your Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Tees amen ke-to Epnevmati so.

rows.en: (If Nisavev was sung, it is continued as follows)

rows.cop: ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: the holy father, the high priest, Pope Abba (…..) : and our father, the Bishop Abba (…..), the beloved of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: em-penyot ethouab enarshee erevs papa ava (…..) : nem penyot ettayot en epeskopos ava (…..) : peemenreet ente pi-Ekhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲃ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁ ⲡⲓ ⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ: ⲉⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲛ̀ Ⲁⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ: ⲉϥⲧⲁⲗⲉ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ: ⲉϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉⲣϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ.
rows.en: This is the Censor of pure gold bearing the ember. Is in the hands of Aaron the priest. Offering up incense on the altar.
rows.ar_lat: Al magmara alzahab al naky, alhamilatu al-Anbar, be-yadai Haroon al-kahin, yarfa’a bakhoran fawka almazbah ‘alla ma’odee al-ghofrn.
rows.cop_lat: Tay shoree en nob en katharos : etfay kha pee aromata : et khen nen jeeg en Aaron pee-oweeb : eftaly ooestoynofee eepshoy : ejen peema en-ershooshee.

rows.ar_lat: OPTIONAL SECOND ARABIC VERSE: (Heya al-‘adra al-kedeesa Mariam. Allaty waladat Yasou al-Massieh, al –Ebn al-kalima, al-Roh al-Kodoos halla ‘allayha, kaddas-ha, wa-taharha wa-mala’aha ne’ama, betelibateha Yarabana an’em lana be-maghferat khatayana.)

rows.en: During Lent, feasts of the Cross and fasting days, the following is sung instead of Tai shori:

rows.cop: Ϯϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲧⲉ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲥⲁⲣⲱⲙⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ ⲁϥⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: The golden censer is the virgin : her aroma is our Saviour : she gave birth to Him : He saved us and forgave us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Tee-shoree en-nob te tee parthenos : pes aromata pe pensoteer : asmeesee emmof afsoty emmon : owoh afka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: THE INTERCESSIONS

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the mother of God Saint Mary : O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente teethe-otokos ethouab Mareya : Epetchoise aree ehmot nan embee ko evol ente nennovee.

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲧⲁⲅⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the seven archangels and the heavenly hosts : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pee shashf en arshee angelos nem nee taghma en eporaneyon : Epetchoise …

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟⲧϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲁϧ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of our master, the apostle : our father and teacher Saint John the beloved : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente pachoyse enyoty enapostolos : penyot nem pensakh ava Yoanness : Epetchoise...

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓⲟⲧϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of my masters the apostles and disciples : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente nachoys en-yoty en apostolos : nem epsepee ente nee matheetees : Epetchoise …

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲇⲓⲁⲕⲱⲛ ⲉⲧⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ: Ⲥⲧⲉⲫⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the truly blessed archdeacon : Steven the first martyr : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente pee-arshee zeeyakon etesmaro-ot : Estefanos peeshorp em-marteeros : Epetchoise…

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲑⲉⲱⲣⲓⲙⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the beholder of God, evangelist Mark the apostle : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente pee-theoreemos en ev – angelestees : Markos pee apostolos : Epetchoise …

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲁⲑⲗⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲅⲉⲱⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲙⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲫⲓⲗⲟⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ Ⲙⲉⲣⲕⲟⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the victorious martyrs : my lords king George, ava Mina and Philopateer Merkorious : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente nee-athloforos emmarteeros : nachoyse eporo Ge-orge-os nem ava Meena nem Phelopateer Merkoreyos : Epetchoise …

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲓ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the true bride of Christ : the holy Demiana : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente tee sheleet ente piEkhristos : tee-ageya emmee Temeeanee : Epetchoise…

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of our holy righteous father, Saint Athanasius : the apostolic : O Lord…
rows.ar_lat: Heeten nee evkee penyot ethouab zeeke-os : Athanasius apostoleekos Epetchoise…
rows.cop_lat: ente en ava pee:

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of all the saints of this day : each one in his name : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente ne ethouab ente pay eho-o pee-oway pee-oway kata pefran : Epetchoise…

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through their prayers, O Lord preserve the life of our father the honoured Pontiff Abba (.....) : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evkee areh eep-onkh empenyot ettayot en-arshee-erevs baba ava (.....) : Epetchoise...

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓ ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲏⲧⲓⲥ / ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through their prayers, O Lord preserve the life of our father : Abba (.....) the honoured Metropolitan/ Bishop : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evkee areh eep-onkh empenyot ettayot en zike-os ava (.....) pi-metropoleetees /epes-kopos: Epetchoise…

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲱ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
rows.en: We worship You O Christ : with Your good Father : and the Holy Spirit : for You have come and saved us.
rows.cop_lat: Ten o-osht emmok O piEkhristos : nem Pekyot en aghathos : nem Piepnevma Ethouab : je ak-ee aksoti emmon nai nan.

rows.en: - [2] THE READINGS -
THE PAULINE EPISTLE
Introduction :

rows.cop: Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲫ̀ⲃⲟⲕ ⲙ̀ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲑⲁϩⲉⲙ: ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲑⲁϣϥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓϩⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ.
rows.cop_lat: Pavlos evok em-Penchoise Isous piEkhristos pi-apostolos et-tha-hem fietav-ashf e-pi-hi-shenofi ente Efnoty.

rows.en: Verse : (Recite verse for appropriate reading from Katameros. Standard verse below.)

rows.cop: Ⲡⲁⲩⲗⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲫⲟⲩϣ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ.
rows.en: Pavlos pi-apostolos ente Isous Ekhristos : evol heeten ef-o-osh Efnoty.
rows.cop_lat: piem-

rows.en: Response :

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉⲩⲥⲟⲡ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲉⲥ ⲉϣ̀ⲱⲡⲓ. ⲧ̀ϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ
rows.cop_lat: Pee-ehmot ghar nem-oten nem etheereeny evsop : je amen es-e-shopi.

rows.en: Introduction in the presence of the Pope, Metropolitan or Bishop:

The grace of our Lord Pee-ehmot ghar em Pen- Ⲡⲓϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Jesus Christ be with your shoice Isous pi-Ekhristos Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲉϥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲛ saintly spirit, my Lord, : ef-eshopy nem pek ⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲡⲁⲟⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ the honoured father, the agyon epnevma :

patⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) high priest Abba (…..) choise enyot ettayot en ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ and our father the arshee erevs papa ava (ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ / ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲏⲧⲓⲥ) (Bishop/Metropolitan) (…..) : nem penyot en Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...)* : Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ Abba (…..).* May the (epeskopos/metropolitis) clergy and all the people ava (…..)* :

mare pee ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ be safe in the Lord : ekleeros nem pee-la-os Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲉⲥⲉ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ. amen, so be it. teerf : ogay khen Epetchoise je amen es eshopee. * If more than one Bishop/Metropolitan: (who are present | ni etki neman | ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲕⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ)
APETJEEK

rows.cop: Ⲁⲡⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲗⲟⲅⲟⲩ ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲓ̀ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ϩⲱⲥ ⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲗⲓⲟⲥ. Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
rows.en: The perfect, the blessing of His Father, the Word, came and incarnated and became a perfect human. Glory be to the Father and the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Apetjeek evol enje peeesmo to logho pefyot eafetchee-sarex hoos romee ente-leyos. Zoxa Patri ke Eyo ke Agio Epnevmati.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲡⲉⲧ ϧⲉⲗϧⲱⲗϥ ⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ: ⲁⲡⲉⲧ ϧⲉⲗϧⲱⲗϥ ϣⲟⲡ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ: ⲁⲡⲉⲧ ϧⲉⲗϧⲱⲗϥ ⲁϣϥ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ.
rows.en: They saw the slaughtered : the slaughtered is present among you : the slaughtered is hung on the Cross.
rows.cop_lat: Apet-khel-kholf nav erof : apet-khel-kholf shop nemoten : apet-khel-kholf ashf heejen pi-Estavros.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ ⲱⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and forevermore and until the age of ages Amen.
rows.cop_lat: Ke neen ke a-ee ke es-tos e-onas ton e-onon. Amen.

rows.cop: Ⲑⲁⲓ ⲧⲉ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲏ̀ ⲧⲉ. Ⲑⲁⲓ ⲧⲉ ϯⲥⲉⲃⲏⲣⲟⲥ. Ϯⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲕⲩⲛⲓⲥⲏⲥ ⲧⲟ ⲙⲟⲛⲱ Ⲭⲥ̅. Ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲛϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅. (x2) Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: This eloquent. This miraculous. The kneeling is to the only begotten Christ. The blessings of the Holy Trinity (x2). The Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Thay te teeno ee-te. Thay te tee-seveeros. Teeepros-keeneesees to monoo Ekhrestos. Ere pee esmo en-tietreyas ethouab (x2). Efyot nem Epshiri nem Pi-epnevma Ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ϯⲑⲉⲟⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ (x2): Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: The blessings of the mother of God (x2) Mary the mother of Jesus Christ.
