rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓϩⲓⲏⲃ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲱ̀ⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲥⲱϯ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲟⲥ.
rows.en: This is the Lamb of God : who carries the sin of the world : He came with a horn of salvation : to redeem His people.
rows.cop_lat: Fay pe pi-heeb ente Efnoty : fi-et-oli emefnovi em-pikosmos : fietaf-ini eno-tap ensoty : ethref-nohem em-peflaos.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲱⲙⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲒⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) Christ the Son was baptised Jordan.
rows.ar_lat: : Jesus of God : in the
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afetchi-oms khen pi-Yordanis

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲡⲓⲛⲁϥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲙ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲱ ⲛⲉⲙ ϣⲁ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: This is to whom glory is due : together with His Good Father : and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore.
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo ereprepee naf : nem Pefyot en aghathos : nem pi Epnevma Ethouab : isigen tino nem sha eneh.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je efesmaro-ot…

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲱⲙⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲒⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : was baptised in the Jordan.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afetchi-oms khen pi-Yordanis.

rows.en: Concluding Prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏ ⲧ̀ⲁϥϭⲓⲱⲙⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲒⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ.
rows.en: Who was baptised in the Jordan.
rows.cop_lat: Fi etaf-etchi-oms khen pi Yordanees.

rows.ar_lat: - THE WEDDING AT CANA OF GALILEE (13 th Touba)

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲥⲟⲟ ⲛ̀ϩⲩⲇⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩ: ⲁⲕⲁⲓⲧⲟ ⲛ̀ⲏⲣⲡ ⲉϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ: ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲧⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲛⲁⲕ ϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲡ.
rows.en: Six jars of water : You turned into good wine : with Your great glory : we praise You three times.
rows.cop_lat: Soo enhez-reya emmooo : ak-aito enerp efsotp : heeten peknishti en o-oo : tenhoos nak shomt en-sop.

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲁϥⲁⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲏⲣⲡ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : blessed the water and turned it into wine : alleluia alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : af-esmo enimo-oo af-aito enerp : alleluia alleluia.

rows.en: Gospel Reponse :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲁϥⲁⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲏⲣⲡ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ the Son of God : blessed the water and turned it into wine.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri emEfnoty : af-esmo enimo-oo af-aito enerp.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ...
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo…

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je efesmaro-ot…

rows.ar_lat: - FEAST OF ARCHANGEL SOURIEL (27 th Touba & 27 th Abib)

rows.en: Intercessions :
(After Saint Mary : )

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲥⲟⲩⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲥⲧⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the pure archangel : Souriel the trumpet blower : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pi archi-angelos ethouab : Sourey-eel pisal-pestees : Epetchoise…

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲓ ⲟ̀ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲟⲩⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩϥ̀ⲧⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Lets worship the Father the Son and the Holy Spirit : and honour Souriel the fourth among the archangels.
rows.cop_lat: Mareno-osht em Efyot nem Epshiri nem piEpnevma ethouab : ententai o-en-Soureyeel pimah-efto enarchi-angelos.

rows.en: Gospel Response :
(After Saint Mary : )

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ: Ⲥⲟⲩⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲥⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O holy archangel Souriel : the trumpet blower : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ari-epresve-vin e-ehri egon : o-pi-archiangelos ethouab : Sourey-eel pi-salpestees : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: - JONAH’S FASTING -
Intercessions : (After apostles : )

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϩⲓⲱⲓϣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲛⲉⲩⲏ̀: Ⲓⲱⲛⲁⲥ ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the preacher of Nineveh : Jonah the prophet : O Lord… Gospel Response :
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evki ente pirefhi-oish ente nirem Ninev-ee : Youanness pi-Eprofitees : Epetchoise …

rows.en: [Monday] O Lord, who preserved Jonah : inside the whale : after being thrown into the deep sea : preserve us with Your power.
rows.cop_lat: O-fe etaf areh e-Yoanas : ef-kee khen eth-neji em-pi-keetos : etav hitf e-epshok em efyom : areh eron kata tek-gom.

rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je-efes-maro-ot…

rows.en: [Tuesday] But absolve us and forgive us our many transgressions : as a good One and lover of mankind : have mercy on us : according to Your great mercy.
rows.cop_lat: Alla vool evol ko-ni evol : enna para eptoma e-tosh : hoos aghathos owoh emmairomi : nai nan kata pek nishti en-nai.

rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je-efes-maro-ot…

rows.en: [Wednesday] He blessed the seven loaves : and satisfied four thousand hungry men : seven baskets : were filled with leftovers.
rows.cop_lat: Pi shashf en-oik af-esmoo ero-oo : ef-to en sho en romi af et-sio-oo : shashf emvir av-moh em-mo-oo : khen ni lakh etav er-ho-oo ero-oo.

rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je-efes-maro-ot…

rows.en: [Thursday : Jonah’s Feast Day] O our Lord Jesus Christ : create in us for Yourself : a temple of Your Holy Spirit : offering You glorification
rows.cop_lat: Je Penchoise Isous pi-Ekhristos : mathameyo nak en-ekhree en-kheeten : en-o erfe-i ente pek Epnevma Ethouab : ev-ti zoxologeya nak.

rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je-efes-maro-ot…

rows.en: - THE LORD’S ENTRY INTO THE TEMPLE -
Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : entered into the temple : alleluia alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : afshe ekhoon epi-er-fe-ee : alleluia alleluia.

rows.en: Gospel Reponse :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ the Son of God : entered into the temple.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri emEfnoty : afshe ekhoon epi-er-fe-ee.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ...
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo…

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je efesmaro-ot…

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : entered into the temple.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : afshe ekhoon epi-er-feee.

rows.en: Concluding prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲫⲉⲓ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : entered into the temple.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : afshe ekhoon epi-er-feee.

rows.en: - LENT -
[SATURDAYS & SUNDAYS]
Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀Ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡⲁⲙⲉⲩⲓ̀ ⲱ̀ Ⲡⲁⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ⲁⲕϣⲁⲛⲓ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
rows.en: Remember me O Lord : remember me O my God : remember me O my King : when You come into Your Kingdom.
rows.cop_lat: Ari-pamev-e O Patchoise : ari-pamev-e O Panoty : ari-pamev-e O Pa-oro : ak-shan-e khen tek-met-oro.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ...
rows.en: Hail O Mary…
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne Maria…

rows.en: Acts Response :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲟⲧⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: + Our Lord Jesus Christ : fasted for us forty days : and forty nights : and redeemed us from our sins.
rows.cop_lat: A Penshoice Isous piEkhristos : ernes-tevin e ehri egon : en-ehme en eho-o nem ehme en-egorh : sha entef-sotten khen nennovi.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛ ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲍⲉⲥⲑⲉ: ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Let’s also fast : in purity and righteousness : and pray : proclaiming and saying:
rows.cop_lat: Anon hoon maren ernestevin : khen otovo nem o methmi : owoh enten-er epros evkesti : en-osh evol engo emmos :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲓⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲁⲓⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ ⲭⲱ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲃⲱⲕ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: + I have sinned, I have sinned : O my Lord Jesus forgive me : for there’s no slave without sin : and no master without forgiveness.
rows.cop_lat: Ai-ernovi ai-ernovi : Patchoise Isous ko ni evol : je emmon vook en aternovi : oze emmon echois en -atko evol.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ: ⲙⲁⲧⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲫⲱⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: Our father who art in Heaven : hallowed be Thy Name : Thy Kingdom come : for Yours is the glory forever.
rows.cop_lat: Je penyot et-khen ni-fiowi : maref-tovo enje pekran : mares-e enje tek-met-oro : je fook pe pi-o-o sha ni eneh.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩ ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲛⲉϫⲓ: ⲟⲩ ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ: ϣⲁϥⲭⲁⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: + The incense is Mary : the incense in her womb: the incense to whom she’ll : give birth to forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: O estoi-nofi pe Maria : o estoi-nofi et-khen tes-neji : o estoi-nofi esmisi emmof : shafka nennovi nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϩⲱⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲝⲓⲁ ⲁ̀ⲝⲓⲁ: ⲁ̀ⲝⲓⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Let us praise with the angels : proclaiming and saying : worthy worthy : worthy O Mary the virgin .
rows.cop_lat: Maren-hoos nem ni angelos : en-osh evol engo emmos : je axia axia : axia Maria ti parthenos.

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲣⲟ: ϫⲉ ⲫⲱⲕ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: Our father who art in Heaven : hallowed be Thy Name : Thy Kingdom come : for Yours is the glory forever.
rows.cop_lat: Je penyot et khen ni-fiowi : maref-tovo enje pekran : mares-e enje tek-met-oro : je fook pe pi-o-o sha ni eneh.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ...
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf…
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen…

rows.en: Aspasmos Adam : {Before ‘Exchange a holy kiss’} [Tune: Rejoice O Mary]

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲭ̀ⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲁⲥⲑⲟϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲟⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲩ. Ⲙⲁⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟⲛ Ⲫϯ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲉⲕⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲧⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ.
rows.en: For you do not desire the Je ek o-osh em-efmo an death of the sinner : but empirefernovi : em efrity to repent and his soul entef-astof ente-onkh enje lives. Restore us O God tef-epsishi. Mataston to Your salvation : and do Efnoty ekhon e-pek-ogai : with us according to Your ari-owi neman kata goodness. tekmet-aghathos. (‘That we may praise you’… page 164)
Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ fasted for us : forty days and forty nights.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos ernestevin e ehri egon : en ehme en eho-oo nem ehme en-egorh.

rows.en: Concluding Prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥ ⲉⲣⲛⲏⲥⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ϩ̀ⲙⲉ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲣϩ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲥⲟⲧⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Who fasted on our behalf forty days and forty nights : to save us from our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Fi etaf ernesteveen e ehri egon en ehme en eho-oo nem ehme en egorh : sha entef-sotten khen nen novee.

rows.en: - ANNUNCIATION (29 th Baramhat)
Intercessions : (After Saint Mary : )

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓϥⲁⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of archangel Gabriel : the announcer : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pi archi angelos ethouab : Ghabriel pi fay shennofi : Epetchoise…

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀...
rows.en: Hail O Mary…
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne Maria…

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥϫⲉⲙ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϣⲟⲡ ⲛⲉⲙⲉ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to her who has found grace : the Lord be with you : Hail to her who accepted from the angel : the joy of the world.
rows.cop_lat: Shere thi-etas-jeem ehmot : Epetchoise shop ni-me : shere thietas-etchi enten ni angelos : em ef-rashi em pi kosmos.

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia (x2) : Jesus Christ : the Son of God : was incarnated from the virgin : alleluia (x2).
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x2) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : af-etchi-sarex evol khen ti-parthenos : alleluia (x2).

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ : the Son of God : was incarnated from the virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : af-etchi-sarex evol khen ti-parthenos.

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ : the Son of God : was incarnated from the virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afetchi-sarex evol khen ti-parthenos.

rows.en: Concluding Prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Who was incarnted from the virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Fi etaf-etchi-sarex evol khen ti parthenos.

rows.en: - PALM SUNDAY -
Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲗ̅: ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ.
rows.en: Hosanna in the Highest : this is the King of Israel : blessed is He who comes in : the name of the Lord of Hosts.
rows.cop_lat: Osanna khen ni-etetchosi : fay pe ep-oro em piIsrael : ef-esmaro-ot enje fi ethnio : khen efran em Epetchoise ente nigom.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Truly blessed…
rows.cop_lat: Ekesmaro-ot…

rows.en: Acts Response : HYMN OF THE PALM

rows.cop: Ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲏⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ⲉⲣⲭⲟⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲛⲟ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉⲛⲟ̀ⲛⲟⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Blessed is He who comes in the Name of the Lord and also in the name of the Lord.
rows.cop_lat: Evloge-menos o-erkhomenos : en-onomati Kireyo : palin en-onomati Kireyo.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ⲧⲱ ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲧⲱ ⲩ̀ⲓⲱ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ.
rows.en: Hosanna to the Son of David : and also to the Son of David.
rows.ar_lat: Osanna to eyo David palin to eyo David.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ⲉⲛⲧⲓⲥⲯⲓⲥⲧⲓⲥ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉⲛⲧⲓⲥⲯⲓⲥⲧⲓⲥ.
rows.en: Hosanna in the Highest : and also in the Highest.
rows.cop_lat: Osanna en tis epsis-tees : palin en tis epsis-tees.

rows.cop: Ⲱⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲓⲧⲟⲩ Ⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲓⲧⲟⲩ Ⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Hosanna to the King of Israel : and also to the King of Israel.
rows.ar_lat: Osanna vasilito Israel palin vasilito Israel.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅: ⲡⲓⲱⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ: ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲡⲓⲱⲟⲩ ⲫⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ.
rows.en: Let us chant saying : alleluia : alleluia : alleluia : glory be to our God and also glory be to our God.
rows.cop_lat: Ten-erepsalin engo emmos : alleluia : alleluia : alleluia : pi-oo fa Pennoty pe : palin pi-oo fa Pennoty pe.

rows.en: VERSES OF THE CYMBALS

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉⲧϩⲓⲙⲥⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲗⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲱ̀: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅ ⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲁⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ.
rows.en: He who is sitting above the Cherubim : today appeared in Jerusalem : riding on a colt with great glory : what a great act of humbleness.
rows.cop_lat: Fi et-hemsi hijen ni Cherubeem : aftaleyot eoo-e-oo : afshe ekhon eYerosalem : o-pe painishty entheveyo.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲉϩⲱⲥ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲛⲉϩⲥⲓ: ⲁϥϫⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ⲱ̀ⲥⲁⲛⲛⲁ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲗ̅.
rows.en: They praise Him with alertness : saying “this is Emmanuel” : hosanna in the highest : this is the King of Israel.
rows.cop_lat: Sehoos erof khen onehsi : avje fay pe Emmanoeel : osanna khen ni-et-etchosi : fay pe ep-oro em-piIsrael.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲅⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲡⲓϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲧⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ: ϧⲉⲛ ϥ̀ⲣⲁⲛ ⲙ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲡⲓⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ϣⲁ ⲧ̀ϧⲁⲉ̀ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲥⲏⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Let us praise with David the chanter : “blessed is He who comes in : the Name of the good Lord : from now and till the end of the ages.”
rows.cop_lat: Marengos nem David pi hemnotos : je efesmarooot enje fe ethnio : khen efran em-Epetchoise piaghathos : es-jen tino sha et-kha-ee enniseyo.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓ ⲭⲉⲣⲱⲃⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁϥⲓⲙ: ⲛⲓ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲱⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓ ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲱⲥ: ⲛⲓ ⲥⲉⲧⲣⲁϯⲁ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓ ⲝⲱⲥⲓⲁ: ⲛⲓ ⲉⲑⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓⲅⲱⲙ.
rows.en: The Cherubim and the Seraphim : the angels and archangels : the powers the principalities : the dominions : the thrones, and lordships.
rows.cop_lat: Ni Cherobeem nem ni Serafeem : ni angelos nem ni archi-angelos : ni setrateya nem ni exoseya : ni ethronos nem etchoise nigom.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲟ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲧ̀ϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟϩⲏⲣⲓⲛⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟϯⲙⲁϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
rows.en: Proclaiming and saying : “glory to God in the highest : and peace on earth : goodwill toward men.”
rows.cop_lat: Ev-osh evol evgo emmos : je o-o-oo em-Efnoty khen ni et-etchosi : nem o-hirini hijen pi-kahi : nem o- timati khen niromi.

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀Ⲓⲗⲏⲙ̅: ⲁϥⲧⲁⲗⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉⲟⲩⲉ̀ⲱ̀: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia (x2) : Jesus Christ the Son of God : entered into Jerusalem : riding on a colt : alleluia (x2).
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x2) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : af-she ekhoon e-Yerosaleem : aftale-ot e-oo-e-oo : alleluia (x2).

rows.en: Gospel Response :
(The following four verses may be split into four individual responses to each Gospel)
He who is sitting above the Cherubim: today appeared in Jerusalem : riding on a colt with great glory : and multitudes of angels surrounding Him.
rows.ar_lat: Al-galis fawka al-Sharobeem: al-yoma zahar fi Oroshalem : rakiban `alla gahshen be-magden azeem: wa hawlu tikoos ni angelos.

rows.en: The crowd spread garments on the road : and they cut branches from the trees : while shouting and singing : “hosanna to the Son of David”.
rows.ar_lat: Fil-tareek farasho komsan : wa men alshagar kata-`oo aghsan : wa hom yasihona bel-alhan : “Ossanna Epshiri en Daveed.”

rows.en: Today the saying have been fulfilled : as said in the prophets and proverbs : and also Zachariah prophesied and said : a prophesy about our Lord Jesus Christ.
rows.ar_lat: Al-yawma tammat el-akwal : men alnebowaty wal-amthal: kamma tannaba-a Zakaria wakal : nebowa an Isous piEkhristos.

rows.en: Hosanna in the highest : this is the King of Israel : blessed is He who comes in : the name of the Lord of Hosts.
rows.cop_lat: Osanna khen ni etet-chosy : fay pe eporo em pi-Israel : ef-esmaro-ot enje fi ethneyo : khen efran em Epetchoise ente nigom.

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus & Concluding prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ Ⲓⲗⲏ̅ⲙ̅.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : has entered Jerusalem.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : afshe e-khoon eYerosaleem.

rows.en: - RESURRECTION -
During the period from the Resurrection through to the Ascension, the following is also said except ‘Kata ni khoros’ & the ‘Resurrection re-enactment’.
Intercessions :
(After Saint Mary)

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲩⲥⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲩⲥ: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the resurrection trumpet blower : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pee salpestees ente anastasis : Meekhael ep- arkhon enna nee-fee-owee : Epetchoise …

rows.en: (After the apostles)

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲕⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲑ̀ⲙⲓ ⲛⲓ ⲣⲟⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲥⲉϥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲕⲟⲇⲉⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲘⲁⲅⲇⲁⲗⲓⲛⲏ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the two righteous perfect men : Joseph and Nicodemus, and Saint Mary Magdalene : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evki ente nee ethmee nee romy ente le-os : Youssef nem Nikodimos nem tee ageya Maria teeMagdaleeny : Epetchoise …

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧⲉϥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ: ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲑ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Hail to His resurrection : who arose from the dead : that He saved us : from our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Shere tef anastasees : etaf-tonf evol khen nee ethmo-oot : sha entef soty em-mon : evol khen nen-novee.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Truly blessed…
rows.cop_lat: Ekesmaro-ot…

rows.en: Acts Response :

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓ ⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲧⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲱ̀ⲛⲓⲙ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲥⲩⲙⲫⲱⲛⲓ ⲁ̀: ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲁⲙⲁϣϫ.
rows.en: All the choirs that I hear : O what harmonious tune : has come to my ear.
rows.cop_lat: Kata nee khoros et-sotem ero-oo : oneem nay simfoneya : ethnio enamashg.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲣⲡ ⲙ̀ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲥⲀⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Christ has risen from the dead : at the dawn of Sunday : following Saturday.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-Ekhristos aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot : enshorp em ef-oway ente nisavaton.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲧⲟⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣϫⲉ ⲙⲉⲑⲛⲟⲩϫ: ϧⲁ ⲧ̀ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁ̀ⲕⲏ.
rows.en: You soldiers don’t lie : concerning our Saviour’s : resurrection on Sunday.
rows.cop_lat: Neematoy emper-ge methnog : kha etanastasees empensoteer : khen pee eho-oo ente teekeereeyakee.

rows.en: Or the following may be sung as an alternate hymn :

rows.cop: Ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓ ⲭⲟⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓ ⲧⲁⲝⲓⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲁ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ: ⲛⲓ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉⲩⲥⲟⲡ: ⲉⲩⲉⲣⲯⲁⲗⲓⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟ̀ ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡⲓϩⲓⲏⲃ ⲙ̀ⲙⲓ (2): ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ (3) ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: All the choirs and ranks of heavenlies and earthlies, the angels and people together chant joyfully: (for our Lord Jesus Christ, the True Lamb) x2 (has risen) x3 from the dead.
rows.cop_lat: Kata nee khoros nem nee taxees : ente na neefee-owee nem na epkahee : nee angelos nem neeromee evsop : ev-erepsaleen khen o theleel : (je Penshoice Isous pi-Ekhristos peehee yeeb emmi) x2 : (aftonf) x3 evol khen nee-ethmo-ot.

rows.en: Come all you heavenly hosts, with joyful praises, sing to our Lord : rejoice and be glad with us today: for the resurrection of our Lord Christ.
rows.ar_lat: Ya-koll al-sefoof al-sama-eyeen : rattelu le Ellahona be naghamat al-tasbeeh : we ebtaheegu ma-‘ana alyawma fareheen : be keyamat al-Sayed al-Masieh.

rows.en: Today the sayings of the former fathers have been completed, and the prophecies have been fulfilled : by the resurrection of the Lord from the dead and He is the first of the resurrected.
rows.ar_lat: Al-yawma kad kamulat al-nebowat : wa kad tammat akwal al-aba-e al-awaleen : be keyamat al-Rabu men bayna alamwat : wa howa bad-‘o al-mota-ge‘ean.

rows.en: The Lord awoke like one from sleep, and as a drunk from wine : and granted us the eternal delight and redeemed us from bitter slavery.
rows.ar_lat: Kad kama al-Rabu methlu al-na’eem : wa kal-thamily men al-khamra : wa wahabna al-na-‘eam al-da-em : wa a ‘atakna men al-‘obodeya al-morra.

rows.en: He captured hell and destroyed its copper doors : and broke its metal bulwarks : and changed our punishment : into salvation.
rows.ar_lat: Wa saba al-gaheem sabyan : wa hattam abwabhu al-nuhas : wa kasarra matareesahu al-hadeed kasrran : wa abdala lana al-‘ekoba bel khalas.

rows.en: He returned Adam to Paradise : in happiness and joy : he and his children who were in prison : to the place of joy once more.
rows.ar_lat: Wa a-‘ada Adam ella al-ferdoos : befarah wa bah-ga wa massarra : howa wa baneeh alazeena kanu fee al-heboos : mahal al-na’eem dof’a okhrra.

rows.en: Today the flags of salvation are spread : bodies and souls are renovated : and the believers won forgiveness of punishment : and they glorify the Lord with praises.
rows.ar_lat: Al-yawmma entasharat a’alamu alkhalas : wa tagadaddat al-agsam wal arwah : wa faza al-mo’emeenoon belsaf’h ‘an al-kassas : wa magadu Allah bel-tasabeeh wal-afrah.

rows.en: Today the daughter of David became rejoiced : and the hearts of the righteous disciples were full of joy : when the women announced to them the completion of the promises : and what they heard from the pure angels.
rows.ar_lat: Al-yawmma ebtahagat ebnat Dawood : wa tahallalat kooloob al-rossol al-abrrar : heenamma basharathom al-nesswa betammah al-maw’ood : wa ma sama’oo men al-mallaeka al-at-har.

rows.en: “Jesus Christ has risen He is not here as you see” : so the women went and announced the good news : to His honoured disciples : about the resurrection of the creator of the whole creation.
rows.ar_lat: Anna Yasou’e al-Massieh kad kamma : laysa howa hahona kamma taroon : fazahabat al-nusswa wa basharrat talameezahu al-keerram : be keyamet khalek al barraya agma’een.

rows.en: He appeared to His disciples and gave them joy : with His glorious image : while appearing in the glory of His divinity : and pleased them, when they saw Him alive.
rows.ar_lat: Wa zahara le talameezahu wa abhagahom : be baha’a nazarahu motagaleyan : be magd lahutahu wa afrahahom : lamma shahado-ho hayan.

rows.en: We praise Him and increase His exaltation : and declare the glory of His resurrection : and thank Him for His grace : for His mercy is forever.
rows.ar_lat: Nosabehahu wa nozeed refe’atahu : wa na’atarrif bemagd keyamatahu : wa nashkorahu ‘ala ‘azeem ne’matahu : le anna ella al-abad rahmatahu.

rows.en: RESURRECTION RE-ENACTMENT

rows.cop: Ⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲧⲏ.
rows.en: Christ has risen.
rows.ar_lat: Al Maseeho kama.
rows.cop_lat: Ekhrestos anesty.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗⲏⲑⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲧⲏ.
rows.en: Truly He has risen.
rows.ar_lat: Bel-hakeekaty kad kam.
rows.cop_lat: Aleethos anesty.

rows.en: (The above is repeated three times.)
(It can be repeated three times in Coptic, Arabic and then English.)
(An excerpt from Psalm 24:7-10)
Open your doors O kings : and be lifted up you eternal doors. (x2)
rows.ar_lat: Eftahoo ayohal melooko abwabakom : wa ertafe’e ayatoha alabwabo al-dahreya. (x2)

rows.en: Open your doors O kings : and be lifted up you eternal doors : for the King of glory to enter.
rows.ar_lat: Eftahoo ayohal melooko abwabakom : wa ertafe’e ayatoha al-abwabo al-dahreya : le yadkhola Maleko al-magd .

rows.en: Who is this King of glory ?
rows.ar_lat: Man howa Maleko al-Magd ?

rows.en: The Lord; strong and mighty : the Al Rabu al-azeezo al-kawio al mighty in battles : He is the King of gAbbar : al-kahher fe al-heroobi : glory! haza howa Maleko al-magd! + + +

rows.cop: Ⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲧⲏ ⲉⲕ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲱⲛ: ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲱ ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲥⲁⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲓⲥ ⲉⲛ ⲧⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲛⲏⲙⲁⲥⲓ ⲍⲱⲏⲛ ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥⲁ ⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Christ has risen from the dead, trampling down death by His death : and to those who were in the tombs, bestowing them eternal life.
rows.cop_lat: Ekhrestos anesty ek nekroon : thanato thanaton : pateesas ke tees en tees emneemasee zo-en khareesa menos.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ. Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father, to the Son and to the Holy Spirit. Now and forever more amen.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri ke Eyo : ke Agio Epnevmati. Ke neen ke a-e ke estos eonas ton e-onon amen.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲟⲛ ⲥⲩⲛⲁⲛⲁⲣⲭⲟⲛ ⲗⲟⲅⲟⲛ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ: ⲧⲟⲛ ⲉⲕ ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲭⲑⲉⲛⲧⲁ ⲓⲥ ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣⲓⲁⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ: ⲁ̀ⲛⲩⲙⲛⲏⲥⲱⲙⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲥⲧⲓ ⲕⲉ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲥⲕⲩⲛⲏⲥⲱⲙⲉⲛ: ⲟ̀ⲧⲓ ⲏⲩⲇⲟⲕⲏⲥⲉ ⲥⲁⲣⲕⲓ: ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲗⲑⲓⲛ ⲉⲛ ⲧⲱⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲱ: ⲕⲉ ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲩⲡⲟⲙⲓⲛⲉ: ⲕⲉ ⲉ̀ⲅⲓⲣⲉ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲧⲉⲑⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ⲟⲧⲁⲥ: ⲉⲛⲧⲏ ⲉⲛⲇⲟⲝⲱ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓ ⲁⲩⲧⲟⲩ.
rows.en: We, the believers praise and glorify the Word : equal to the Father and the Spirit in eternity and non beginning, born from the virgin for our salvation : because He was pleased and accepted that the Body be hanged on the cross, enduring death, and raising the dead through His holy resurrection.
rows.cop_lat: Ton seena-narkhon loghon patree ke epnevmatee : ton ek partheno tek thenta ees soteereyan emon : anemnee-somen pestee ke epros-keneesomen: otee evzo-keese sarkee : aneltheen en to-stavro : ke thanaton epomeene : ke eegeeree tos tethne-o-oo-tas : ente enzoxo anastaseeavto.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲟⲩ ⲗⲓⲑⲟⲩ ⲉϥⲣⲁⲅⲓⲑⲉⲛⲧⲟⲥ ⲩⲡⲟ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲓⲟⲩⲇⲉⲱⲛ: ⲕⲉⲥⲧⲣⲁⲧⲓⲱⲧⲱⲛ ϥⲩⲗⲁⲥⲥⲟⲛⲧⲱⲛ ⲧⲟ ⲁⲭⲣⲁⲛⲧⲟⲛ ⲥⲟⲩ ⲥⲱⲙⲁ: ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲧⲏⲥ ⲧⲣⲓⲏ̀ⲙⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲇⲱⲣⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲧⲱ ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲱ ⲧⲏⲛ ⲍⲱⲏⲛ: ⲇⲓⲁ̀ ⲧⲟⲩⲧⲟ ⲉ̀ ⲇⲩⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲱⲛ ⲥⲓ ⲍⲱⲟ̀ⲇⲟⲧⲁ: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲧⲏ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓ ⲥⲟⲩⲭ̀ⲣⲓⲥⲧⲉ: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲧⲏ ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲓⲁ̀ ⲥⲟⲩ: ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲧⲏ ⲟⲓⲕⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ̀ ⲥⲟⲩ: ⲙⲟⲛⲉ ⲫⲓⲗⲁⲛⲑⲣⲱⲡⲉ.
rows.en: When the stone was sealed from the Jews and Your Holy Body was guarded by the soldiers, You arose on the third day, O Saviour, granting life to the world. For that the heavenly hosts cried out to You, O donor of life “glory be to Your resurrection O Christ, glory be to Your Kingdom, glory be to Your planning, You are the only lover of mankind.”
rows.cop_lat: To leetho efrageesthen-tos epo ton yozeon : kestrateyo-ton feelason-ton to akranton so soma : anestees etree-meros soteer : zoro-menos to kosmo teen zo-een : zeya toto e zeenamees ton oranon : evoon see zo-ozota : “zoxa tee anastasee so-ekhreste : zoxatee vaseeleya so : zoxatee oykonomeya so : mone feelanethropee.”

rows.en: At the completion of the procession:

rows.cop: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲙⲟⲩ ⲁϥϩⲱⲙⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙ̀ϩⲁⲩ ⲁϥⲉⲣ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲛⲉϩ. Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀: ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡⲛⲁ̅ⲧ̅ⲓ̅: ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀: ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ ⲉ̀ⲱⲛⲱⲛ: ⲁⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Christ has risen from the dead, trampling down death by His death : and to those who were in the tombs, bestowing them eternal life. Glory be to the Father, to the Son and to the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore : amen.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-Ekhristos aftonf evol khen nee ethmooot fee-etafmo afhomy ejen efmo owoh nee-etkee khen neeemhav afer ehmot nooo empee-onkh eneneh. Zoxa patree ke eyo : ke agio epnevmati : ke neen ke a-e ke estos e-onas ton e-onon : amen.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϩϣⲟⲙⲧ ⲉⲕ ⲉ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕϫⲟⲙ.
rows.en: O My Lord Jesus Christ who arose from the dead : on the third day arise us with Your power.
rows.cop_lat: Patchoice Isous piEkhristos : fee-etaf-tonf evol khen nee ethmo-oot : khen pee eho-oo emmahshomt ek-eto-nosten khen tek-gom.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙ ⲛⲓ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲓⲥⲧⲣⲁⲧⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲉⲝⲟⲥⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲓ ⲑ̀ⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲧϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ.
rows.en: The Cherubim and the Seraphim, the angels, the archangels : the principalities, the thrones, the dominions, the lordships and the powers.
rows.cop_lat: Nee Cherobeem nem nee Serapheem nee angelos nem nee archee-angelos: nee setratia nem nee exoceya nee ethronos nem et-shoise neegom.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲩⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩϯⲙⲁϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ.
rows.en: Proclaim and say: “glory be to God in the highest : peace on earth, and good will toward men.”
rows.cop_lat: Ev-osh evol evgo emmos : “Je o-o-oo em Efnoty khen nee et-etchosy : nem o heereenee heejen peekahee nem otee-matee khen nee-romee.”

rows.en: The Trisagion:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲉⲥϣⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲟ̀ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲉⲕ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲟⲛ: ⲉⲗⲉⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ. (3)
rows.en: Holy God : Holy Mighty : Holy Immortal : who arose from the dead : have mercy upon us. (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Agios O-Theos : agios yes-sheros : agios athanatos : O anastas ek ton nekron : eleyson emas. (x3)

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀: ⲕⲉ ⲁⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡⲛⲁ̅ⲧ̅ⲓ̅: ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀: ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ ⲉ̀ⲱⲛⲱⲛ: ⲁⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲁⲅⲓⲁ ⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲗⲉⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲉⲙⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father : the Son and the Holy Spirit : now and forevermore : amen. O Holy Trinity have mercy upon us.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri ke Eyo : ke agio Epnevmati : ke neen ke aa-ee : ke estos e-on aston e-onon : amen. Agia Etreyas eleyson emas.

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm : [Sengary tune]

rows.cop: Ⲯⲁⲗⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲟ Ⲇⲁⲩⲏⲇ.

rows.en: [Below is the psalm for Resurrection Liturgy]

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲑⲁⲙⲓⲱϥ: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛ ⲑⲉⲗⲓⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛ ⲟⲱⲛⲟϥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧϥ: ⲱⲠϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉⲕⲉ̀ⲛⲁϩⲙⲉⲛ ⲱ̀ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉ̀ⲕⲉⲥⲟⲩⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲙⲱⲓⲧ: Ⲫϯ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲉϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ.
rows.en: This is the day which the Lord has made, we will rejoice and be glad in it : save us, O Lord and ease our ways : Lord God has given us light.
rows.cop_lat: Fay pe-pee eho-oo eta Epetchoise thameyof : maren theleel enten onof emmon en-khetf : o Epetchoise ek-enahmen o Epetchoise ek-e-soten nen-moyt : Efnoty Epetchoise efer-o-oynee eron.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϩ ϣⲟⲙⲧ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia (x2): Jesus Christ, the King of glory : has risen from the dead on the third day, alleluia (x2).
rows.cop_lat: + + + Alleluia (x2) : Isous piEkhristos ep-oro ente epo-oo : aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot : khen pee eho-oo emmah shomt : aleluia (x2).

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ (x4): Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ, the King of glory : has risen from the dead.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos ep-oro ente Ep-o-oo : aftonf evol khen nee-ethmo-oot.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱⲟⲩ......
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-o-oo…

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je efesmaro-ot…

rows.en: Aspasmos Adam : {Before ‘Exchange a holy kiss’} [Tune: Rejoice O Mary]

rows.cop: Ⲁ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ ⲧ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲉⲛⲕⲟⲧ. Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲛϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲕ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲱ̀Ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲧⲱⲛⲕ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Christ our God has risen from the dead : He was the first of the resurrected. For that we glorify Him saying: “You are blessed, O my Lord Jesus : for You have risen and redeemed us.
rows.cop_lat: A pi-Ekhristos Penoty : tonf evol khen neeethmo-oot : enthof pe etarshee ente nee etavenkot. Ethve fay tentee-oo naf enosh evol engo emmos : je ek-esmaro-ot o Patchoise Isous je aktonk aksotee emmon.

rows.en: (‘That we may praise you’… page 164)
Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ, the King of glory : has risen from the dead Concluding Prayer :
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos eporo ente Ep-o-oo: aftonf evol khen neeethmo-oot.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ϥⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲱⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϩ ϣⲱⲙⲧ.
rows.en: King of glory who rose from the dead on the third day.
rows.cop_lat: Ep-oro ente ep-o-oo fee etaf-tonf evol khen nee ethmo-oot khen pee eho-oo em-mah shomt.

rows.en: - FEAST OF THE LORD’S ENTRY INTO EGYPT -
Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia alleluia : Jesus Christ the Son of God : has entered into Egypt : alleluia alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia alleluia : Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : af-e ekhoon e-epkahi en Kimi : alleluia alleluia.

rows.en: Gospel Reponse :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ the Son of God : has entered into Egypt.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri emEfnoty : af-e ekhoon eepkahi en Kimi.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ...
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo …

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Je efesmaro-ot…

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : has entered into Egypt.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : afe ekhoon e-epkahi en Kimi.

rows.en: Concluding prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : has entered into Egypt.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em-Efnoty : afe ekhoon e-epkahi en Kimi.

rows.en: - ASCENSION (From the Fortieth day after the Resurrection feast through to Pentecost)
Intercessions :
(After Saint Mary)

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲩⲥⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲩⲥ: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the resurrection trumpet blower : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pee salpestees ente anastasis : Mikhael ep- arkhon ena nee-fee-owee : Epetchoise …

rows.en: (After the apostles)

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲕⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲑ̀ⲙⲓ ⲛⲓ ⲣⲟⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲥⲉϥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲕⲟⲇⲉⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯ ⲁⲅⲓⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲘⲁⲅⲇⲁⲗⲓⲛⲏ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the two righteous perfect men, Joseph and Nicodemus, and Saint Mary Magdalene : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente nee ethmee nee romee ente le-os : Youssef nem Nikodimos nem tee agia Maria teeMagdaleeny : Epetchoise …

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲗⲩⲙⲯⲓⲥ: ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ.
rows.en: Hail to His ascension : as He ascended to Heaven: in glory and honour : and sat at the right hand of His Father.
rows.cop_lat: Shere tef analem-epses etaf shenaf e epshoi eneefee owee : khen oo-o nem otayo : afhemsee sa owee nam em-pefyot.

rows.en: Acts Response :
[Procession is conducted in the Sanctuary only]

rows.cop: Ⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲥⲧⲏ ⲉⲕ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲱⲛ: ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲱ ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲥⲁⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲓⲥ ⲉⲛ ⲧⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲛⲏⲙⲁⲥⲓ ⲍⲱⲏⲛ ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥⲁ ⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Christ has risen from the dead, trampling down death by His death. And to those who were in the tombs, bestowing them eternal life.
rows.cop_lat: Ekhristos anesty ek nekroon : thanato thanaton : patisas ke tis en tis emni-masi zo-en kharisa menos.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ. Ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father, to the Son and to the Holy Spirit. Now and forever more amen.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri ke Eyo : ke Agio Epnevmati. Ke neen ke a-e ke estos e-onas ton e-onon amen.

rows.cop: Ⲁ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲗⲩⲙⲯⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲉⲝⲁⲡⲉⲥⲧⲓⲗⲉ ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ ⲧⲟ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ ⲝⲱⲏⲛ ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥⲁⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲯⲩⲭⲱⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ.
rows.en: Christ has risen to Heaven : and sent the Holy Spirit the Comforter : and granted life to our souls.
rows.cop_lat: A pi-Ekhristos anelemepses ton oranon exapesteely parakleeton to epnevma to ageyo zoen khareesa menos epee ton epsee-khon emon.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ̀: ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ̀ Ⲡⲛⲁ̅ⲧ̅ⲓ̅: ⲕⲉ ⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀: ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ ⲉ̀ⲱⲛⲱⲛ: ⲁⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father, to the Son and to the Holy Spirit. Now and forever more amen.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri ke Eyo : ke Agio Epnevmati. Ke neen ke a-e ke estos eonas ton e-onon amen.

rows.en: At the completion of the procession:

rows.cop: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧϭϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁϥⲉⲣϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲛ̀ⲉⲛⲉϩ.
rows.en: Christ has risen from the dead and ascended to Heaven : He sat at the right hand of His Father in the Highest and granted us eternal life.
rows.cop_lat: A pi-Ekhristos aftonf evol khen nee ethmo-ot : owoh afshinaf e epshoi e neefee-owee : afhemsi sa owe nam empef-yot khen nee etetshosy : afer ehmot nan empee onkh en eneh.

rows.en: The Trisagion :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲭⲩⲣⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲟ̀ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥ ⲉⲕ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲛⲉⲗⲑⲱⲛ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ. (x3)
rows.en: Holy God : Holy Mighty : Holy Immortal : who arose from the dead : and ascended to the Heaven : have mercy upon us . (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Agios O-Theos : agios yes-sheros : agios athanatos : O anastas ek ton nekron : ke anelthon es tos oranos : eleyson emas. (x3)

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ. Ⲁⲅⲓⲁ ⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father , the Son and the Holy Spirit , now and forevermore : amen. O Holy Trinity have mercy upon us.
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri ke Eyo ke Agio Epnevmati : ke neen ka a-ee : ke estos e-onas ton a-onon : amen. Agia-etreyas. Eleyson Emas.

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia, (x2) : Christ has risen from the dead : ascended to Heaven : and sat at the right hand of His Father : alleluia (x2) Gospel Response :
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x2) : piEkhristos aftonf evol khen nee ethmo-ot: owoh afshenaf e epshoi e neefee-owi: afhemsee sa-owi nam em-pefyot : alleluia (x2).

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4): Christ has risen from the dead : and ascended to Heaven.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4): piEkhristos aftonf evol khen nee ethmo-ot : owoh afshenaf e epshoi e neefee-owee.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲱⲟⲩ......
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo…

rows.en: Aspasmos Adam : {Before ‘Exchange a holy kiss’} [Tune: Rejoice O Mary]

rows.cop: Ⲁ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ.
rows.en: Christ our God has risen from the dead : and ascended to Heaven : and sat at the right hand of His Father.
rows.cop_lat: A pi-Ekhristos Penoty : tonf evol khen neeethmo-oot : owoh afshenaf e-epshoy eneefee-owee : afhemsee sa-oweee nam empefyot.

rows.en: (‘That we may praise you’… page 164)
Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀.
rows.en: Christ has risen the dead : ascended to Heaven.
rows.ar_lat: from and the
rows.cop_lat: Pi-Ekhristos aftonf evol khen nee ethmo-ot : owoh afshenaf e epshoi e neefee-owee.

rows.en: Concluding Prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲥⲁ ⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ.
rows.en: Who arose from the dead and ascended to Heaven and sat at the right hand of His Father.
rows.cop_lat: Fee etaf tonf evol khen nee ethmo-oot owoh afshenaf e epshoi eneefee-owee afhemsee sa-owee nam empefyot.

rows.en: - PENTECOST (Fiftieth day after the Resurrection feast)
Intercessions :
(After Saint Mary :)

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲩⲥⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲩⲥ: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the resurrection trumpet blower : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pee salpestees ente anastasees : Meekha-eel ep-arkhon ena nee-fee-owee : Epetchoise …

rows.en: (After the apostles :)

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲕⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲑ̀ⲙⲓ ⲛⲓ ⲣⲟⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲥⲉϥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲕⲟⲇⲉⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯ ⲁⲅⲓⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲘⲁⲅⲇⲁⲗⲓⲛⲏ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the two righteous perfect men, Joseph and Nicodemus, and Saint Mary Magdalene : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evkee ente nee ethmee nee romee ente le-os : Youssef nem Neekodeemos nem tee agia Mareya tee-Magdaleeny : Epetchoise …

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧⲉϥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲗⲩⲙⲯⲓⲥ: ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲏⲓ.
rows.en: Hail to His ascension : He ascended to heavens: and sent us the Comforter : the Spirit of Truth.
rows.cop_lat: Shere tef analem-epses : etaf shenaf e epshoy eneefee-owee : af-oorp nan empee parakleeton : pi-epnevma ente tee methmee.

rows.en: Acts Response : (3 Hour Response)

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲕⲟⲩⲟⲣⲡϥ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲕ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ: ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲁϫⲡ ϣⲟⲩⲙϯ: ⲫⲁⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲟⲗϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲧϥ ⲙ̀ⲃⲉⲣⲓ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit, O Lord : who You sent upon Your Holy disciples and honoured apostles at the third hour : do not take away from us O Righteous : but renew him in our hearts.
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab Epetchoise : fee etako-orpf ejen nek ageyos emmatheetees : owoh en apostolos ettayot: khen tee-agp shomty : fay emperolf evol haron : o-pee-aghathos alla aretf emveree : khen nee etsa khoon emmon.

rows.en: O Good Lord, do not take your Holy Spirit away from us, this which You sent upon Your holy disciples and honourable apostles at the third hour. Create a pure heart in me, O God and put a new and loyal Spirit within me, do not banish me from Your presence and do not take your Holy Spirit from me.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit …
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab…

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father and to the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
rows.ar_lat: Zoxa-patri ke Eyo Agio Epnevmati.
rows.cop_lat: ke

rows.en: O Lord, who sent Your Holy Spirit upon the Holy disciples and honourable apostles at the third hour, do not take this away from us, O righteous Lord. We ask You our Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of God the Logos, renew within

us a right and life giving spirit, a filial spirit of chastity, holiness, justice and authority. Our Almighty God, the light of our souls, illuminating every person who comes into this world, have mercy upon us.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit …
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab…

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and amen.
rows.ar_lat: forevermore
rows.cop_lat: Ke neen ke-a-ee estos-e-onas ton onon amen ke e-

rows.en: O mother of God, full of grace, you are the true vine that carries the fruit of life. We ask you and all the apostles to pray for the salvation of our souls. Blessed be the Lord our God whom we praise each day, because He prepares our path as He is the God of our Salvation.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit …
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab…

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and amen.
rows.ar_lat: forevermore
rows.cop_lat: Ke neen ke-a-ee estos-e-onas ton onon amen ke e-

rows.en: O Heavenly King, the Spirit of truth, the comforter, who is everywhere and fills everybody. You are the treasure of goodness and giver of life, we ask You to graciously come and dwell within us, purify us from iniquity and save our souls.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit …
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab…

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ Ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ ⲕⲉ Ⲩⲓⲱ ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲅⲓⲱ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓ.
rows.en: Glory be to the Father and to the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
rows.ar_lat: Zoxa-patri ke Eyo Agio Epnevmati.
rows.cop_lat: ke

rows.en: Lord, abide with us as You did with the apostles, when You gave them Your peace, we ask You to grant us Your peace, our Saviour, save us and spare our souls.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit …
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab…

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and amen.
rows.ar_lat: forevermore
rows.cop_lat: Ke neen ke-a-ee estos-e-onas ton onon amen ke e-

rows.en: Whenever we stand in Your holy temple, we are considered as those who abide in Heaven, O mother of God, you are the gate of Heaven, open to us the door of mercy.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Your Holy Spirit …
rows.cop_lat: Pek-epnevma ethouab…

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉⲛⲩⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲓ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲁⲥ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲱ̀ⲛⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ.
rows.en: Now and forevermore amen.
rows.cop_lat: Ke neen ke-a-ee ke estose-onas ton e-onon amen

rows.en: HYMN OF THE DESCENSION OF THE HOLY SPIRIT

rows.cop: Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ϣⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ϯⲡⲉⲛⲧⲏⲕⲟⲥⲧⲏ ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲥ.
rows.en: The Comforter Spirit : who descended on the disciples : on Pentecost and they talked in many tongues.
rows.cop_lat: Pee-epnevma em parak-leeton : fee-etafe-ejen nee apostolos : khen ep-shay enty pentee kostee avsajee : khen hanmeesh enlas.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩϫⲱⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲡⲉⲛⲧⲏⲕⲟⲥⲧⲏ: ⲛⲁⲩⲑⲟⲩⲏⲧ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲟⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲙⲏⲧ ⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ. Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲁϥⲫⲱⲣϣ: ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲫ̀ⲟⲩⲁⲓ: ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ⲛ̀ⲗⲁⲥ.
rows.en: When the fifty days were completed : they were all gathered the twelve disciples. When the Comforter Spirit : descended from Heaven : He spread out and touched every person : and they talked in many tongues.
rows.cop_lat: As-shopee et avgok evol enge nee eho-o ente tee-pentee-kostee : navtho-weet teero heeyoma : enge pimeet esnav en apostolos. Pee-epnevma em parak-leeton : etaf-e epe-seet evol khen etfe : af-forsh ejen efoway efoway : afsajee khen han-meesh enlas.

rows.en: In the presence of the Pope/Metropolitan/Bishop: ( See page 453)
Till the end of the years | Ella montaha el-a-awam | Sha ni rompi o pilas | Ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲥ
The Trisagion:

rows.cop: Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲑⲉⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲉⲥϣⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲥ: ⲟ̀ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲉⲕ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲕⲣⲟⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲁ̀ⲛⲉⲗⲑⲱⲛ ⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩⲥ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲩⲥ: ⲉⲗⲉⲏⲥⲟⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲁⲥ. (x3)
rows.en: Holy God : Holy Mighty : Holy Immortal : who arose from the dead : and ascended to the Heaven : have mercy upon us. (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Agios O-Theos : agios yes-sheros : agios athanatos : O anastas ek ton nekron : ke anelthon estos oranos : eleyson emas. (x3)

rows.cop: Ⲇⲟⲝⲁ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓ...
rows.en: Glory be...
rows.cop_lat: Zoxa patri...

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ: ⲁϥ ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia (x2): Christ has risen and ascended and sent to us the paraclete : the Spirit of Truth : alleluia (x2).
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x2) : piEkhristos aftonf owoh afshenaf : af o-orp nan empee parakleeton : piEpnevma ente tee methmee : alleluia (x2).

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ (x4): Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Christ has risen and ascended : and sent to us the Paraclete.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : piEkhristos aftonf owoh afshenaf : af o-orp nan empee parakleeton .

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ...
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo…

rows.en: Aspasmos Adam : {Before ‘Exchange a holy kiss’} [Tune: Rejoice O Mary]

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲟⲩ ϣⲁⲣⲟⲛ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲏⲃ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲛ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲕⲙⲉⲑⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ. Ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲙ̀ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Come to us today our Amo sharon emfo-oo oLord Christ : and teneeb pi-Ekhristos areeenlighten us with Your oynee eron khen tekmost high divinity. Send methnoty etchosee. O-orp us this great grace of e-ehree egon Your Holy Spirit the empaynishty en-ehmot comforter. ente pek-epnevma ethouab emparakleeton. (‘That we may praise you’… page 164)
Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Christ has risen and ascended : and sent to us the Paraclete.
rows.cop_lat: Pi-Ekhristos aftonf owoh afshenaf : af o-orp nan empee parakleeton .

rows.en: Concluding prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ: ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲛ: ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ.
rows.en: Who rose and ascended : and sent to us the Paraclete : the Spirit of Truth.
rows.cop_lat: Fee etaftonf owoh afshenaf : afo-orp em-pee-parakleeton : pi-epnevma ente ti-methmee.

rows.en: - APOSTLES FASTING -
Introduction to the Catholic Epistle:
ONTOS ALEETHOS [Partial]

rows.cop: Ⲟⲛⲧⲱⲥ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲕ̀ⲥⲁⲗⲑⲓⲛ ⲡⲁⲥⲓ ⲧⲏⲛ ⲅⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉ ⲫ̀ⲑⲟⲛⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛ Ⲑⲉⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲛ.
rows.en: Truly your names are glorified on earth : O chosen by God our fathers the apostles.
rows.cop_lat: Ontos aleethos ghar eksaltheen pasee teen geen : ke ef-thoneekon ton Theon ton apostolon.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ Ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲁ: ⲕⲉ Ⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ Ⲓⲥⲕⲉⲑⲓⲛ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃⲟⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲍⲉⲃⲉⲇⲉⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲉⲣⲉϥⲣⲓⲕⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: Simon Peter in Rome : Andrew Thomas and James son of Zebedee : for Africa.
rows.cop_lat: Simon Petros enehroma : ke Anedreyas Iskethen Yakobos to Zebedeos : entef ereEfrikya.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲫⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲱ̀ ⲧⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ϯⲑⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲩⲕⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O our lady mother of God : Mary the mother of Jesus Christ : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen e ehree egon : o tenshoys ennef teeren titheotokos : Mareya ethmav en Isous piEkhristos : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray for us to the Lord : O masters and fathers the apostles : and all the disciples : to forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e ehree egon : o nashoys enyoty en-apostolos: nem epsepee ente nee matheetees : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: (Verses for other saints may be recited)
Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Hail to my masters and Fathers the apostles : Hail to the disciples of our Lord Jesus Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere nashoys enyoty en-apostolos : shere nee matheetees ente Penchoise Isous piEkhristos.

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ⲱⲟⲩⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲧⲟⲩ...
rows.en: Truly blessed…
rows.cop_lat: Oneyatoo…

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ... ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ
rows.en: Intercede for Lady…
rows.ar_lat: us : O
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen ehree egon : e-

rows.cop: Ⲧⲱ̅: ⲱ̀ ⲛⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲓⲟϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲥⲉⲡⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲓⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲕⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Pray for us to the Lord : O masters and fathers : the apostles and all the disciples : to forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Toveh em Epetchoise e ehree egon : o nashoys enyoty en apostolos: nem epsepee ente nee matheetees : entef ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: (Verses for other Saints may be recited)
Aspasmos Adam : {Before ‘Exchange a holy kiss’} [Tune: Rejoice O Mary]

rows.cop: Ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲁⲩϩⲓⲱⲓϣ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅. Ⲁⲡⲟⲩ ϧ̀ⲣⲱⲟⲩ ϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡ̀ⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲁⲩⲫⲟϩ ϣⲁ ⲁⲩⲣⲏϫⲥ ⲛ̀ϯⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏ.
rows.en: Our fathers the apostles preached the Gospel of Jesus Christ among the Gentiles. Their voices went out through all the earth and their words reached the end of the world.
rows.cop_lat: Nenyotee en-apostolos avhee-oysh khen neeethnos : khen pievangeleyon ente Isous pi-Ekhristos. Apo ekhrooo shenaf evol heejen epkahee terf owoh nosajee avoh sha avregs entee-oykomenee.

rows.en: (‘That we may praise you’… page 164)
- FEAST OF THE TRANSFIGURATION (13 th Misra)
Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲟⲃⲧϥ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲁⲃⲱⲣ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia (x2) : Jesus Christ the Son of God: transfigured on Mount Tabour : alleluia (x2).
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x2) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afshobtf ejen peeto-oo en-Tabour : alleluia (x2).

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲟⲃⲧϥ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲁⲃⲱⲣ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ the Son of God: transfigured on Mount Tabour.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4): Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : af-shobtf ejen peeto-oo en-Tabour.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ...
rows.en: This is to whom …
rows.cop_lat: Je efesmaro-ot…

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ...
rows.en: Blessed is the Father…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pi-o-o …

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲟⲃⲧϥ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲁⲃⲱⲣ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ, the Son of God : transfigured on Mount Tabour.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afshovtf ejen peeto-oo en-Tabour.

rows.en: Concluding prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ: ⲁϥϣⲟⲃⲧϥ ⲉ̀ϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲑⲁⲃⲱⲣ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ, the Son of God : transfigured on Mount Tabour.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afshobtf ejen peeto-oo en-Tabour.

rows.en: - SAINT MARY’S FASTING -
Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲧⲁϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲣⲉⲕ ⲡⲉⲙⲁϣϫ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲱⲃϣ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲓⲱⲧ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲡⲓ ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲑⲓⲙⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲁⲓ: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ Ⲡⲉϭ̅ⲥ̅: ⲁⲗ.̅
rows.en: Listen, O daughter, consider and incline your ear, forget your people and your father’s house : the King has desired your beauty, for He is Your Lord : alleluia.
rows.cop_lat: Sotem tasheeree anav rek pemashg : aree epobsh empee-la-os nem ep-e terf ente peyot : je apee-oro er-epee theemeen epee-say : je owee enthof pe pechoys : alleluia.

rows.en: Gospel Response : (Yearly tune)

rows.cop: Ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲁ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲉⲗⲓⲥⲁⲃⲉⲧ ϯⲥⲩⲅⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲧⲉ ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟ̀ⲙⲓ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲛⲉϫⲓ.
rows.en: We worthily glorify you : with your relative Elizabeth saying : “blessed are you among women : and blessed is the fruit of your womb” .
rows.cop_lat: Tenetcheesee emmo khen o-em epsha : nem Eleesavet teesengenees : je te-esmaro-ot entho khen nee heeyomee : ef esmaro-ot enje epotah ente tenejy.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ...
rows.en: Intercede on our behalf : O lady…
rows.cop_lat: Aree-epresveveen eehree egon…

rows.en: - 29 DAY OF EACH COPTIC MONTH (Except for the months of Touba and Amsheer) (For months 1-6, the readings of the 2 nd Sunday of Amsheer are to be read) (For months 7-12, the readings of 29 th Baramhat are to be read)
Intercessions :
(After Saint Mary : )

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥⲁⲗⲡⲩⲥⲧⲏⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲁⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲩⲥ: Ⲙⲓⲭⲁⲏⲗ ⲡ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲟⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲁ ⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the Resurrection trumpet blower : Michael the chief of the heavenly hosts : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pee salpestees ente anastasis : Meekha-eel ep- arkhon enna nee-fee-owy : Epetchoise …

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: Ⲅⲁⲃⲣⲓⲏⲗ ⲡⲓϥⲁⲓϣⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the intercessions of archangel Gabriel : the announcer : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente pee arsheeangelos ethouab : Ghabrey-eel pee fay shennofy : Epchoise…

rows.en: (After the seven archangels : )

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟⲓ ⲧ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ: Ⲓⲱⲥⲏⲫ ⲡⲓϩⲁⲙϣⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲥⲁⲗⲱⲙⲓ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅..
rows.en: Through the prayers of the blessed elders : Joseph the carpenter and Saint Salome : O Lord …
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evki ente ni khelloy : et ezmaro-ot : Youssef pee hamshy nem thee ethouab Salomee : Epchoise …

rows.en: (After Saint Mark : )

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲕⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓ ⲑ̀ⲙⲓ ⲛⲓ ⲣⲟⲙⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲗⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲓⲱⲥⲉϥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲕⲟⲇⲉⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ϯ ⲁⲅⲓⲁ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲘⲁⲅⲇⲁⲗⲓⲛⲏ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the two righteous perfect men : Joseph and Nicodemus, and Saint Mary Magdalene : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee evki ente ni ethme nee romee ente leyos : Youssef nem Nikodemus nem ti agia Maria ti-Magdaleeny: Epetchoise…

rows.en: Introduction to The Acts:

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥϫⲉⲙ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ: Ⲡⲟⲥ̅ ϣⲱⲡ ⲛⲓⲙⲉ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥ ϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to her who found grace: the Lord be with you : hail to her who accepted from and angel: the joy of the world.
rows.cop_lat: Shere thee-etas-jeem ehmot : Epetchoise shop neeme : shere thee etas etchee enten pee angelos : em efrashy em pi-kosmos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲧ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲙⲉⲥ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ϧⲏⲧⲥ: ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲥ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ Ⲁⲇⲁⲙ.
rows.en: Hail to Bethlehem : the city of prophets : where Christ : the second Adam was born.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Beth-la-eem : et polees ennee eprofeetees : thee etaf mees pi-Ekhristos enkhets : pee mah esnav en-Adam.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧⲉϥ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲥⲧⲁⲥⲓⲥ: ⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲑ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥ ⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Hail to His resurrection : who arose from the dead : that He saved us : from our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Shere tef anastasees : etaf tonf evol khen nee ethmo-ot : sha entef soty emmon : evol khen nen-novee.

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲟⲱⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲁϥⲧⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲑ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲱⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱⲙⲧ: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅.
rows.en: Alleluia (x2) : Jesus Christ the Son of God : incarnated from the virgin : was born in Bethlehem : according to the prophets : and has risen from the dead : on the third day : alleluia (x2).
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x2) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : af-etchee sarex khen ti-parthenos : owoh avmasf khen Bethla-eem : kata nee esmee em eprofeeteekon : aftonf evol khen nee ethmooot : khen pee eho-oo : emmah shomt : alleluia (x2).

rows.en: Gospel Response :

rows.cop: Ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: ⲁⲗ̅ ⲁⲗ̅: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲁϥⲧⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲑ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: Alleluia (x4) : Jesus Christ the Son of God : incarnated from the virgin : was born in Bethlehem : and has risen from the dead.
rows.cop_lat: Alleluia (x4) : Isous piEkhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afetchee sarex khen ti-parthenos : fee etaf-masf khen Beth-laeem : aftonf evol khen nee ethmo-oot.

rows.cop: Ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ...
rows.en: This is to whom…
rows.cop_lat: Fay ere pee o-oo…

rows.en: Psalm 150 Chorus : (Alternate for each Psalm 150 verse :)

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : was incarnated from the virgin.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : afetshee sarex khen tiparthinos.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the Son of God : was born in Bethlehem.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Epshiri em Efnoty : fee etaf masf khen Bethlaeem.

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ: ⲁϥⲧⲱⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ the King of glory : has risen from the dead.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Eporo ente ep-o-o : aftonf evol khen nee ethmoot.

rows.en: Concluding Prayer :

rows.cop: Ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ̀ ϧⲉⲛ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁⲩⲙⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲃⲏⲑⲗⲉⲉⲙ: ⲕⲁⲧⲁ ⲛⲓⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲙ̀ ⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲧⲟⲛϥ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲑ̀ⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲉ̀ϩⲟⲱⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱⲙⲧ.
rows.en: Who was incarnated from the virgin : was born in Bethlehem according to the prophets : and has risen from the dead on the third day.
rows.cop_lat: Fee-etaf etchee sarex khen ti-parthenos : fee etaf masf khen Bethlaeem kata nee esmee em eprofeeteekon : fee etaf tonf evol khen nee ethmo-ot khen pee eho-oo emmah shomt.

rows.en: - IN THE PRESENCE OF A POPE/METROPOLITAN/BISHOP-
Entrance : (Or Evlogimenos – Page : 419)

rows.cop: Ⲕⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀* ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
rows.en: Truly You are blessed with Your Good Father and the Holy Spirit for You have come and saved us.
rows.cop_lat: Ek-esmaro-ot aleethos : nem Pekyot en aghathos : nem Pi-epnevma ethouab : je ak-ee aksoty emmon.

rows.en: (Verses for Pope/Metropolitan/Bishop – See next page)
Thanksgiving prayer : (Pages 4 & 133)

Let us pray that God may have mercy and compassion upon us, hear us, sustain us, disperse all temptations for us and preserve our faith. Through the supplications and prayers of our father, the triple-blessed, the honourable father of fathers the shepherd of shepherds, the highest of high priests,
rows.cop_lat: Tovh hina ente Efnoty nay nan entef shenheet kharon, entef sotem eron, entef ervo-ethin eron, entefger pirasmos niven evol haron : entefka nen nahty efmin evol. Khen niti-ho nem ni epros-evki ente penyot ettayot to etris makario patros imon patros pateron : pimenos pimenon : archi-ere-os archi ere-on imon :

rows.en: the true pastor after the order of Melchizedek and Aaron, the successor of apostle Mark, the Pope and Patriarch of the great city of Alexandria and its different countries, the beloved of Christ, (the archBishop, Pope Abba (…..) the Patriarch) x3, and our honoured father the Bishop Ava (…).
rows.cop_lat: pima en-eso-oo en-alithinon kata efrity enti-met oweeb em-Melchisedek nem Aaron : pizi-azoxos em-Markos piapostolos papa ke patriarkho tis-meghalo pole-os Alexanedreyas : nem ni etenos em-polis pimenreet ente pi-Ekhristos (penyot ethouab em-patriarchees papa Abba (…..)) x3, nem penyot ettayot en epeskopos Ava (…).

rows.en: May Jesus Christ the True Lamb and the Good Shepherd, firm him on his throne for many years in peaceful duration. Swiftly subjugate all his enemies under his feet quickly. And grant him a pleasant and peaceful time. May the Lord accept the paryers and supplication of His saints on our behalf,
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos pi-heeb en-alithinos owoh pima en-esooo en-aghathos : ef etagrof hijen pef ethronos enhanmeesh enrompi nem hanseyo enhirinikon. Entef-theveyo ennef gajee tiro sapeseet en-nef-etchalavg enkolem. Owoh entefty naf en-oseyo engami en-notem. Entef-etchi en-niti-ho nem nitoveh ente ni ethouab entaf entoto e-ehri egon epi-agathon enseyo niven,

rows.ar_lat: and make us worthy to partake of these entef ay ten enem epsha ethrin etshi evol holy sacraments, for the forgiveness of khen tike nonya, ente nef mestereyon our sins. ethouab et-esmaro-ot epiko evol ente nenovi. + + + Intercessions : Combined:

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ (ⲛ̀ ⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ / ⲡ̀ⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ) Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through their prayers, O Lord preserve the life of our father the honoured Pontiff Abba (.....) and our father the honoured (Metropolitan/Bishop) Abba (…..) : O Lord grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evki ente penyot ettayot en arshi erevs papa ava (…..) nem penyot (en metropolitees/episkopos) ava (…..) : Epetchoise ari ehmot nan em piko evol enti nen novee.

rows.en: Separate: (After the Pope)
[For one Metropolitan/Bishop]

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲱⲛϧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) (ⲡⲓⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ / ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥ- ⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ): Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Through their prayers, O Lord preserve the life of our father the honoured Metropolitan/Bishop Abba (…..) : O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evki areh eponkh empenyot ettayot en-zike-os ava (…..) pi metropolitees/piepeskopos : Epetchoise ari ehmot nan embi ko evol ente nennovi.

rows.en: [In the presence of two or more Metropolitans OR Bishops]

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ (ⲛⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ / ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ) ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Through their prayers, O Lord preserve the lives of our fathers the honoured (Metropolitan(s)/Bishop(s )) who are present with us today : O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evki areh enonkh en-nenyot ettayot en-zike-os (en metropolitees/epeskopos) etki neman : Epetchoise ari ehmot nan embi ko evol ente nennovi.

rows.en: [In the presence of atleast one Metropolitan AND atleast one Bishop]

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Through their prayers, O Lord preserve the lives of our fathers the honoured Metropolitan(s) and Bishop(s) who are present with us today : O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten no-evki areh enonkh en-nenyot ettayot en-zike-os en metropolitees nem en epeskopos etki neman : Epetchoise ari ehmot nan embi ko evol ente nennovi.

rows.en: Response to the Pauline Epistle :

rows.cop: Ⲏⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲡⲏ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲑⲉⲟ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲟⲥ: ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲟⲩⲥ Ⲩⲓⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲕⲉ Ⲑⲉⲟ ⲕⲉ Ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ Ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩ Ⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲩ: ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ ⲕⲟⲓⲛⲱⲛⲓⲁ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ⲇⲱⲣⲉⲁ̀ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲩ Ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲟⲥ:
rows.en: The love of God our Father, and the grace of the only begotten Son, our Lord, God and Saviour Jesus Christ, and the Communion and the gift of the Holy Spirit be with the holy and blessed father
rows.cop_lat: Ee-aghapee to Theo patros : ke e kharisto monogenos : Eyo Kerio ze ke Theo ke Sotiros emon : Isou Ekhristo : ke ee kenonya ke ezorea : to Agio Epnevmatos : e emeta to agio tato ke ma-kario tato :

rows.cop: ⲓ̀ⲏ̀ⲙⲉⲧⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱⲧⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲕⲉ ⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲱ̀ⲧⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲙⲉⲅⲁⲗⲟⲡⲟⲗⲉⲱⲥ Ⲁⲗⲉⲝⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧ̀ⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲥ ⲛ̀Ⲭⲏⲙⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧ̀ⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ Ⲓⲉⲣⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲏⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙ ϯ ⲉⲧⲓⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲙⲉⲛⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ϯⲗⲩⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲟⲩⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲑⲁⲩϣ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁϥⲣⲓⲕⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: Pope Abba (…..) Pope and Patriarch of the great city of Alexandria and the whole country of Egypt, the city of our God, Jerusalem, the five Western cities and Lybia, Nubia, Ethiopia and Africa.
rows.cop_lat: patros emon papa ava (…..) papa ke patriarkho : tees meghalo pole-os Alexanedrias : nem etkhora tirs en Kemi : nem etpolis em pennoti Yerosalem : nem te etio emvake em pement : nem ti Lybia nem Nobia nem Neethavsh : nem Afrikia.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲉ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲇⲉⲥⲓⲙⲱⲧⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲟⲣⲑⲟⲇⲟⲝⲟ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲱⲥ ⲧⲁⲩⲧⲏⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲟ̀ⲣⲓⲱⲛⲁⲩⲧⲏⲥ. Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲓⲣϥ: ⲟϫⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲥ̀ⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ.
rows.en: And the blessed saint, the most honourable, our father Abba (…..) our Orthodox Bishop of this city and its surroundings. May the clergy and all the people : be safe in the Lord, amen so be it.
rows.cop_lat: Ke to agios ke makario eze-simo-tato: to patros imon ava (…..) orthozoxo imon episkopo tees poleos tavtees ke ton oriyonavtees. Mare pi ekliros nem peela-os tirf : ogai khen epetchoise je amen es eshopi.

rows.en: Another response to the Pauline Epistle:

rows.cop: (...) ⲧⲟⲩ ⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲱ̀ⲧⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲱ̀ⲧⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲉ ⲕⲉ ⲥⲉⲃⲁⲥⲙⲓⲱ̀ⲧⲁⲧⲟ: ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ ⲁⲩⲑⲉⲛⲧⲟⲩ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲉⲑⲡⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲡⲁ ⲕⲉⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲙⲉⲅⲁⲗⲏⲥ ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲱⲥ Ⲁⲗⲉⲝⲁⲛⲇ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ Ⲗⲩⲃⲓⲏⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲁⲡⲟⲗⲉⲱⲥ Ⲉⲑⲓⲟ̀ⲡⲓⲁⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲁϥⲣⲓⲕⲓⲁ̀ ⲕⲉ ⲡⲁⲥⲏⲥ ⲅⲏⲥ Ⲉⲅⲩⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲁⲧⲉⲣⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲱⲛ ⲁⲣⲭⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲱⲥ ⲁⲣⲭⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲱⲛ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ:
rows.en: (…..) the blessed, the holy fully honoured : our father and master : Pope and Patriarch of the great city of Alexandria, Lybia, the five western cities, Ethiopa, Africa and all the land of Egypt : father of all fathers : shepherd of shepherds :
rows.cop_lat: (…..) to makareeyo-tato ageeyo-tato te ke sevasmeyo-tato : patros eemon avthento ke zethpoto baba ke-patreeyarkho tees meghalees pole-os Alexanedreyas Leebees pentapole-os Etheeyopeyas nem Afreekeya ke pasees gees Eghepto patros pateron peemenos peemenon arshee ere-os arshee ereon eemon :

rows.cop: ⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲕⲉ ⲇⲉⲕⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲱⲛ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲱⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲕ̀ⲣⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲓⲕⲟⲩⲙⲉⲛⲏⲥ: ⲡⲟⲗⲗⲁ ⲧⲁ ⲉⲧⲏ: ⲧⲟⲛ ⲇⲉⲥⲡⲟⲧⲏⲛ ⲕⲉ ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲁ̀ ⲏ̀ⲙⲱⲛ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲫⲩⲗⲁⲧⲧⲉ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛ (ⲓⲥⲡⲟⲗⲗⲁ ⲉ̀ⲧⲏ ⲇⲉⲥⲡⲟⲧⲁ). ⲅ̅ * Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲓⲣϥ: ⲟϫⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲙⲏⲛ ⲥ̀ⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ.
rows.en: our archBishop : the thirteenth apostle and the judge of the world : may his years be countless : may God preserve our master and archBishop : (for many years O Lord) x3.* May the clergy and all the people : be safe in the Lord, amen so be it.
rows.cop_lat: etreeto ke zekato ton apostolon ke ekreeto tees oy-komenees : polla ta ete : ton zespoteen ke arshee-ere-a eemon Kiriye feelatte avton (espolla ete zespota) x3.* Mare pee ekleeros nem pee la-os terf : ogay khen epetchoise je amen es eshopee.

rows.en: * in the presence of a Metropolitan/Bishop:

rows.cop: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ (ⲛⲙⲏⲧⲣⲟⲡⲟⲗⲓⲧⲏⲥ / ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲥ- ⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ) Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...)
rows.en: And our father the (Metropolitan/Bishop) Abba (…..)
rows.cop_lat: nem penyot (enmetropoleetees/enepeskopos) Abba (…..)

rows.en: In the presence of the Pope:

rows.cop: Ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲇⲓⲁ̀ⲇⲟⲭⲟⲥ ⲙ̀ ⲡⲓ-ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲙⲁⲣⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...): ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲉ̀ⲣⲉⲩⲥ.
rows.en: Till the end of the years, O sweet tongue. Till the end of the years O golden tongue, O successor of Saint Mark the apostle, Pope and archBishop Abba (…..) .
rows.ar_lat: Ella montaha el-aawam : ya lesan aletr : ella montaha el-a-awam ya lesan el-zahab : ya khalifat al-keddis Markos al-rasol: Anba (…..) raes alkahana.
rows.cop_lat: Sha nee-rompy o peelas ente pee estoynofee sha neerompy o peelas en-nob : o peezeyazokhos em-peeagyos Markos peeapostolos Abba (…) pee-archee-erefs.

rows.en: In the presence of a Metropolitan or Bishop:

rows.cop: Ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓ ⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ϣⲁ ⲛⲓⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲥ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ: ⲱ̀ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲏ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ (...) ⲡⲓ (ⲙⲉⲧⲣⲟⲡⲗⲏⲧⲏⲥ / ⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ).
rows.en: Till the end of the years, O sweet tongue. Till the end of the years O golden tongue, O our honoured father, Bishop (…) the arch-priest.
rows.ar_lat: Ella montaha el-aawam : ya lesan aletr : ella montaha el-a-awam ya lesan el-zahab : ya abeena al-mokarram Anba (…..) ra-ees alkahana.
rows.cop_lat: Sha nee-rompy o peelas ente pee estoynofee sha neerompy o peelas en-nob : o penyot ettayot en-zike-os ava (…) pee (metropoleetees/ epeskopos) .

rows.en: Response to the Gospel’s Psalm :
[Pope/Bishop]

rows.cop: onkh: amin alleluia. Ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩϭⲁⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟϥ ϩⲓⲧ̀ⲕⲁⲑⲉⲇⲣⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁϥⲭⲱ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧⲓⲱⲧ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲥⲱⲟⲩ:
rows.en: Let them exalt Him Fal yarfa’oo fi in the Church of His kaneesat people, and praise sha’abahihy wal Him in the yobarekohu ‘alla assembly of the manaber al-sheelders, for He has yokh : le anahu made His families ga’ala obuwatana like a flock of methla al-kherraf, sheep, that the yobsiru alupright may see and mostakimoona wa rejoice.

The Melki-sadek ya Lord is at your right Rabana Yasoua alhand, O our saintly Massieh. rows.en: Introduction to the Gospel :
[Pope]

Stand up in the fear of God, to listen, from our honourable father, the righteous and triple blessed, our father and father of all fathers, the shepherd of shepherds and the chief of the Archpriests, the successor of Saint Mark the evangelist, the great among the patriarchs, the beloved of Lord Christ, our pure father
rows.ar_lat: Kifu be khawfen ammam Allah waensetoo le sama’a al-Engeel almokadass, men fam abeena almokarram el-bar, al-mothalath altooba, abeena abi al-aba’, ra’e alroa’a, ra-‘ees ro-asa’ kahanatina, khalifat al-kedees Markos alengeely, al-‘azeemu fi al-bataroka, habeeb al-Massieh, abeena al-taher, al baba Anba (…..) baba

rows.en: Abba (…..) Patriarch of the great city of Alexandria and Patriarch of the See of Saint Mark in all the cities of Egypt and the city of our Lord, Jerusalem and Ethiopia, Nubia, Sudan, Libya and the five western cities and all the African nations, and the east and the west. May God of Heaven keep him on his throne for many years and peaceful times.
rows.ar_lat: al-madeena al-‘ozma al-Eskandareya, wa batriark al-kiraza al-Morkoseya fi kol bilad Misr wa madinat Ellahona Orshaleem wa Ethiopa wa al-Noba wa al-Sudan wa Libya wa al-khamas modon al-gharbia wa kolly bilad Afrikia wa al-shark wa al-mahgar. Illahu al-sama’ yo-thabitahu ‘ala korsi-eeh saneenan ‘adeeda wa ‘azmenatan salematan madeeda.

rows.en: And humiliate all his enemies under his feet quickly. And grant him pleasant and peaceful times and bestow grace and mercy upon us through his prayers and supplications. The holy Gospel according to our teacher Saint (…..) the evangelist, apostle and pure disciple, may his blessings.
rows.ar_lat: Wa yokhdi’a game’a ‘ada’e al-kaneesa tah’ta kadami-hee sare’an. Wa yo’ateeh zamanan hadey an bahigan, wa yo’ateena ne’amatan wa rahmatan be salawatehee wa telbatehee. Al-Engeel al-mokaddas , faslon men besharat al-kedees mo’alemna mari (…..) al-engeely albasheer wal telmeezu al-taher, barakatahu.

Illahu al-sama’ yo-thabitahu ‘ala korsi-eeh saneenan ‘adeeda wa ‘azmenatan salematan madeeda.

rows.en: LITANY FOR PATRIARCH’S DEPARTURE

This is which You have bought with Hazehy allati eqtanaytaha laka beldam the honoured Blood of Your Christ. al-kareem allazi le Massiheka. Ehfazha Preserve her in peace and all her besalamaten wakul al-assakefa alOrthodox Bishops. Remember, O Lord, Orthozoxien allazina fiha. Ozkor Yarab the soul of our father the Patriarch Pope nafs abeena al-batryark al-baba (…). Abba (…).

Graciously repose it with Tafaddal nayeh-ha ma’a kiddesseek. your saints. (Grant to appoint for us a (An’em be an tokeema lana ra’yan good shepherd to shepherd Your people salehan le yar’a sha’bak bel-taharra wal in purity and righteousness.)* Pray for ‘adl.)* Salu men agl abena al-oskof alour honoured father the Bishop, Anba mokkaram al-Anba (…). (…). * Not said between the new pope’s election and his enthronement DEACON:

Pray for the soul of our blessed and honoured father Pope Abba (…), that the Lord God may repose his soul in the bossom of our holy fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the Paradise of Joy. Pray for our honoured father, Bishop (…), and all the Orthodox Bishops.
