rows.cop: Ⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲥⲓϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲙ.
rows.en: Bless the seeds and the herbs.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo enisity nem nisim.

rows.en: From 11 Touba,(Amshir, Baramhat, Baramouda, Bashans) to 11 Baouna :

rows.cop: Ⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓ ⲁⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ.
rows.en: Bless the air of Heaven.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo eni-a-er ente etfe.

rows.en: Alternative – combined :

rows.cop: Ⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ ⲫ̀ⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲛⲓⲥⲓϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲙ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓ ⲁⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ.
rows.en: Bless waters of the rivers : the seeds and the herbs : and the air of Heaven.
rows.cop_lat: Esmo enimo-oo emefyaro : nem enisity nem nisim : nem eni-aer ente etfe.

rows.en: Continue with : (For concluding prayer – Amen alleluia…)

rows.cop: ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ: ⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ..
rows.en: May Your mercy and Your peace be a fortress for Your people : save us…
rows.cop_lat: Mar-e peknai nem tekhirini oi en-soft empekla-os : soty emmon…

rows.en: GLORIFICATION (Tamgeed)

Ekesmaro-ot Greek Hymn (Agios Yesteen) Another Greek hymn (Zefte Pentees) Verses for Saint Mary & Saints (Rashi) Sunday’s Theotokia (Shashf ensop/Seven times) For Saint mary (Atai parthenos) Epouro Veneration to the saints Short story of the saint Khen Efran The three crowns Apekran Wa salam Allah (The peace of God) Ya Rabana (O our Lord) Conclusion
- EKESMARO-OT -

rows.cop: Ⲕⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲕⲓⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲁⲑⲟⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϫⲉ ⲁⲕⲓ̀ ⲁⲕⲥⲱϯ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ.
rows.en: Truly You are blessed with Your good Father and the Holy Spirit for You have come and saved us.
rows.cop_lat: Ek-esmaro-ot aleethos : nem Pekyot en-aghathos : nem Pee-epnevma ethouab : je ak-ee aksoty emmon.

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: Ⲡ̀ϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲁⲣⲓ ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲭⲱ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ.
rows.en: Through the intercessions of the mother of God Saint Mary : O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee epresveya ente tee-the-otokos : ethowab Mareya : Epetchoise aree ehmot nan embi ko evol ente nennovee.

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲁϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛⲓⲟⲧϯ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲁⲭ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of our master, the apostle : our father and teacher Saint John the beloved : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee-evkee ente pachoys enyoty enapostolos : penyot nem pensakh Abba Yoanness : Epetchoise…

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲓ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of the true bride of Christ : Saint Demiana : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee-evkee ente tee sheleet ente pi Ekhristos : tee ageya emmee Teemeyanee : Epetchoise…

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅ ⲛ̀ ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ: Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲓ ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅...
rows.en: Through the prayers of our righteous father, Saint Athanasius : the apostolic : O Lord…
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nee -evki ente penyot ethouab en zike-os Abba Athanasyos pee apostoleekos : Epetchoise…

rows.en: Add verse(s) for Pope/Metropolitan/Bishop – See pages 451-452
- GREEK HYMN -

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲧⲱⲙⲉⲛⲏ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲟ̀Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟ ⲥⲉⲙⲉⲅⲁⲗⲓⲛⲟⲙⲉⲛ.
rows.en: Rejoice, O full of grace, O Mary, the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ke kharitomeni Maria : OKireyos meta-soo semeghalinomen.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲃⲁⲥⲓⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲅⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲇⲟⲝⲓⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Holy You O Lord and King : who is praised from all the ranks : and multitudes of hosts : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Agios eesteen O Pateer vasilevsin : thepensevio : genos en-zoxin : to-epnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲃⲟⲏⲑⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲍⲱⲏⲛ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Righteous is the Father : who is fully praised : and the life giver for many : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Zike-os eesteen O Pateer eovoythin : thepensevio : zoeen en e-poraneyon : toepnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲏⲡⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲑⲩⲥⲁⲩⲣⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Praise is the Father : who is praised by all : Jesus who is glorified from all : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Eepanos eesteen O Pateer thisavrin : thepensevio : Isous en e-poraneyon : toepnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲗⲁⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲙⲁⲧⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Lord is the Father : to whom all : chant God : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Kireyos eesteen O Patir lalevsin : thepensevio : matoos en e-poraneyon : toepnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲝⲁⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲟⲛⲧⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Praise is the Father : of all : the only divine essence : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Nimeyos eesteen O Pateer exalevsin : thepensevio : ontos en e-poraneyon : toepnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲛⲓⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲣⲁⲣⲁⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲥ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲣⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Eternal is the compassionate Father : who was crucified : for us : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Nimenos eesteen O Pateer rarevsin : thepensevio : estavros en e-poraneyon : toepnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲓⲙⲓⲟⲥ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲩ̀ⲙⲟⲛⲫⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ϥⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Honoured is the Father : and praised from all : with the saints : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Timeyos eesteen O Pateer imonfin : thepensevio : fosteer en e-poraneyon : toepnevma too Agio.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ ⲓⲥⲧⲓⲛ: ⲟ̀ ⲡⲁⲧⲏⲣ ⲯⲁⲗⲉⲩⲥⲓⲛ: ⲑⲉⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ̀ ⲱ̀ⲛ̀ⲧⲱⲥ ⲛ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲓⲟⲛ: ⲧⲟⲩ ⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲧⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟ.
rows.en: Great is the Father : and praised from all : with the saints : and the Holy Spirit.
rows.cop_lat: Shere esteen eesteen O Pateer epsalevsin : thepensevio : o-entos en eporaneyon : to-epnevma too Agio.

rows.en: - ANOTHER GREEK HYMN -

rows.cop: Ⲇⲉⲩⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲧⲏⲥ ⲓ̀ⲇⲁⲏⲓ̀ ⲧⲟⲛⲁⲣⲭⲏ: ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲛ ⲁⲛ: ⲛ̀ⲁⲙⲉⲛⲡⲟⲙⲉⲛ. Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓ ⲧⲟⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Come all you people : to see the archangel : proclaim to her. Hail to you Mary : O full of grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Zevte pentees ela-ee ton-arshee : angeli emmon an : en-amenpomen. Shere Mariam : ke-khari tomenee : o-Kireyos metaso.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲙⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫⲓⲙⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϣⲟⲡ ⲛⲉⲙⲉ.
rows.en: Come all you people : to see the archangel : proclaim to her. Hail to you Mary : you have found grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Amoini en-nila-os teero : enten-nav epiarshee-angelos efgo emmos : je shere Mariam : arejimi ghar en-o-ehmoot : owoh Epetchoise shop neme.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲑⲉⲟ ⲧⲟⲕⲉ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲭⲱⲣⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲛⲗⲟⲅⲟⲛ ⲧⲟ ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲗⲏⲧ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧ̀ⲥⲁⲃⲉ ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲧⲟⲙⲉⲛⲓ ⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Hail to the mother of God : the decorated palace : with the word of the Father : hail to the bride : hail to the wise who is filled with grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Theo-toke ton kosmon ton khoron ton-loghon to-petro : shere etsheleet : shere etsave ke khari tomeni o-Kireyos metaso.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲑⲉⲟ ⲧⲟⲕⲉ: ⲧⲟⲛ Ⲡⲛⲁ̅: ⲕⲉ ⲩ̀ⲡⲟⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲧⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲛⲉ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲏⲑⲉⲃⲙⲓⲑⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲫⲉⲩⲟⲥ: ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲇⲟⲝⲁⲥⲑⲉ: ⲕⲉ ⲟ̀ⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲥⲁⲣⲕⲟⲕⲓ ⲇⲓⲛⲁⲙⲓⲥ:
rows.en: Hail to the mother of God : to whom the spirit came : and filled you with grace : O mother of the bridegroom : the God of glory and the word :
rows.cop_lat: Shere Theo-toke : ton Epnevma : ke ipomenee : tees pine pe nem ni-theb mithere nem fevos : theozoxaste : ke ologhos sarkoki zinamis :

rows.cop: ⲑⲓⲛ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲛ ⲉⲧⲉⲕⲓ̀ ⲧⲉⲥⲓⲛ ⲧⲉⲥⲓⲛⲁ̀ ⲡⲉⲛⲧ̀ⲣⲟⲡⲏⲥ ⲫ̀ⲣⲉⲛⲉⲑⲉ: ⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲧⲏⲥ ⲓ̀ⲗⲁⲏ̀ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓ ⲁⲗⲑⲓⲛⲛⲁ: ⲃⲁⲡⲧⲓⲥⲙⲁ: ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓ: ⲣⲁϣⲓ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓ ⲧⲟⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: took flesh and was born of you : for the heavenly angels always give : honour unto you : in the human race : the joy : to all people : and the archangels : praise with the choir : of the archangels : rejoice O Mary : O full of grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: thin oranon angelon etekee teseen teseena pen-etropees efren-ete : apotees ila-ee ton arshee angeli althina : baptisma : ton arshee angeli : rashi Mariam : ke-khari tomenee : oKireyos metaso.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲑⲉⲟ ⲧⲟⲕⲉ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ̀ ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ̀: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲙⲉⲑⲉⲣⲑⲉ ⲟ̀ⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲣⲁϣⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲇ̀ⲣⲉⲁ̀ⲥ ϫ̀ⲫⲉ Ⲫϯ: ⲣⲁϣⲉ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲣⲁϣⲉ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲁⲩⲙ̀Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Hail to the mother of God : hail to the saint the virgin : hail to the mother of our Saviour : rejoice O Mary : who bore God : rejoice O holy virgin : rejoice O mother of Christ.
rows.cop_lat: Shere Theo-toke : shere pen-agia parthenia : shere metherthe osoteeria : rashe Mariam : edre-as egfe Efnoti : rashe tiparthenos ethouab : rashe ethmav emavem-pi-Ekhristos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲱ̀ ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲙⲓⲑⲉⲣⲑⲉ ⲟ̀Ⲭⲥ̅: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲧ̀ⲥⲁⲃⲉ ⲣⲁϣⲉ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲣ̅: ⲣⲁϣⲉ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲁϥϯ ⲁ̀ⲭⲱⲣⲁⲩⲧⲏⲥ ⲧⲟⲛ ⲁⲣⲭⲏ ⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓ.
rows.en: Hail to the heaven : hail to the chaste : hail to the mother of Christ : hail to the bride : hail to the wise : rejoice O mother of our Saviour : rejoice O light of the world : hail to the one who is honoured by the archangels.
rows.cop_lat: Shere etfe : shere osemne shere mi-therthe o-Ekhristos : shere etsheleet : shere etsave rashi ethmav empensoteer : rashi ep-ooini empikosmos : shere afti akhoravtees ton arshee angeli.

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲉ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲭⲱⲣⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ: ⲣⲁϣⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓ ⲧⲟⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Rejoice O you who is honoured by the choir of angels : rejoice O Mary : O full of grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Rashi em-eptayo : emefnav enje epkhoros en-angelos : rashi Mariam : ke-khari tomenee : o-Kireyos metaso.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲓⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲛⲉⲕⲥⲏⲛ: ⲕⲉⲩⲗⲟⲅⲓⲙⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ⲧⲏⲥ ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲓⲥ: ⲡⲓⲕⲁⲣⲓ: ⲟⲩⲥⲁⲣⲣⲁ: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓ ⲧⲟⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Blessed is your birthgiving : and blessed is your fruit : in which your heart rejoices : hail to you O Mary : O full of grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Evlogimenos enje ennekseen : kevlogimenos : tees karpis : pi-kari : osarra : shere Mariam : kekhari tomenee : oKireyos metaso.

rows.cop: Ⲧⲥⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓϩⲓⲟ̀ⲙⲓ: ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϩⲏⲧ ϥ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁⲙ: ⲕⲉ ⲭⲁⲣⲓ ⲧⲟⲙⲉⲛⲏ: ⲟⲩ Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩ.
rows.en: Blessed are you among women : blessed is your fruit : in which your heart rejoices : O Mary O full of grace : the Lord is with you.
rows.cop_lat: Et-esmaro-ot entho khen ni-hiomi : ef-esmaro-ot enje pi-karpos enheet efrashi Mariam : ke-khari tomenee : oKireyos metaso.

rows.en: - VERSES FOR SAINT MARY & SAINTS -

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅.
rows.en: Joy be to you O mother of God : Mary the mother of Jesus Christ.
rows.ar_lat: Rashi ne Theotokos ethmav en Ekhristos.
rows.cop_lat: O ti: Maria Isous pi-

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲁⲭ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲓⲱⲁⲛⲛⲏⲥ.
rows.en: Joy be to you O holy, our father and teacher, Saint John the beloved.
rows.cop_lat: Rashi nak o pi-agios : Penyot nem pensakh Abba Yoanness

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲱ̀ ϯⲙⲁⲣⲧⲩⲣⲟⲥ ϯⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁ ⲙ̀ⲙⲓ Ⲧⲩⲙⲓⲁ̀ⲛⲏ.
rows.en: Joy be to you O martyr, the holy Saint Demiana.
rows.cop_lat: Rashi ne O ti-martiria : ti-agia emmi Timianee.

rows.cop: Ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲱ̀ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ Ⲁⲃⲃⲁ Ⲁⲑⲁⲛⲁⲥⲓⲱⲥ ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲓⲕⲟⲥ. Ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲡⲉⲛⲃⲟⲏ̀ⲑⲟⲥ ϯⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲗⲓ ⲙ̀Ⲫϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ϥ̀ⲛⲁⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ: ϥ̀ⲛⲁⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲒⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Joy be to you O holy, Saint Athanasius, the apostolic. Rejoice with God our supporter, O the vine of the True God. Jacob rejoices and Israel delights.
rows.cop_lat: Rashi nak O pi-agios : Abba Athanasius piapostolikos. + + + Theleel em-Efnoty penvo-ethos ti-aloli emEfnoty enta efmee. Efnatheleel enje Yakob efna o-onof enje pi-Israel.

rows.cop: Ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ϣⲁ ⲉⲛⲉϩ: ⲛ̀ⲥⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ.
rows.en: They rejoice forever, and grow in hope.
rows.cop_lat: Sena-thelil sha eneh : ensa owoh en o-helpees.

rows.cop: Ⲁ ⲡⲁϩⲏⲧ ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲁⲗⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲓⲗ.
rows.en: My heart and my tongue rejoice with praise.
rows.cop_lat: A naheet onof : owoh palas khen otheleel.

rows.cop: Ⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲙ̀ⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲟⲥ. ⲛⲁⲥⲱϯ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ
rows.en: Praising God has saved you, through your purity.
rows.cop_lat: Peten-theleel nasoty emmoten : evol eeeten nete en-katharos.

rows.cop: Ⲑⲱϥ ⲱⲣ ⲙⲉⲛ ϩⲟⲣⲁⲙⲁ ⲡⲉⲛⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ. :
rows.en: Your name mentioned, as chanting.
rows.ar_lat: too it is
rows.cop_lat: is our Thof op men horama pentheleel pe pekran.

rows.en: - SUNDAY’S THEOTOKIA -

rows.cop: Ϣⲁϣϥ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲏⲛⲓ: ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲁϩⲏⲧ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ϯⲛⲁ ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ: Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲉ̀ⲡ̀ⲧⲏⲣϥ.
rows.en: Seven times each day : with all my heart : I bless Your name : O Lord of all.
rows.cop_lat: Shashf ensop emmini : evol khen paheet teerf : tina-esmo epekran : Epetchoise empiepteerf.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲓⲉⲣⲫ̀ⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲓϫⲉⲙⲛⲟⲙϯ: ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉ̀ⲱⲛ Ⲫϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ.
rows.en: I remembered Your name : and was comforted : O King of ages : and God of Gods.
rows.ar_lat: A-er-efmev-ee empekran : ayjemnomty : enni-e-oon : ente nenoty.
rows.cop_lat: owoh ep-oro Efnoty

rows.cop: Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅ Ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲡⲓⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲓⲛⲟⲥ: ⲫⲏⲉⲧⲁϥⲓ̀ ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱϯ: ⲁϥⲉⲣⲥⲱⲙⲁⲧⲓⲕⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Jesus Christ : our true God : who came and incarnated : for our salvation.
rows.cop_lat: Isous pi-Ekhristos Pennoty : pi-alithinos : fi-etaf-e ethve pensoty : afersomatikos.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ Ⲡⲓⲡⲛ̅ⲁ̅ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ϯϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅.
rows.en: Incarnated : of the Holy Spirit : and of Mary : the pure bride.
rows.cop_lat: Afetchisarex evol : khen Pi-epnevma Ethouab : nem evol khen Maria : tishelet ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲫⲱⲛϩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛϩⲏⲃⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡⲉⲛϩⲟⲅϩⲉⲅ ⲧⲏⲣϥ: ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛ̀ϩⲏⲧ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲉ̀ ⲡ̀ⲧⲏⲣϥ.
rows.en: And turned our sorrow : and all our anguish : into heartly joy : and complete rejoicing.
rows.cop_lat: Afvonh empenheebi : nem penhog-heg terf : e-orashi enheet : nem otheleel epteerf.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟϥ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲩⲙⲛⲟⲥ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲙⲁⲩ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ.
rows.en: Let us kneel unto Him : and chant to : His mother Mary : the beautiful dove.
rows.cop_lat: Maren-o-osht emmof : owoh enten-erhemnos : entefmav Maria : tietsherombi ethnesos.

rows.cop: Ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲛⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲥ̀ⲙⲏ ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ: ϫⲉ ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲙⲙⲁⲛⲟⲩⲏⲗ.
rows.en: And shout with : rejoicing voices saying : Hail to you O Mary : mother of Emmanuel.
rows.cop_lat: Owoh enten-osh evol : khen o-esmeen theleel : je shere ne Maria : ethmav en Emmanuel.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϯ ⲛ̀Ⲁ ⲇⲁⲙ ⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲙ̀ⲫⲱⲧ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲛ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲩⲁ̀: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲛⲟϥⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ̀.
rows.en: Hail to you O Mary : rescue of Adam our father : Hail… : mother of salvation : Hail… : joy of Eve : Hail… : joy of generations.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne Maria : epsoty en Adam penyot : shere… : ethmav empimaemfoot : shere… : eptheleel en Eva : shere… : ep-onof enigenia.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ⲫ̀ⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲁ ⲃⲉⲗ ⲡⲓⲑ̀ⲏⲓ: ⲭⲉ̅: ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁ ⲫ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲭⲉ̅ ⲫ̀ⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲛ̀Ⲛⲱⲉ̀: ⲭⲉ̅: ϯⲁⲧⲑⲱⲗⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲉ.
rows.en: Hail… : joy of Abel the righteous : Hail… : the true virgin : Hail… : rescue of Noah : Hail… : undefiled and quiet.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ef-rashi en Abel pi-ethmi : shere… : ti-parthenos enta efmee : shere… : efnohem en No-e’ : shere… : ti-at-tholeb en-semne.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ϩ̀ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛ̀Ⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡⲓⲭ̀ⲗⲟⲙ ⲛ̀ⲁⲑⲗⲱⲙ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲥⲱϯ ⲛ̀Ⲓ ⲥⲁⲁⲕ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
rows.en: Hail… : grace of Abraham : Hail… : the undiminishing crown : Hail… : salvation of Isaiah : Hail… : mother of the Holy.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ep-ehmot en-Abram : shere… : pi eklom en-athlom : shere… : epsoty en Isaak : shere… : ethmav emfi ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲑⲉⲗⲏⲗ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ: ⲭⲉ̅: ϩⲁⲛⲑ̀ⲃⲁ ⲛ̀ⲕⲱⲃ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲇⲉⲥⲡⲟⲧⲁ.
rows.en: Hail… : rejoicing of Jacob : Hail… : many times over : Hail… : pride of Judah : Hail… : mother of the Master.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ep-theleel en Yakoob : shere… : han ethva enkoob : shere… : epshosho en Yooda : shere… : ethmav empzespota.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ϩⲓⲱⲓϣ ⲙ̀Ⲙⲱⲩ̀ⲥⲏⲥ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲇⲉⲥⲡⲟⲧⲁ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲁⲙⲟⲩⲏⲗ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ.
rows.en: Hail… : preaching of Moses : Hail… : mother of the Master : Hail… : honour of Samuel : Hail… : pride of Israel.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ephi-oish em-Moesees : shere… : ethmav empi-zespota : shere… : eptayo enSamoeel : shere… : epshosho em-Pisrael.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲱⲃ ⲡⲓ ⲑ̀ⲙⲏⲓ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡⲓⲱ̀ⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲙⲏⲓ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ.
rows.en: Hail… : sureness of Jacob the righteous : Hail… : the precious stone : Hail… : mother of the beloved : Hail… : daughter of King David.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : eptagro enYoob pi ethmee : shere… : pi oni en anami : shere… : ethmav empimenrit : shere… : etsheri em ep-oro David.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ϯϣ̀ⲫⲉⲣⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲟⲗⲟⲙⲱⲛ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲛ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ⲛ̀ⲡ̀Ⲥⲁⲏ̀ⲁⲥ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲧⲁⲗϭⲟ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲉⲣⲙⲉⲓⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Hail… : beloved of Solomon : Hail… : strength of the righteous : Hail… : rescue of Isaiah : healing of Jeremiah.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ti eshferi en Solomoon : shere… : epetchisi enni zike-on : shere… : ep-ogay en Ep-sa-eias : shere… : eptaletcho en Ieremeyas.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡ̀ⲉ̀ⲙⲓ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲉⲍⲉⲕⲓⲏⲗ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲭⲁⲣⲓⲥ ⲧⲟⲩ Ⲇⲁⲛⲓⲏⲗ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲧ̀ϫⲟⲙ ⲛ̀Ⲏⲗⲓⲁⲥ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲡⲓϩ ⲙⲟⲧ ⲛ̀Ⲉⲗⲓⲥⲉⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail… : knowledge of Ezekiel : Hail… : grace of Daniel : Hail… : strength of Elijah : Hail… : grace of Elisha.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ep emi en Ezekieel : shere… : kharis to Dani-eel : shere… : etgom en Eleyas : shere… : piehmot en Elise-os.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉ̅: ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀Ⲓⲏⲥ̅ Ⲡⲭⲥ̅: ⲭⲉ̅: ϯϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ: ⲭⲉ̅: ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲛ̀ Ⲩⲓⲟⲥ Ⲑⲉⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail… : mother of God : Hail… : mother of Jesus Christ : Hail… : the beautiful dove : Hail… : mother of the Son of God.
rows.cop_lat: Shere… : ti-theotokos : shere… : ethmav en Isous pi-Ekhristos : shere… : ti-etchrombi ethnesos : shere… : ethmav en Eyos Theos.

rows.cop: Ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲩⲉⲣⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉ ⲛⲁⲥ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Hail to Mary : to whom all : prophets witnessed : and said.
rows.cop_lat: Shere ne Maria : etav er-methre nas : enje ni eprofitees tiro : owoh avgo emmos.

rows.cop: Ϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ Ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲛ̀ϧⲏϯ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧⲟⲩⲁⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲥⲣⲏϯ. Ⲧⲉϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲁ̀ⲗⲏⲑⲱⲥ: ⲉ̀ϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁⲁ̀ⲣⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ ⲑⲏⲉⲑⲙⲉϩ ⲛ̀ϩ ⲙⲟⲧ.
rows.en: Thereby God the Word : who incarnated : from you : in an indescribable oneness. You are truly : exalted above : the rod of Aaron : O full of grace.
rows.cop_lat: Heeppe Efnoty piloghos : etafetchisarex en-khity : khen o-met-oway : enatsaji em-pesreety. Te-etchosi alithos : ehote pi-eshvoot : ente Aaron : o-thi-ethmeh en-ehmot.

rows.cop: Ⲁϣⲡⲉ ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲏⲗ ⲉ̀Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀: ϫⲉ ⲛ̀ⲑⲟϥ ⲡⲉ ⲡ̀ⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲥⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: What is the except Mary : resembles : virginity.
rows.ar_lat: rod : for it her
rows.cop_lat: Ashpe pi eshvot : eveel e Maria : je enthof pe eptipos : entespartheneya.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲥⲉⲣⲃⲟⲕⲓ ⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ: ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥ ⲥⲩⲛⲟⲥⲓⲁ̀: ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲫⲏⲉⲧϭⲟⲥⲓ: ⲡⲓⲗ̀ⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ⲁⲓⲇⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: Conceived and gave birth : without coition : to the Son of the Highest : the ever lasting Word.
rows.cop_lat: As-er-voki asmisi : khoris sino-seya : emepsheeri emfee eeetchosi : piloghos en aydia.

rows.cop: Ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲥⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲓⲁ̀: ⲁ̀ⲟⲩⲱⲛ ⲛⲁⲛ Ⲡⲟⲥ̅: ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ϯⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: Through her prayers : and her intercessions : open for us O Lord : the churches’ doors.
rows.cop_lat: Heeten nes-evkee : nem nes epresveya : ao-oon nan Epetchoise : em efro ente ti-ekekleesia.

rows.cop: Ϯϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟ: ⲱ̀ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: ⲭⲁ ⲫ̀ⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲉⲕⲕ̀ⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ: ⲉⲩⲟⲩⲏⲛ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ.
rows.en: I ask you : O mother of God : keep the churches doors : open to the faithful.
rows.cop_lat: Tee-tee ho ero : O titheotokos : ka efro enni ek-ekleesia : ev-o-on enni pistos.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛϯϩⲟ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲥⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲡⲉⲥⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥⲭⲱ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ. : : :
rows.en: Let us ask her : to pray for us : to her beloved Son : to forgive us.
rows.ar_lat: Marentiho eros ethres-toveh egon nahren pesmenrit ethrefko nan evol.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲩⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉ̀ⲣⲟ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ϯϩ̀ⲣⲏⲣⲓ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲥ̀ⲑⲟⲓⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ.
rows.en: You are called : O Mary the virgin : the holy flower : of the incense.
rows.cop_lat: Avmoty ero : Maria tiparthenos : je ti-ehreeri ethouab : ente pi estoinofi.

rows.cop: Ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥϯⲟⲩⲱ̀ ⲉ̀ⲡ̀ϣⲱⲓ: ⲁⲥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲁⲧⲣⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲥ: ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲡ̀ⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ.
rows.en: Who flourished : and budded : from the root of the patriarchs : and prophets.
rows.cop_lat: Thi etasti-o-oo eepshoi : asfiri evol : khen ethoni enni patriarchees : nem ni eprofitees.

rows.cop: Ⲙⲫ̀ⲣⲏϯ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϣ̀ⲃⲱⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲁⲁⲣⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ: ⲉ̀ⲧⲁϥⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲁϥⲟⲛⲧ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲣⲡⲟⲥ.
rows.en: Like the rod : of Aaron the priest : that budded : and gave fruit.
rows.cop_lat: Em efreety empi eshvot : ente Aaron pi oweeb etaf-firi evol : afopt en-karpos.

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ⲁ̀ⲣⲉϫ̀ⲫⲏ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ: ⲁϭⲛⲉ ⲥ̀ⲡⲉⲣⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ⲣⲱⲙⲓ: ⲉⲥⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲁⲧⲧⲁⲕⲟ: ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲣⲉⲥⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲓⲁ̀.
rows.en: For you gave birth : to the Word : without human seed : while your virginity is undefiled.
rows.cop_lat: Je ari egfo em piloghos : atchne esperma enromi : esoi en-attako : enje tesparthenia.

rows.cop: Ⲉⲑⲃⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉ: ϩⲱⲥ ⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: ⲙⲁϯϩⲟ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥⲭⲱ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Therefore we : glorify you : as the mother of God : ask your Son to forgive us.
rows.cop_lat: Ethve fay tenti-oo ne : hoos theotokos : matiho empe-sheeri : ethrefko nan evol.

rows.en: - FOR SAINT MARY -

rows.cop: Ⲁⲧⲁⲓ ⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲧⲁⲓⲟ̀ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ ⲁ̀ ⲧⲁⲓ ϣⲉⲗⲉⲧ ϭⲓ ⲛ̀ⲟⲩⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫⲟⲟⲩ: ⲑⲁⲓ ⲉⲧϫⲟⲗϩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛ ϣ̀ⲧⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲓⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲉⲥⲥⲉⲗⲥⲱⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲟ ⲛ̀ⲣⲏϯ.
rows.en: This virgin has today attained honour : this bride has today attained glory : her gown is made of gold thread : and is adorned with many colourful things.
rows.cop_lat: Atai parthenos etchi en-o-tayo emfo-oo : atai shelet etchi en-ooo em-fo-oo : thai etgolh khen han eshtati eneeb eno-oob : eselsol khen otho enreety.

rows.cop: Ⲁ Ⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲕⲓⲙ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲥⲟ̀ϩⲓ ⲉ̀ⲣⲁⲧⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ϯⲟⲩⲣⲱ ⲥⲁⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲛⲁⲙ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲕ ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ.
rows.en: David moved the first string of his harp : crying out saying : “the queen stood at Your right hand O King.”
rows.cop_lat: A David kim empi shorp enkap ente tef keethara : ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je as-ohi erats enje ti-ooro saowee nam emmok eporo.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲃ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲧⲁϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲣⲉⲕ ⲡⲉⲙⲁϣϫ ⲁ̀ⲣⲓ ⲡ̀ⲱⲃϣ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲡ̀ⲏⲓ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲉⲓⲱⲧ.
rows.en: He moved the second string of his harp : crying out saying : “hear my daughter, see and incline your ear : forget your people and the whole household of your father.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah esnav enkap : ente tef kithara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je sotem tasheeree anav rek pemashg : aree ep-obsh enpee-la-os nem ep-ee teerf ente peyot.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲅ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲡ̀ⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲛ̀ⲧ̀ϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡ̀ⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ⲉ̀ⲥⲉⲃⲱⲛ ⲉⲥϫⲟⲗϩ ϧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛ ϣ̀ⲧⲁϯ ⲛ̀ⲓⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ⲛⲟⲩⲃ.
rows.en: He moved the third string of his harp : crying out saying : “all the glory of the daughter of the king is within : clothed in gold-fringed garments.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah shomt enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je ep-ooo teerf en etsheree em ep-ooro en es-evon : es golh khen han eshtatee en-eeb ennoob.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲇ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲉⲩⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲛⲓ ⲉ̀ϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙ̀ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ϩⲓⲫⲁϣⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ.
rows.en: He moved the fourth string of his harp : crying out saying : “unto the king shall enter : virgins after her.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah eftoo enkap : ente tef kithara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je ev-e eenee-ekhoon empeeooro : enhan parthenos heefa hoo emmos.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲉ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲡⲉ Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲉ̀ⲙⲁϣⲱ ϧⲉⲛ ⲑ̀ⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲉϥⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ.
rows.en: He moved the fifth string of his harp : crying out saying : “great is the Lord and exceedingly blessed : in the city of our God on His holy mountain.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah etee-oo enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je oneshty pe Epetchoise ef-esmaro-oot ema sho : khen ethvaky em Pennoty heejen pef tooo ethouab.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲥⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲧⲉⲛϩ ⲛ̀ϭⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲩⲟϣϫ ⲛ̀ⲓⲉⲃ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲥⲕⲉⲙⲟϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲧⲟⲩⲉⲧ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲃ.
rows.en: He moved the sixth string of his harp : crying out saying : “the wings of a dove covered with silver : and her feathers with yellow gold.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah soo enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je han tenh en etchrompee ev-oshg enneeb enhat : owoh neske moty khen oo-otoo et ente oo-noob.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲍ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲕⲉⲛⲓ ⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲧ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϭⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲕⲉⲛⲓⲱ̀ⲟⲩⲧ.
rows.en: He moved the seventh string of his harp : crying out saying : “the mountain of God, the mountain full of good things : the rugged mountain, the mountain full of good things.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah shashf enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je pee tooo ente Efnoty pee tooo etke nee o-oot : pee to-oo etchees pee to-oo et kenee o-oot.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲏ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲛⲉϥⲥⲉⲛϯ ϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉ̀ⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲁ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲙⲉⲓ ⲛ̀ⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ.
rows.en: He moved the eighth string of his harp : crying out saying : “His foundations are in the holy mountains : the Lord loves the gates of Zion.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah eshmeen enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je nef senty khen nee tooo ethouab : a Epetchoise mee ennee peelee ente Seyon.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲑ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲏϯ ⲛ̀ϩⲁⲛ ϩ̀ⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ̀ ⲉⲧⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ Ⲫϯ.
rows.en: He moved the ninth string of his harp : crying out saying : “they have said concerning you : honoured things O city of God.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epe-mah epseet enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je av sajee eth-veetee enhan ehvee owee : evtai oot teevaky ente Efnoty.

rows.cop: Ⲁϥⲕⲓⲙ ⲉ̀ ⲡⲓⲙⲁϩ ⲓ̅ ⲛ̀ⲕⲁⲡ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲕⲩⲑⲁⲣⲁ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ: ϫⲉ ⲁ̀Ⲡϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲛ̀Ⲥⲓⲱⲛ ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲉ̀ⲟⲩⲙⲁ ⲛ̀ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ.
rows.en: He moved the tenth string of his harp : crying out saying : “the Lord has chosen Zion : He has chosen her as a dwelling for Himself.”
rows.cop_lat: Afkeem epee-mah meet enkap : ente tef keethara ev-osh evol efgo emmos : je a Epetchoise sotp en Seyon : afsotp emmos e-oo ma en shopy naf.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ: ⲱ̀ⲧⲉⲛϭ̅ⲥ̅ ⲛ̀ⲛⲏⲓⲃ ⲧⲏⲣⲉⲛ ϯⲑⲉⲟ̀ⲧⲟⲕⲟⲥ: Ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ̀ ⲑ̀ⲙⲁⲩ ⲙ̀Ⲡⲉⲛⲥⲱⲧⲏⲣ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉϥⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: Intercede for us : O lady of us all the Theo-tokos : Mary the mother of our Saviour : that He may forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Aree epresvevin eehree egon : O tenchoys en-nef teeren-ti Theo-tokos : Maria ethmav em-Pensoteer : entef kanen novee nan evol.

rows.en: (Verses for other saints may be recited.)
- EPOURO -

rows.cop: Ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛⲧⲉ ϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ: ⲭⲁ ⲛⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ.
rows.en: O King of peace : give us peace : establish Your peace : and forgive us our sins.
rows.cop_lat: Ep-ooro ente tiheereene : moi nan entek heereene : semni nan entek heereene : ka nen novee nan evol.

rows.en: Disperse the church enemies : and fortify her : to be unshakeable : forever.
rows.cop_lat: Goor evol eni gaji : ente ti-ek-ekleseya : arisoft eros : enneskim sha eneh.

rows.en: To bless us all : and purify our heart : and heal the sickness : of our souls and bodies.
rows.cop_lat: Entef esmo eron teeren : entef tovo en-nenheet : entef taletcho ennishoni : ente nen epsiki nem nen soma.

rows.en: We worship You O Christ : with Your Good Father : and the Holy Spirit : for You have come and saved us.

rows.en: - V ENERATION TO THE SAINTS -
Doxologies Saint Mary Saint Mark Saint George Saint Demiana Saint Athanasius Saint Athanasius 2 Saint Anthony Pope Kyrillos
VENERATION TO SAINT MARY
Hail to you, O Mary, the pride of our race : The very and true queen, the pure symbol of grace
Hail to the throne of God, the second Heaven : The mother of our Saviour, the salvation of all men.
Hail to the pure virgin, the help of all mankind : The daughter of David, who leaves no one behind.
Hail to her who appeared, to millions abroad : And converted many, to become children of God.
Hail to her who received, the angel Gabriel : And did bear in her womb, the salvation of Israel.
Hail to the ever-virgin, who carried in her hand : Emmanuel, before whom, all the angels stand.
Hail to her who appeared, on the domes of Zeitoun : As a shining figure of light, as bright as the sun at noon.
Hail to the undefiled, the perpetual virgin : Who brought us peace on earth, and goodwill toward men.
Hail to her who heard, Gabriel’s salutation : Proclaiming unto her, the Messiah’s visitation.
Hail to the new Eve, who brought us salvation : Forget not your children, in the hour of temptation.
Hail to the mother of God, blessed by all generations : The handmaid of the Lord, worthy of all exaltation.
Hail to the censer, carrying the Divine Ember : In the presence of the Lord, your children remember.
Hail to the pure vessel, bearer of the Great Mystery : And through whom was fulfilled, the promise to the ancestry.
Hail to the glorious one, who is to be called blessed : By all the generations, by us and all the rest.
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : Remember us before the Lord, Saint Mary help us all.
VENERATION TO SAINT MARK
O Lord, grant us wisdom, and teach us to understand : How to praise Saint Mark, the evangelist of our Lord.
In the city of Jerusalem, he grew up as a Jew : At school he did earn, both Greek and Hebrew.
Saint Mary the mother of God, was pious and devout : She taught him the fear of God, and the faith without a doubt.
One day he was walking, while yet a young man : He saw John the baptist, on the shores of the Jordan.
He heard him saying, to those who stood by : “There comes One after me, whose shoes I dare not untie.”
Soon after that he saw, a Galilean man : Coming to be baptised, by John in the Jordan.
He saw the Holy Spirit, in the shape of a dove : Descending upon Him, from the heavens above.
He followed the Galilean, from country to country : And was chosen by Him, as one of the seventy.
In his house at Jerusalem, the Lord Jesus did eat : The last supper and washed, His disciples feet.
In the same house too, the disciples used to meet : And there in the upper room, they received the Paraclete.
To the land of Egypt, with Saint Peter he came : To preach and baptise, in the Lord Jesus’ Name.
After some years went by, he received the call : To preach the word of God, with Barnabas and Paul.
He preached in Cyprus, and the land of Cyrene : Then he was called to return, to Egypt once again.
To Alexandria he came, with the message of salvation : Preaching Christianity, throughout all the nation.
Saint Ananias was chosen, by him and anointed : And priests and deacons, they both were appointed.
Then once again he received, the calling to depart : To preach the word of God, in another part.
He ministered to Saint Paul, when he was in jail : With zeal and courage, and faith that cannot fail.
And after he returned, to Egypt once again : And learned that his labors, had not been in vain.
The vine he had planted, took root and filled the land : Nourished and watered, by the Almighty’s hand.
When he had perfected, the works of his Lord : He knew it was time to depart, to his heavenly abode.
He suffered great afflictions, and endured without fear : Till he was adorned, with the crown of a martyr.
Blessed are you Saint Mark, the evangelist of our Lord : You shall receive your reward, from your dear Lord’s hand.
Blessed are you Saint Mark, who taught us the Gospel : O servant faithful and wise, you have done so well.
In your liturgy you taught us, about the heavenly bread : The life of the coming age, and the resurrection of the dead.
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : Remember us before the Lord, Saint Mark help us all.
VENERATION TO SAINT GEORGE
Hail to you Saint George, the prince of the martyrs : For the sake of your Lord, you endured for seven years.
Hail to you O hero, who forsook all worldly things : Leaving this world to dwell, in the shadow of His wings.
Hail to you great prince, who did tear the decree : Proclaiming to all men, “Pagans we shall not be!
We have only One God, He is the True Lord : For us He was killed, His side pierced by the sword.”
Hail to you O Saint George, your faith you have announced : Before all the people, their gods you have denounced.
Through the sign of the Cross, you were filled with power : Before seventy rulers, you stood as a tower.
Hail to you O Saint George, you shared your Saviours pain : Many heavenly crowns, you did obtain.
In your many afflictions, your eyes looked up above : Ever beholding, your Saviours tender love.
With love and compassion, he answered your call : He came to you Himself, Our Lord, who is above all.
Hail to you Saint George, you fought a great war : O triumphant martyr, you opened Heaven’s door.
Hail to the courageous, winner of the great victory : To whom what was concealed, is no longer a mystery.
Hail to you Saint George, great is your name : Throughout the entire world, has spread your fame.
Hail to you Saint George, intercessor for all : When we call on your name, please hear our call.
Hail to you Saint George, may all the nations call : “O God of Saint George, help us all.”
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : Remember us before the Lord, Saint George help us all.
VENERATION TO SAINT DEMIANA
Great truth is your honour, O Holy Saint : Who has become a member, of the Church’s martyrs.
A great truth indeed, your efforts may also : Become long indeed, in your holy glory.
Blessed are you my lady, Demiana the martyr : You received a great amount, of tortures from soldiers.
Blessed are you Saint Demiana, your many tortures : Are very strong, with valuable crowns.
O pure selected Demiana, the stubborn soldiers : Became confused, because of your great faith.
You left all the earthly, and all therein : And liked the heavenly, and loved it’s regions.
You liked the retirement, for generations of humans : And attained perfection, as lighten rites.
You liked the desert, and dwelt in it’s environment : And also our Lord, brightened your light within.
You loved the celibacy, when you were young : Peaking at the age, of a small bright star.
You liked purity O Saint, and became a beacon : For all the children, of the Church.
You asked the father, to build a tower : To worship God, and left the entire world.
And he answered your request, and built a beautiful palace : According to your hearts request, for hymns and carols.
You chose forty virgins, and you gained grace : And you quickly gained, speech and knowledge.
Even the soldiers acts, became shameful : When you followed God, you and your pure virgins.
Mary your father, when he followed the infidel : He repented, by your brilliant protest.
Triple blessed are you, you who where raised : Lighten me with your shine, O you the combatant.
Blessed are you, who won and accepted : Protect me, because you have conquered.
I the poor, ask from a pure virgin : To be kind, and peaceful in my death.
I the sinner ask, a pure virgin : To raise my steps and help me when I say:
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : All of us say “O God of, Saint Demiana help us all.”
VENERATION TO SAINT ATHANASIUS
The defender of the faith, the great Saint Athanasius : Who rescued the whole Church, from the heresy of Arius.
When he was yet a child, playing on the beach : He solemnly performed, a sacrament of the Church.
But he was not aware, that the Pope Saint Alexander : From his palace afar, was watching with wonder.
The Pope then decided, to adopt him as a son : And that was the start, of the course he had to run.
He studied the scriptures, and the Gospels word by word : Till he found the mystery of, the divinity of the Lord.
When Arius began to deny, the divinity of the Son : He knew that he was destined, for a war that had to be won.
Against the heretics, he began to preach and write : Proclaiming the truth of God, with all courage and might.
At the council of Nicea, the faith he did uphold : Defending the Trinity, and the doctrines taught of old.
He fought for the faith, by word and by deed : And when the war was won, he bequeathed to us the creed.
When the Pope’s time had come, that before Christ he should stand : He called Saint Athanasius, and laid upon him the hand.
Pope Athanasius endured, for forty years and some : Defending all his flock, from whatever may come.
Time after time, to exile he went : Carrying the Cross with him, whom the Father sent.
Rejoice Saint Athanasius, in the heavenly Paradise : O great one among saints, and the prudent and the wise.
O beloved of the Son of God, who did uphold his cause : The angels proclaim and say, “Axios, axios axios!”
O friend of Saint Anthony, who taught us about his way : Remember us before the Lord, on that most fearful day.
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : All of us say “O God of, Saint Athanasius help us all.”
ANOTHER VENERATION TO SAINT ATHANASIUS
O pure righteous heart, and great apparent faith : Dismissive of manifestations, Pope Ava Athanasius.
As a small child, God gave him the measure : He had no peers, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Baptising the children, in the sea and on sand : Pope Alexander said, Pope Ava Athanasius.
The Pope’s apprentice, and lured him on his hands : To worship his creator, Pope Ava Athanasius.
He progressed in the grace, and mercy and best known : For patience with wisdom, Pope Ava Athanasius.
The Lord opened his heart, for his faith in his Lord : Who he chose and loved, Pope Ava Athanasius.
He entered the theological, and knew the heavenly : Seminary pure teachings, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Sponsored by the grace of God, invited him to glory : Through the guides of sinners, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Blessed are you who is wearing, the light of joy and pleasure : And became a famous name, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Your name means eternal, and worshipped Christ : And steadfast in the faith, Pope Ava Athanasius.
When Arius came, and taught against Jesus : You overcame him and Satan, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Arius and his associates, and his friend the devil : All this time fought you, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Pains did not stop you, from the light of the Lord : The perfect One, Pope Ava Athanasius.
Arius and the infidel, the malicious demon : Of the theology of Jesus, Pope Ava Athanasius.
True faith in you, O Athanasius the great : Is known since the ancient, Pope Ava Athanasius.
They said the world is against you, and you are confident : With your Lord this is your faith, Pope Ava Athanasius.
I am against the world, no matter what you do to me : Or cut up my body, Pope Ava Athanasius.
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : All of us say “O God of, Saint Athanasius help us all.”
VENERATION TO SAINT ANTHONY
In the Church of the victorious, with the faithful righteous : Stands the most pious, penyot Ava Antonious.
Stands in the radiant glory, the ascetic and saintly : To adore the most Holy, penyot Ava Antonious.
You resolved to respond, to the holy words to read : And adhere to what was said, penyot Ava Antonious.
A youth who could realise, that a spiritual exercise : Is the bread for the wise, penyot Ava Antonious.
Powerful constant prayers, rose for years and years : You served over sweet tears, penyot Ava Antonious.
The body you mortified, the soul you sanctified : To the world you died, penyot Ava Antonious.
Resembling the Cherubim, in the rite of the Seraphim : Fastings that would not cease, penyot Ava Antonious.
The demons terrified, with a life sanctified : Soon they tried and tried, penyot Ava Antonious.
Tore your heart asunder, with thoughts of your sister : You proved you are wiser, penyot Ava Antonious.
Stirred in you thoughts of fame, money and a big name : You put them all to shame, penyot Ava Antonious.
Women to you they brought, so that you might be caught : In the warfare of thought, penyot Ava Antonious.
Even in the form of beasts, couldn’t disturb you the least : Your modesty saw their defeat, penyot Ava Antonious.
In your ears they thundered, around you they wandered : The faithful won’t surrender, penyot Ava Antonious.
You always stayed the same, devoted to the Holy Name : The contrite’s soul overcame, penyot Ava Antonious.
With the spirit of Elijah, and the prophetess Anna : And the son of Zachariah, penyot Ava Antonious.
An inviolate tower, with virtues you’re higher : From power to power, penyot Ava Antonious.
Ava Anthony the castle, an unconquered fortress : The resolute relentless, penyot Ava Antonious.
With love we venerate, Ava Anthony the great : The pure and the chaste, penyot Ava Antonious.
Father in your height, pray for our plight : As we continue to fight, penyot Ava Antonious.
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : Remember us before the Lord, Saint Anthony help us all.
VENERATION TO POPE KYRILLOS
Among the stars of the Paradise, servant of the Lord Isous : Light of the Baramous Monastery, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
When Emmanuel chose him, he decided to resign : To serve the Holy Bible, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
When nominated to be a Bishop, he left the ‘Eklirikeyah’ : Preferring the wilderness, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He did prefer the wilderness, he walked the difficult road : God granted him wisdom, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
The fathers pitied him, the saint prayed with hope : Heaven supported him, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
When the seven monks left, he offered himself to serve : Those who were kicked out, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
And when it came to pass, the monks returned happily : And quickly to their monastery, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He prayed in the windmill, matins and vespers : God granted him knowledge, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
Emmanuel guided him, he performed great wonders : In the monastery of Saint Samuel, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
God’s will chose him, to be the shepherd of shepherds : Upon knowing he cried bitterly, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
Majestic in his fighting, prudent in his guidance : Chosen by his Lord, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He listened to the apostle’s sayings, he rebuked the lazy : Serving in great purity, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He had tolerance for the herd, never letting it go astray : He accompanied it with a humble heart, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He did not seek his praise, but guided the flatterers : He was an honest man, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He awoke in the early morning, whether in health or sickness : To praise the Lord of lords, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He was truly modest, loving to all mankind : Companion to the angels, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
The Lord accepted his prayers, his incense and fasting : And accepted it all before Him, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
Hail to the man of power, hail to the one who adored the Lord : The one who accepted sinners, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
Hail to the new Jeremiah, the one with great sacrifices : The one with tears and sighs, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
You gained the grace of Moses, and the priesthood of Aaron : And the wisdom of Solomon, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
To the light he guided us, to the friendship of Saint Mina : And his Church he did build, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
In a short period of time, he accomplished a lot of work : With the Creator’s help, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He built the Cathedral, and many other Churches : To spread the Christian faith, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He miraculously returned, our beloved’s remains : Saint Mark the apostle, Ppenyot Ava Kyrillos.
He gave to the poor, he healed the sick : He offered to the needy, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
As a shepherd of the Church, he loved the people of Ethiopia : Treating them with great love, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
In the Church of El-Zaytoun, the virgin mother appeared : In the times of this kind shepherd, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
With his hands he made the chrism, amidst the believers : After so many years, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He called the departure of the righteous, traveling to the Heaven : Seeking the Lord of lights, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
He requested to be buried, in the monastery of Saint Mina : Beside his intercessor, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
When he was called by Heaven, he immediately obeyed : And he departed to the fathers, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
At the hour of his departure, he said “God takes care of you” : And completed his struggle, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
Remember the unity of faith, remember us at all times : In front of the Lord of judgment, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
O children of praise, arrange a hymn this day : To the beloved of Jesus Christ, penyot Ava Kyrillos.
May your name be mentioned, by all the faithful : Remember us before the Lord, Saint Kyrillos help us all.

rows.en: - THE THREE CROWNS –
Let us gather, we the people who love God, Jesus Christ : to honour Saint (…).
rows.ar_lat: Falnagtame’u naznoo al-sha’eb almoheb lel-Ellah, Yasoua al-Massieh : le nokkarrem al (keddees/keddeessa) (…).

rows.en: Worthy (x3) (…).
rows.cop_lat: Axia/Axios (x3) (…).

rows.en: A golden crown, a silver crown and a jewel crown upon the head of Saint (…).
rows.ar_lat: Ekleel zahab, wa ekleel fidda, wa ekleel gawhari ‘alla ra’es al (keddees/keddeessa) (…).

rows.en: Amen, amen, amen, alleluia, alleluia, glory to God.
rows.cop_lat: Amen, amen, amen, alleluia, alleluia, pioo fa Pennoty pe.

rows.en: - WA SALAM/THE PEACE OF GOD -
The peace of God be with you : all you people of Christ : and hear His joyful call saying : “enter into the happiness of Paradise.”
rows.ar_lat: Wa salam Allah yakoon ma’akom : ya sha’eb el-massieh be ag-ma’ekom : wa be sawtehy el-fareh yosame’ana wa yosamea’kom : el-ka-el “edkholoo illa farah el-ferdoos.”

rows.en: Through the prayers of the virgin Saint Mary and the bride of Christ Saint Demiana and Saint Athanasius defender of our faith and Saint (…).
rows.ar_lat: Be sallat Mariam el-azra wal shaheeda al-‘afeefa al-kedeesa Demiana wal kedees al-‘azeem Anba Athanasius hamy el-iman wal kedees/kedeesa (…)

rows.en: Worthy…
rows.cop_lat: Axia/Axios…

rows.en: + O our Lord Jesus Christ : Who carries the sin of the world : Count us with Your sheep : Who shall stand upon Your right.
rows.ar_lat: Ya Rabana Yasoua al-Massieh : Hamel khateyat el ‘allam : Ehsebna ma’a kheerafak : Allazina ‘an yameenok.

rows.en: And in Your second coming : Awesome and full of glory : May we never hear You say : “I do not know you.”
rows.ar_lat: ‘Enda zehorik al thany : Al-makhouf la nasma’a : Be re’adattin annany : Lastu a’arifakom.

rows.en: + Rather, may we be worthy : To hear Your tender voice : Which is full of joy : Proclaiming and saying :
rows.ar_lat: Bal nakoun mustahekeen : Le sama’a el-sawt al mumtalea farahan : Allazi le ra’afatek : Yasrokhu ka-eleen:

rows.en: “Come you unto me : O blessed of My Father : And inherit the life : That endures forever.”
rows.ar_lat: “Ta’alu ellaya : Ya mubaraky Abby : Rethu al-hayatu : Al-da-emma ellal abad.

rows.en: + All the martyrs shall come : Bearing their afflictions : And the righteous shall come : Bearing all their virtues.
rows.ar_lat: Ya’aty al-shuhada’ : Hamileena ‘azabati-hum : Wa ya’aty al-sedikeen : Hamileena fada’ ilahum.

rows.en: The Son of God shall also come : In His Father’s glory. To reward every one : According to his works.
rows.ar_lat: Ya’aty ebn Allah : Fi magdihi wa magdi Abbieh : Wa yogazy kolla wahed : Ka a’amalihi allaty ‘amalha.

rows.en: + O Christ, Word of the Father : The only begotten God : Grant us Your peace : Which is full of joy.
rows.ar_lat: Ayoha al-Massieh kalimatu el-Aab : Al-Ellah el waheed : A’atina salamak : Al-mamlo’ farahan.

rows.en: As You have said unto : Your holy apostles : Likewise say unto us : “My peace I give to you.
rows.ar_lat: Kamma a’ataytahu : Le ro’osilaka kedesseen : Kol lana mithlahom : Anny o’atikom salamy.

rows.en: + My peace, which I have taken : From My Good Father : I leave unto you : Now and forevermore.”
rows.ar_lat: Salamy Anna : Allazy akhaztahu men Abby : Anna atrokahu ma’akum : Men al-ann wa illal Abbad.

rows.en: O angel of this day/evening : Flying up high with this hymn : Remember us before the Lord : That he may forgive us our sins.
rows.ar_lat: Ya malak (hazza al youm/hazihy allayla) : Al-sa’ed illal ‘olowy behazzy al-tasbeha : Ozkorna koddam al-Rab : Le yaghfir lana khatayana.

rows.en: The sick, O Lord heal them : Those who slept repose them : And all our brethren in distress : Help us, O Lord and all of them.
rows.ar_lat: El-marda eshfihom : Allazina rakadu Yarab nayeh-hom : Ekhwatna allazina fi kol shedda : Yarab a’enna wa eyahom.

rows.en: May God bless us all : And let us bless His Holy Name : And may His praise be : Always on our lips.
rows.ar_lat: Le yobarikna Allah : Wal nobarek Esmahul Koddous : Fi koli heenen tasbehatu : Da’eman fi afwah-na.

rows.cop: Ⲁⲣⲓ ⲡ̀ⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲉ̀ϫⲱⲛ... ⲉ̀ϩ̀ⲣⲏⲓ
rows.en: Intercede behalf…
rows.ar_lat: on
rows.cop_lat: our Ari epresvevin egon… e-ehri

rows.cop: Ϫⲉ ϥ̀ⲥ̀ⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ Ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ: ⲛⲉⲙ Ⲡⲓⲡ̀ⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲉⲑ̅ⲩ̅: ϯⲧ̀ⲣⲓⲁⲥ ⲉⲧϫⲏⲕ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱϣⲧ ⲙ̀ⲙⲟⲥ ⲧⲉⲛϯⲱ̀ⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲥ.
rows.en: Blessed is the Father, the Son : and the Holy Spirit : the perfect Trinity : we worship and glory.
rows.cop_lat: Je ef ezmaro-ot enje Efyot nem Ep-shiri : nem pi Epnevma ethouab : ti etrias etjik evol : ten-o-osht emmos ten ti o-onas.

rows.en: (Other saints verses may be recited)

rows.cop: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲉ̀ ⲉ̀ⲗⲉⲏ̀ⲥⲟⲛ (x3)
rows.en: Lord have mercy (x3)
rows.cop_lat: Kiriye eleyson (x3)

rows.en: O Lord have mercy, O Lord hear us, O Lord bless us.
rows.ar_lat: Yarabu erhamna, Yarabu esma’ana, Yarabu barekna.

rows.en: Amen, alleluia… (Page 98)
